p-337.summary: Air no dey transfer heat well, so you fit endure 80°C sauna, but if di same temperature water touch you, you go get burn immediately.
p-337.principle: Heat wey go skin dey proportional to thermal conductivity and heat capacity. Thermal conductivity of water na about $0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\,K}$, wey be about 25 times of air ($0.026$), and e get much bigger heat capacity per volume too.
p-337.example: Water get about 25 times di thermal conductivity of air and about 3,500 times di volumetric heat capacity, so water above 60°C fit cause burn within few seconds.
p-337.actionItem: Today, before shower or bath, first check di water temperature with your inner arm.

p-338.title: Frozen lake ice only safe if e thick 10cm or more
p-338.summary: Di strength of ice to carry load dey increase proportionally to di square of thickness, but thin ice dey dangerous. Check di thickness and follow local guidance.
p-338.principle: Di supporting load of ice sheet na $P\propto h^2$, and if thickness $h$ double, e go carry about 4 times.
p-338.example: Generally, 5cm na barely enough for one person walking across, and only above 10cm dem say e safe for many people to walk, and if thickness increase from 5cm to 10cm, di supporting capacity na about 4 times.
p-338.actionItem: Today, before you go onto ice, first check local guidance and ice thickness, and if you doubt, no go.

p-339.title: Judge lantern by lumens, duration by Wh
p-339.summary: Compare lantern brightness by lumens (lm), and how long e go stay on by battery capacity (Wh) divided by power consumption.
p-339.principle: Efficiency na $\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$ and usage time na $t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: If you produce 300 lm with 100 lm/W efficiency, e be 3W. 3.7V 5,000 mAh battery (about 18.5Wh) go stay on for about 6 hours in theory.
p-339.actionItem: Today, check lumens and battery Wh (or mAh×V) for your lantern spec and calculate di usage time.

p-340.title: Di earliest sunset no be on winter solstice
p-340.summary: Di sun dey set earliest for early December, about 2 weeks before di winter solstice (around 21 December) wey get di shortest day. Di latest sunrise na for early January.
p-340.principle: Di time wey di sun reach due south dey shift by equation of time $E$, so di extreme values of sunset and sunrise time different from di solstice.
p-340.example: For Seoul, sunset na earliest for early December at about 17:16 and around di solstice na about 17:20, about 4 minutes later, but daylight duration na shortest for di solstice.
p-340.actionItem: Today, check sunset time and watch whether sunset time dey get later again until mid-December.

p-341.title: Kitchen scale dey waste less ingredients than measuring cup
p-341.summary: Flour wey you scoop with cup dey vary a lot depending on how compressed e be, but scale dey measure exactly for grams so you waste less ingredients.
p-341.principle: Mass na $m=\rho V$ but powder density $\rho$ fit change by more than 20% depending on how compacted e be, so even di same volume get different mass.
p-341.example: 1 cup of flour (about 240mL) fit be about 100 to 150g depending on how you scoop am, nearly 50% difference, so dough fit be too stiff or too wet.
p-341.actionItem: Today, if you go bake bread or cookies, measure ingredients with scale in grams instead of cup.

p-342.title: Put smartphone inside glass cup make sound louder
p-342.summary: If you put smartphone inside empty glass cup, di sound go gather and go forward and e go resonate inside di cup, so e go sound louder. Di effect na just few dB.
p-342.principle: Pipe wey one side closed dey resonate near $f=\frac{c}{4L}$, and di cup dey gather sound to one side to increase directivity.
p-342.example: If cup depth na 10cm, near $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$ go strengthen, and e fit increase by about 3 to 6dB (sound energy 2 to 4 times) and e depend on di product.
p-342.actionItem: Today, put smartphone inside cup with di speaker side facing inside and compare di volume.

p-343.title: Low-temperature burn fit happen even for 44°C after some hours
p-343.summary: Heat wey no too hot like electric blanket or heat pack fit damage deep skin if e touch di same place for long time. Because e no too painful, e easy to miss.
p-343.principle: Skin damage dey happen through thermal contact conduction where temperature and exposure time dey accumulate, and even if temperature low, if time long, di damage go big.
p-343.example: E dey known say burn fit happen if you touch about 44°C for about 6 hours or more, and heat pack near 60°C dey dangerous for much shorter time.
p-343.actionItem: Today, no put heat pack or electric blanket direct on skin, put am on top clothes or cloth, and off am before you sleep.

p-344.title: Avalanche dey happen most for 30 to 45° slope
p-344.summary: For snowy slope, avalanche dey happen most when slope na 30 to 45°. If e too gentle, snow go hold, and if e too steep, snow go slide before e gather.
p-344.principle: If shear stress $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$ for di bottom of snow layer pass friction resistance, e go slide, and as slope angle $\theta$ dey bigger, $\tau$ dey bigger and e dey maximum for about 45°.
p-344.example: If snow wey get density 300kg/m³ and thickness 1m dey for 38° slope, e be $\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, and if dis value pass di strength of di snow layer, avalanche go happen.
p-344.actionItem: Today, if you go snow mountain, check avalanche forecast and slope angle before you start, and avoid slopes wey pass 30°.

p-345.title: For light tripod, hang weight
p-345.summary: Light tripod dey fall easily for wind. If you hang weight like bag for di middle below to lower di centre of gravity, e go much more stable.
p-345.principle: Tripod go fall if force wey pass restoring moment $mgr$ dey act for height $h$ with di edge of di leg as axis. Di force wey need to knock am over na $F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, so di lower di centre of gravity, di bigger di force wey need.
p-345.example: If you hang 3kg bag for 0.3m height on 1.5kg tripod (centre of gravity 1.2m, leg radius 0.4m), di centre of gravity go go down to 0.6m, and di force wey need to knock am over go increase from about 4.9N to about 14.7N, about 3 times.
p-345.actionItem: Today, when you dey use tripod, hang di bag for di hook under di centre column and hang am low so e no touch di ground.

p-346.title: One person na 100W heater
p-346.summary: Person dey produce about 100W of heat even when e dey rest, so room wey plenty people gather go warm quick even without heating.
p-346.principle: Energy of food wey you eat dey finally release as heat, and basal metabolic rate na about $P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: 2,000kcal per day na $\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Room wey 20 people gather na about 2kW, wey equal one small electric heater.
p-346.actionItem: Today, if gathering dey, try lower heating setting by 1 to 2°C.

p-347.title: Wipe wet pot bottom before you put am for fire
p-347.summary: Water for di pot bottom dey evaporate on fire and dey take plenty heat, so e dey waste time and gas, and splashing water fit dey dangerous.
p-347.principle: When water evaporate, e need latent heat $Q=mL$ and di heat of vaporization of water na $L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: If 10g water dey for di bottom, e need $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$, and for effective 2kW fire power, na about 11 seconds worth of heat.
p-347.actionItem: Today, before you put pot for fire, wipe di water from di bottom with dishcloth.

p-348.title: Why whole string go off if one bulb for Christmas tree comot
p-348.summary: For string wey bulbs connect for series, if even one break, no path go dey for current to flow and di whole thing go off.
p-348.principle: Current for series circuit dey di same for all components and $I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. If one place break, resistance go be infinity and $I=0$.
p-348.example: If you connect 50 bulbs wey be 2.4V each for series, dem go share about 120V. If one comot, current for di remaining 49 go be 0 too.
p-348.actionItem: Today, for string wey off, unplug am, press di loose bulb inside, or replace am with spare bulb.

p-349.title: Why 'hoo' and 'whoo' breath get different temperature
p-349.summary: 'Hoo' wey you blow with mouth wide open dey feel warm, and 'whoo' wey you blow with lips puckered dey feel cool.
p-349.principle: If you purse your mouth, e go become fast jet and e go draw in surrounding air (entrainment). Mixture temperature go drop to $T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$, and expansion cooling go add small.
p-349.example: If about 34°C exhaled air mix 1:1 with 20°C room air, e be about 27°C, and di air wey touch your hand go feel about 7°C lower.
p-349.actionItem: Today, blow 'hoo' and 'whoo' for di back of your hand alternately to feel di temperature difference.

p-350.title: Snow sled speed dey decided only by height
p-350.summary: If friction no dey, di bottom speed of snow sled go depend only on di height wey you come down from and e no go depend on body weight. For real life, friction and air resistance dey make am slower.
p-350.principle: Potential energy dey change to kinetic energy, so from $mgh=\frac12mv^2$ na $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: If height na 5m, e be $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, about 36km/h, and di real speed go low pass dis.
p-350.actionItem: Today, if you go sled, choose gentle place wey no get obstacles and wear helmet.

p-351.title: Lie on mattress for 10 minutes and check di gap for your waist
p-351.summary: When you dey buy mattress, lie down for about 10 minutes and check whether palm fit enter easily between your waist and di mattress. If gap big, your waist go lift and pressure go gather for one place.
p-351.principle: Pressure na $P=\frac{F}{A}$ and e dey reduce as support area $A$ dey wider. Mattress dey spread load through spring constant $k$ and layer structure.
p-351.example: If 70kg body weight (about 686N) dey rest on only 0.1m², e be about 6.9kPa, and if e spread to 0.3m², e be about 2.3kPa, one-third.
p-351.actionItem: Today, when you dey choose mattress, lie on your side too and check for 10 minutes whether shoulder, waist and hip dey supported evenly.

p-352.title: Fan on top stove dey spin without electricity
p-352.summary: Fan wey dem put on top stove dey spin with only di stove heat without wire or battery, and e dey spread warmth inside di room.
p-352.principle: Through Seebeck effect, temperature difference $\Delta T$ between two junctions dey produce voltage $V=S\Delta T$, and dis voltage dey turn di motor.
p-352.example: If thermoelectric module get Seebeck coefficient about 0.05V/K, temperature difference of 100K go produce open-circuit voltage of about 5V, and output na few W or less.
p-352.actionItem: Today, put di stove fan for position inside di allowed temperature range wey dem write for di product, and keep am away from children hands.

p-353.title: Tealight flowerpot heater no fit warm room
p-353.summary: Heater wey dem make with few tealights and flowerpot no get enough heat to warm room, and e only increase fire and carbon monoxide risk.
p-353.principle: Candle dey produce only heat equal to di combustion heat of di fuel $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, and one tealight na about 40W.
p-353.example: One tealight dey burn about 14g wax (about 0.6MJ) for 4 hours to give about 40W, and 4 na about 160W, only few percent of di 1 to 3kW wey room heating need.
p-353.actionItem: Today, instead of flowerpot heater, block gaps for window frame to reduce heat wey dey leak.

p-354.title: Champagne cork fit fly 50km/h
p-354.summary: Inside champagne bottle na about 6atm pressure, so if cork release, e fit fly near 50km/h and hurt eye.
p-354.principle: Pressure difference dey accelerate di cork with force $F=\Delta P\cdot A$ wey push am, and di work wey di gas do while expanding become kinetic energy $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: If pressure difference na about 5bar, cork cross-section na about $2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, e be $F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, and if cork fly at about 14m/s (50km/h), kinetic energy na about 0.9J.
p-354.actionItem: Today, when you dey open champagne, tilt di bottle about 45°, press di cork with thumb, turn di bottle slowly, and no point am toward person.

p-355.title: Di white noise dey cover sudden sounds while you sleep
p-355.summary: Gentle white noise fit reduce di difference between sudden sound and background sound, so you go wake less. Di effect dey different for each person.
p-355.principle: Through auditory masking, wide-band noise dey raise di audibility threshold of other sounds. Sound difference dey expressed as $\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: For background 30dB, door closing sound of 70dB na 40dB difference, but if 45dB white noise dey, di difference go reduce to 25dB so e go bother less.
p-355.actionItem: Tonight, play white noise for small sound of about 40dB for ear with timer, and keep am far from young baby ear.

p-356.title: Crampon na mechanical grip wey dey dig into ice
p-356.summary: Crampon no dey increase friction, e dey prevent sliding by di way wey sharp spikes dey dig into ice and physically hook.
p-356.principle: Shoe wey dey on ice get sliding limit of $\tan\theta=\mu$ and friction coefficient $\mu$ small well well, but spike dey use di shear resistance of ice to hook.
p-356.example: Static friction coefficient between normal shoe and ice na about 0.1, so e go slide at only about 5.7° ($\tan^{-1}0.1$), but crampon spikes fit hold even for much steeper ice slopes.
p-356.actionItem: Today, before you hike, check say di crampon spikes no blunt and di straps dey tighten firmly.

p-357.title: Choose laser pointer wey be 1mW or less
p-357.summary: Laser pointer wey dey safe for eye na Class 2 product wey get output of 1mW or less. If output high, even di blink reflex no fit protect enough.
p-357.principle: Eye blink reflex na about 0.25 seconds and di energy wey enter di eye na $E=P\,t$. Di smaller di beam cross-section, di bigger di irradiance $I=P/A$.
p-357.example: If 1mW for 0.25 seconds, e be $E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. For 3mm diameter beam, e be $I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Cheap products sometimes get higher output than wetin dem label.
p-357.actionItem: Today, check say your laser pointer get 'Class 2, 1mW or less' label, and no shine am toward people, animals or vehicles.

p-358.title: Firewood and coal briquette stove dey burn better if chimney tall
p-358.summary: Di taller di chimney and di hotter di air inside, di bigger di suction force (draft) wey dey pull up, so fire dey catch well and smoke dey comot well.
p-358.principle: Through chimney effect, draft pressure na $\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$ and e dey proportional to height $h$ and density difference.
p-358.example: If height na 5m, outside 0°C (1.29kg/m³), and exhaust 200°C (about 0.75kg/m³), e be $\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Today, if you go use stove, check di flue joints and check di carbon monoxide alarm battery.

p-359.title: Even for below-zero weather, laundry dey dry while frozen
p-359.summary: Laundry wey you hang for below-zero weather go freeze, but e go slowly dry through sublimation, where ice dey turn to vapour without passing through liquid. You no need to use dryer.
p-359.principle: Sublimation $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$ wey ice dey become gas direct need $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$, and di drier and windier e be, di faster.
p-359.example: 1kg of water need about 2.83MJ to sublimate. Even though e go take longer than one dryer cycle (about 2 to 3kWh), e no need electricity.
p-359.actionItem: Today, for clear and dry below-zero day, hang laundry, and after e dry, shake am and finish am indoors.

p-360.title: Clear snow from car roof before you drive
p-360.summary: Snow wey gather for roof fit fly back as lump when you dey drive and hit di car behind or cover di windscreen. Before you start, clear di roof, bonnet and glass.
p-360.principle: Because of driving wind speed, snow lump dey fly back and hit di car behind with kinetic energy $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: If 5cm of snow (assume density 100kg/m³) gather for 2m² roof, e be about 10kg. If e hit with relative speed 80km/h (22.2m/s), e be about 2.5kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Today, if snow fall, before you drive, sweep all di snow from roof, bonnet and glass with soft brush.

p-361.title: Why voice dey loud when restaurant noisy
p-361.summary: When noise big, people dey raise dia voice without knowing, and dem dey call dis Lombard effect. If everybody do am, di noise go bigger.
p-361.principle: Through Lombard effect, sound pressure dey rise according to noise, and for voice to dey heard, you must maintain signal-to-noise ratio $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$.
p-361.example: E dey known say when noise rise 20dB from 60dB to 80dB, speech go loud by about 6 to 10dB. Restaurant fit even reach 70 to 80dB.
p-361.actionItem: Today, for gathering, choose corner seat wey far from speakers and lean toward di person and talk with low voice.

p-362.title: New Year sunrise dey come early for eastern areas
p-362.summary: Di sun dey rise first for east. For di same latitude, every 1° longitude east, sunrise dey come about 4 minutes early.
p-362.principle: Di earth dey rotate $15^\circ$ per hour, so difference of $1^\circ$ longitude na $\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: Homigot wey be 129.6°E dey about 2.6° east of Seoul (127°E), so sunrise dey about 10 minutes early, and di real difference dey slightly different depending on latitude difference.
p-362.actionItem: Today, if you go see New Year sunrise, check di sunrise time for di place wey you go before.

p-363.title: Air pressure units bar, psi, kPa, convert at once
p-363.summary: Tyre pressure dey written in bar, psi, kPa and others. If you remember only one conversion value, you fit convert any unit.
p-363.actionItem: Today, look di recommended pressure table for di driver door frame and check di real value with tyre pressure gauge.

p-364.title: Calculate home EV charging time with kWh÷kW
p-364.summary: Charging time na roughly di energy to fill (kWh) divided by charger output (kW). Because of loss, di real time na slightly more.
p-364.principle: $t=\frac{E}{P}$ and if charging efficiency $\eta$ dey, e be $t=\frac{E}{\eta P}$.
p-364.example: If you fill 60kWh battery from 10% to 80%, e be $E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, and with 7kW charger (90% efficiency), e be $t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ hours.
p-364.actionItem: Today, check your car battery capacity (kWh) and charger output (kW) and calculate di charging time.

p-365.title: When you dey melt snow for water, first put one cup of water
p-365.summary: Snow get plenty air holes so heat no dey transfer well, and if you put am direct inside empty pot, di bottom go burn easily. If you first put small water, di heat contact go better and e go melt much faster.
p-365.principle: Snow thermal conductivity low and e get big pores, so contact area with pot small. To melt am, you need heat of fusion $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: To make 1L of water, e need about 334kJ, wey equal di heat to raise 80°C. Snow na only about 10% water by volume, so you need about 10L of snow.
p-365.actionItem: Today, if you need to make water from snow, first heat one cup of water, den add clean snow small small (make sure say you boil am before you drink).

p-366.title: Snowy uphill road: accelerate slowly and climb without stopping
p-366.summary: For snowy uphill, if you stop, e hard to start again, and if you accelerate hard, wheels go spin. Keep distance before di uphill and climb slowly and steadily.
p-366.principle: Static friction $F\le\mu_sN$ dey bigger than kinetic friction $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), so if wheels spin, grip go drop sharply.
p-366.example: For packed snow road wey be $\mu\approx0.2$, for 10% slope ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$), di gravity component na about $0.1\,mg$ and friction na about $0.2\,mg$, so di margin na only about $0.1\,mg$.
p-366.actionItem: Today, for snowy uphill road, keep enough distance from di car ahead, and climb for steady speed so you no stop halfway.

c-001.title: No mix baking soda and vinegar, use dem separately
c-001.summary: If you mix dem, na only foam go come out and di cleaning power go cancel each other. E better to use baking soda for grease and vinegar for water scale separately.
c-001.principle: Weak base ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) and weak acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) go neutralise and become almost neutral sodium acetate solution: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: If you mix 1 tablespoon baking soda (about 12g) with half cup vinegar, afta di foam finish, pH go drop to about 8 or below and e no go fit dissolve grease or water scale well. If you use dem separately, di same amount go handle both kinds of dirt.
c-001.actionItem: Today, use only baking soda paste for kitchen sink grease, and use only kitchen towel wey you wet with vinegar for tap water scale, separately.

c-002.title: Never use bleach together with acidic cleaner
c-002.summary: If you mix sodium hypochlorite (bleach) with acidic toilet cleaner, toxic chlorine gas go form. Use only one at a time and rinse well with water in between.
c-002.principle: When hypochlorite meet acid, e turn to chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: Chlorine gas dey irritate eyes and throat even at about 3ppm, and above 30ppm e dey cause serious cough and breathing difficulty. For small bathroom, e fit reach dangerous level within few minutes.
c-002.actionItem: For your toilet shelf, separate bleach and acidic (hydrochloric or citric acid) cleaners into different places, and before you use am check di 'do not mix' warning for di label.

c-003.title: Bleach mixed with ammonia or glass cleaner dey dangerous too
c-003.summary: If you mix bleach with glass cleaner wey get ammonia, toxic gas wey dem dey call chloramine go form. Open window and no use di two products one after di other on di same day.
c-003.principle: $\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ form chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$) wey dey irritate di airway.
c-003.example: Even if you mix only small bleach with cleaner wey get about 5% ammonia, cough and burning eyes fit show for closed bathroom within few minutes. If you use bleach for where urine touch, smell gas go come out for di same reason.
c-003.actionItem: Look for 'ammonia' for di cleaner ingredient list and note am so you no go use am with bleach on di same day, and open window when you dey clean.

c-004.title: For travel, use hand sanitiser wey get 60% ethanol or more
c-004.summary: For where no get water, alcohol hand sanitiser na alternative, but if ethanol concentration below 60%, e no go work well. To carry am inside plane, put am for container wey no pass 100mL.
c-004.principle: Ethanol dey denature microbe protein and dissolve lipid membrane. E dey burn, so di combustion reaction na $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$.
c-004.example: Sanitiser wey get 60 to 80% ethanol must rub for about 20 seconds and leave until e dry completely before e go work. For hand wey get visible dirt, water and soap better than sanitiser.
c-004.actionItem: Today, check di ethanol concentration (%) for di label of di sanitiser wey you go use for your travel bag and pour am inside containers of 100mL or less.

c-005.title: When you dey choose detergent, look di pH for di label
c-005.summary: Kitchen and bathroom detergents get different pH depending on use. If you choose alkaline for grease and acidic for water scale, di same money go clean better.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$, and if pH reduce by 1, $\mathrm{H^+}$ concentration go be 10 times. Fat dey saponify for alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Alkaline detergent wey get pH 11 to 12 dey work well for grease, and acidic detergent wey get pH 2 to 3 dey work well for limescale. Neutral (pH 6 to 8) kitchen detergent dey gentle for hand but e go take more time for stubborn grease.
c-005.actionItem: Next time wey you go market, check di pH mark and 'use' for detergent label and note down di pH of three detergents wey dey your house.

c-006.title: Wash cloth with cold water of 30℃ to reduce heating energy
c-006.summary: Detergents nowadays dey work well even for around 30℃, so for normal washing you no need to raise am to 60℃. Di less water you heat, di less electricity go use.
c-006.principle: Heat wey dey heat water na $Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$), and protein-digesting enzymes dey active at 30 to 40℃.
c-006.example: To heat 10L of water from 15℃ to 30℃, e need about 627kJ, and to heat am to 60℃ e need about 1,881kJ, wey be 3 times difference. If you wash 4 times a week, di saving go add up to more than 200 times a year.
c-006.actionItem: Today, set your washing machine to 30℃ (or cold water) and raise am to 40℃ only for heavy sweat cloth.

c-007.title: Use one spoon of citric acid remove scale from electric kettle
c-007.summary: Di white limescale inside kettle go dissolve with citric acid. E smell less than vinegar and e cheap, so e worth to try am first before you buy new kettle.
c-007.principle: Calcium carbonate scale dey dissolve for acid: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: If you put 1 tablespoon citric acid (about 10g) inside 500mL water, boil am and leave am for 20 minutes, most of di scale wey be about 1mm thick go loosen. 1kg citric acid for about 5,000 won fit be use dozens of times.
c-007.actionItem: Today, put water and 1 tablespoon citric acid inside your kettle, boil am, leave am for 20 minutes, then pour di water comot and rinse am two or three times.

c-008.title: Wetin be di white soap residue wey dey remain for cloth and bathroom
c-008.summary: For hard water, di fatty acid for soap dey meet calcium and become residue wey no dissolve for water. You fit reduce am by using synthetic detergent or rinsing with vinegar.
c-008.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ form precipitate and foam go reduce.
c-008.example: For area wey get hardness of 200mg/L (as CaCO₃) or more, di same amount of soap fit give half foam or less. Di white film for bathroom tile fit dissolve with acidic cleaner.
c-008.actionItem: Today, spray vinegar or citric acid water on di white film for bathroom tile, wait 5 minutes and wipe am comot.

c-009.title: Reduce residual chlorine for tap water by leaving am or boiling am
c-009.summary: Tap water dey get small chlorine wey dem leave for disinfection. E safe, but if you no like di smell, you fit leave am open or boil am and e go reduce.
c-009.principle: Hypochlorous acid dey break down when time pass or when light touch am: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: Residual chlorine for tap na usually 0.1 to 0.5mg/L. If you collect am inside kettle and leave am for some hours or boil am for 5 minutes with di lid open, di smell go reduce noticeably.
c-009.actionItem: This evening, collect water for kettle, leave am with di lid open, and tomorrow before you drink am compare di smell.

c-010.title: Why hair dey stiff after you bath with hard water for foreign trip
c-010.summary: Water for places wey get plenty limescale like Europe get plenty calcium and magnesium, so shampoo no dey foam well and hair go stiff. Acid treatment for rinse stage dey help.
c-010.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ for hard water dey combine with anionic surfactant for shampoo to form precipitate. Hardness na $\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: If hardness na 300mg/L or more, dem go call am 'very hard water' and e high pass Korean tap water (usually 50 to 100mg/L) by more than 3 times. If you mix 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar per 1L water and rinse am last, di stiffness go reduce.
c-010.actionItem: For your next trip bag, carry small bottle of divided citric acid powder or vinegar, and ask your hotel about di hardness of di local water.

c-011.title: Ion-exchange resin for softener filter dey recover with salt
c-011.summary: Shower softener filter and some water purifiers dey catch calcium with ion-exchange resin. Some resin dey regenerate with salt water, some dey replaceable, so check before you buy.
c-011.principle: Di resin dey catch calcium and release sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. After e saturate, dem go return am with strong salt water.
c-011.example: If replaceable filter cost 10,000 won each and you change am once a month, e go cost 120,000 won a year. For regenerable type, wey be salt price of few kg fit last many years.
c-011.actionItem: Compare di 'replacement cycle' and 'whether e fit regenerate' of di softener filter wey you wan buy, and calculate di yearly cost.

c-012.title: Heater wey get scale dey use more energy and e dey spoil early
c-012.summary: If limescale gather for electric kettle or humidifier heating plate, heat no go reach di water well, heating time go long and parts go overheat. To remove am regularly dey good for both energy and lifespan.
c-012.principle: Heat transfer na $q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, and scale ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) be insulation layer wey dey block heat pass metal.
c-012.example: If scale reach 2mm or more, di time to heat to di same temperature fit increase by few %, and di heating element temperature go rise and reduce lifespan. Citric acid cleaning once a month go enough.
c-012.actionItem: Put 'first Sunday of every month, citric acid cleaning of kettle and humidifier' as repeating schedule for your calendar.

c-013.title: Melt ice with salt, spray small before e freeze
c-013.summary: If you spray small salt before snow fall or just before e freeze, e go cost far less than when you dey melt ice wey don already freeze. Na because freezing point dey drop.
c-013.principle: Freezing point depression $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, for NaCl $i \approx 2$)
c-013.example: 10% mass salt water na $m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$, so $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, wey mean e go start to freeze at about -7℃. Below -10℃ di effect go drop quickly, so at dat time use sand.
c-013.actionItem: If tonight get freezing forecast, spray one handful of salt thinly on your front door steps.

c-014.title: Calcium chloride de-icer and salt, where to use wetin
c-014.summary: Calcium chloride dey work for lower temperature but e dey damage concrete and metal more. Choose according to temperature and place.
c-014.principle: Calcium chloride dey release heat when e dissolve in water: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Real effect na NaCl up to about -10℃ and $\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ up to about -25℃. Near newly poured concrete or iron railing, reduce chloride use and use sand.
c-014.actionItem: Today, check di ingredient (sodium chloride or calcium chloride) for di de-icer bag, and mark am so you no go use am near iron railing close to di front door.

c-015.title: Wash pet paws and hands afta de-icer touch dem
c-015.summary: Chloride de-icer wey dem spray for road dey dry paw pads and if dem lick am e fit cause vomiting. After walk, wash with lukewarm water.
c-015.principle: Chloride dey pull water from skin and dry am. Dissolved salty water dey remain through $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, di same principle as lowering freezing point.
c-015.example: Calcium chloride dey produce heat when e dissolve, so e fit sting if e touch wet skin. After walk, rinse di paws for lukewarm water for 30 seconds and dry dem, and most problems go solve.
c-015.actionItem: Today after walk, rinse your pet paws with lukewarm water, and for people, wipe di shoe soles with wet mop.

c-016.title: Check di freezing point of windscreen washer fluid before long winter drive
c-016.summary: Windscreen washer fluid wey be only water go freeze at 0℃ and block your view. Winter washer fluid get alcohol wey dey lower di freezing point.
c-016.principle: $\Delta T_f = K_f m$, so di higher di alcohol concentration, di lower di freezing point, but e dey flammable too ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Product wey get -20℃ or -30℃ for di label no go freeze up to dat temperature, but if you dilute am with water di freezing point go rise. Methanol product vapour dey toxic so keep ventilation.
c-016.actionItem: Before you start, check di washer fluid tank level and di freezing point mark for di label.

c-017.title: Check di dilution ratio and standard mark before you buy antifreeze
c-017.summary: If you mix antifreeze (ethylene glycol) with coolant, di freezing point go drop and di boiling point go rise. You must follow di ratio and standard for e to work, and no mix different types.
c-017.principle: $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, and if ethylene glycol na about 50 vol%, di freezing point go be about -37℃ and boiling point about 106℃.
c-017.example: If you use only pure concentrate, di freezing point go rather rise and heat transfer go worse. Ethylene glycol get sweet taste and e dey kill pets, so wipe am immediately if e spill.
c-017.actionItem: Check di recommended antifreeze standard and dilution ratio for di vehicle manual, then ask for am when you dey get quote for garage.

c-018.title: You fit predict winter window condensation with dew point
c-018.summary: If humid indoor air touch cold glass, water drops go form and e go cause mould and heat loss. If you set indoor humidity properly, heating go waste less too.
c-018.principle: Dew point na approximate $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$), and condensation na $\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: If indoor na 22℃ and humidity 60%, di dew point na about 14℃. If di inside surface of window na 10℃, condensation go form, so if you reduce humidity to 40 to 50%, di dew point go be about 10 to 12℃ and e go prevent am mostly.
c-018.actionItem: Today, set your humidifier target humidity to 40 to 50% and check di hygrometer reading for evening.

c-019.title: Use diluted bleach safely for bathroom silicone mould
c-019.summary: Black mould wey spread for silicone fit lose colour with bleach wey get oxidising power. Always ventilate and use am separately from acidic products.
c-019.principle: Oxidation by hypochlorite: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$, and $\mathrm{OCl^-}$ dey oxidise mould pigment and cells.
c-019.example: Dilute commercial bleach (about 4 to 5%) with water 1:10, apply am and after 10 minutes rinse well with water. Mould dey grow for relative humidity 60 to 70% or more, so to ventilate afta shower go prevent am from coming back.
c-019.actionItem: Today, open bathroom window, wear gloves, clean di silicone mould with 1:10 diluted bleach and rinse am after 10 minutes.

c-020.title: Use sodium percarbonate to remove mould and yellow stain safely
c-020.summary: Sodium percarbonate, wey be oxygen bleach, dey irritate less than bleach and no get chlorine gas risk, so e easy to use for coloured cloth. E dey more active for warm water.
c-020.principle: Sodium percarbonate dey break down and release hydrogen peroxide: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \to 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-020.example: If you dissolve 1 tablespoon sodium percarbonate (about 10g) for 1L water at 40 to 50℃ and soak for 30 minutes to 1 hour, sweat stain and mould stain go comot. No use am for wool or silk.
c-020.actionItem: Today, dissolve 1 tablespoon sodium percarbonate inside 40 to 50℃ water and soak yellowed white socks or dish towel for 30 minutes.

c-021.title: Wardrobe dehumidifier dey last longer for small space
c-021.summary: Calcium chloride dehumidifier dey absorb water from air and turn to water. If you use am for small closed place like wardrobe or shoe rack instead of big room, e dey more efficient.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$ e dey absorb moisture, and if e absorb more, e go dissolve and become water.
c-021.example: Calcium chloride dey absorb water many times its own weight. If you put am for where dem dey open door often, e go saturate quick, so e better to use am for small closed place for more than one month. Throw away di collected water so e no touch skin or metal.
c-021.actionItem: Today, put one dehumidifier for di bottom of your wardrobe and reduce how many times you dey open and close di door.

c-022.title: Small sachet for snack, silica gel and quicklime no be di same
c-022.summary: Two common desiccants dey inside food packaging, silica gel and quicklime, and you must not eat any of dem. Quicklime dey get hot when e meet water, so be extra careful with eyes and mouth.
c-022.principle: Quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (exothermic, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). Silica gel dey adsorb water molecules for its surface.
c-022.example: You fit reuse silica gel if you dry am inside 100 to 120℃ oven for 1 to 2 hours. If quicklime sachet get wet, e become strong alkaline liquid, so throw am away without letting am touch water.
c-022.actionItem: Bring out di desiccant sachets for your kitchen drawer, check di 'silica gel/quicklime' mark, and keep dem where children no fit reach.

c-023.title: For glasses and goggles fog, stop am with one drop of surfactant
c-023.summary: When you enter warm room from cold outdoor for winter, fog dey form for lens because of small water droplets. If you put surfactant film, di droplets go spread into thin film and your view go remain clear.
c-023.principle: Di bigger di contact angle, di more water droplets dey form. Surfactant dey reduce surface tension $\gamma$ so droplets go spread.
c-023.example: If you spread only one drop of dish soap thinly on di lens and wipe am with dry cloth, fog go reduce for few hours. Coated lens fit spoil di coating, so check di manufacturer instruction.
c-023.actionItem: Today before you go out, press di top of your mask close to your nose and try spreading one drop of detergent on your glasses and wipe am.

c-024.title: Food wey you spread thin and freeze fast dey spoil less
c-024.summary: If e freeze slowly, big ice crystals go tear cells, so after thaw water go comot and food go tough. If you spread am thin and freeze am fast, small crystals go form and quality go remain.
c-024.principle: Crystal size depend on cooling speed. For di phase change $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$, you must remove heat of $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$.
c-024.example: If you spread leftover soup or meat 2cm thick inside zip bag and freeze am on top metal tray, e go freeze few hours faster than when e dey lump, and juice loss for thaw go reduce. Storage at -18℃ or below na di standard.
c-024.actionItem: Today, spread one leftover food thin inside zip bag, write di date and freeze am.

c-025.title: How to handle potato wey sprout or turn green
c-025.summary: Sprout and green parts of potato get plenty toxic substance wey dem dey call solanine. Even boiling or frying no dey easily break am down, so you must cut am out thick.
c-025.principle: Solanine strong against heat and e only dey break down around $290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Light dey increase solanine production together with chlorophyll.
c-025.example: If you cut around sprouts and green parts generously by 1cm or more around am, most of am go comot. If di whole skin green or e taste bitter, throw am away. If you keep am for dark cool place (8 to 10℃), sprouts go grow slowly.
c-025.actionItem: Today, wrap potato with newspaper and keep am for dark cool place, and cut out or throw away di potato wey don sprout.

c-026.title: Apple and avocado browning fit slow down with one drop of lemon juice
c-026.summary: Di brown colour wey cut fruit dey turn na enzyme reaction wey happen when e meet oxygen. If you add acid, di reaction go slow and e safe to eat.
c-026.principle: Polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) dey reduce quinone back.
c-026.example: At pH 4 or below, enzyme activity go drop well well. If you slice one apple and sprinkle 1 teaspoon lemon juice, browning go delay for 2 to 3 hours. Browned part no get big problem for nutrition or safety.
c-026.actionItem: Today, if you cut apple or avocado, dip dem briefly for few drops of lemon juice or salt water.

c-027.title: Pressure cooker dey raise boiling point to reduce cooking time and gas
c-027.summary: Inside closed pot, pressure dey rise so water go boil for temperature wey high pass 100℃. Di higher di temperature, di faster di chemical reaction.
c-027.principle: By Clausius-Clapeyron relation, at about 2atm (absolute), water go boil at about $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Reaction rate na $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: If temperature rise by 10℃, reaction rate go about double, so if e rise by 20℃, e go be about 4 times. Beans or tough meat wey dey take 60 minutes for normal pot go reduce to about 20 minutes for pressure cooker, so gas use go reduce a lot too.
c-027.actionItem: Today, try pressure cooker for food wey dey take long to boil (beans, shank, etc.) and compare di time.

c-028.title: Why jam wey get plenty sugar dey last long without mould
c-028.summary: Na because sugar dey hold water, so di water wey microbes fit use go reduce. If you sterilise di jar and follow di sugar ratio, you fit store am long for fridge.
c-028.principle: If water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ drop below 0.85, most bacteria no fit grow, and mould fit grow until around 0.8.
c-028.example: Jam wey get about 60% sugar get $a_w \approx 0.80$, so bacteria go suppress but mould fit still grow. If you put am inside jar wey you sterilise with hot water, keep am for fridge before you open am, and eat am within 2 to 3 weeks afta you open am, you go reduce waste.
c-028.actionItem: Today, boil leftover fruit with 40 to 50% sugar to make jam and put am inside sterilised jar with date written.

c-029.title: Wipe frying pan grease first and wash with warm water
c-029.summary: Cold grease dey harden so soap and water no fit easily clean am. If you wipe am first with kitchen towel and use warm water and soap, you go save soap and water.
c-029.principle: Fat dey react with alkali or surfactant to become soap wey easy to wash: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Pork fat dey start to melt at about 30 to 40℃, so water around 40℃ go loosen di grease. If you wipe first, your dish washing water go reduce by half and e go prevent drain blockage.
c-029.actionItem: Today before you wash dishes, wipe di grease from di pan with kitchen towel first and wash with warm water.

c-030.title: If you stop frying and roasting at light golden colour, acrylamide go reduce
c-030.summary: If you cook potato or bread to deep brown colour with high heat, acrylamide go increase. If you stop at golden brown, you go keep di taste and reduce production.
c-030.principle: Asparagine and reducing sugar dey go through Maillard reaction above $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, and acrylamide ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$) dey form.
c-030.example: If you stop french fries at golden colour below 175℃ and no keep potatoes for fridge, sugar no go increase and di amount wey form fit reduce a lot. E better no to eat deep brown or burnt parts.
c-030.actionItem: Today, take toast or roasted potato comot before e turn deep brown and cut off di burnt parts.

c-031.title: Disposable hand warmer na heat from rusting iron
c-031.summary: Di iron powder for hand warmer dey oxidise when e meet oxygen from air, and heat dey comot. E convenient for winter trip but if you stick am on skin for long, e get risk of low-temperature burn.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ na exothermic reaction, and activated carbon and salt dey make di reaction faster.
c-031.example: Di highest temperature na about 50 to 60℃ and e dey last some hours. Stick am on top outer cloth, not underwear, and remove am when you dey sleep so you go avoid low-temperature burn. Before you open am, di sealed packaging dey block air.
c-031.actionItem: Today when you dey use hand warmer, stick am on cloth and check your skin condition every one hour.

c-032.title: Charcoal deodoriser dey adsorb, e no dey break down smell
c-032.summary: Charcoal and activated carbon dey hold smell molecules for their surface and reduce am. When e saturate, e stop to work, so you must follow di replace or regenerate time.
c-032.principle: Adsorption na di thing where molecules stick for surface, and di specific surface area of activated carbon fit reach $500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: 100g activated carbon fit get surface area di size of football field, so e dey catch smell for one fridge shelf. If you dry charcoal for sun once a month, some go regenerate, and change am every 3 to 6 months.
c-032.actionItem: Write di date wey you change di fridge deodoriser for di label and set reminder for 3 months later.

c-033.title: If you soak rice for 30 minutes, cooking energy go reduce
c-033.summary: Soaked rice don already hold water, so heating time go short and di rice go cook evenly. Electric rice cooker or gas use go reduce small small.
c-033.principle: Starch dey absorb water and gelatinise: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ swollen gel. Gelatinisation dey happen at about $60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: If you soak rice for 30 minutes, e go absorb about 20 to 25% water by weight and water go reach inside. Cooking time go reduce by few minutes compare to when you no soak am, so if you cook every day, e go save tens of minutes every month. For winter, lukewarm water dey faster.
c-033.actionItem: This evening, wash rice, soak am for 30 minutes, cook am and compare di cooking time.

c-034.title: 20 seconds hand washing na di time wey soap need to surround dirt
c-034.summary: Soap molecule get one side wey like oil and another side wey like water, so e dey surround dirt and germs and wash dem comot. Dis process need friction and time.
c-034.principle: Soap dey form micelles above critical micelle concentration (CMC) to wrap grease: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: If you lather di palm, back of hand, between fingers and under nails and rub for 20 seconds (two times Happy Birthday song), common germs go reduce well well. Water temperature go be fine if you set am to protect your skin rather than for effect.
c-034.actionItem: Today when you dey wash your hands, count 20 seconds with timer or song and rub reach under your nails.

c-035.title: Winter lip balm dey make film, no be moisture
c-035.summary: Hydrocarbon lip balm like Vaseline dey form hydrophobic film wey dey stop water from leaving lips. E dey work better if you put am on wet lips or on dead skin.
c-035.principle: Evaporation rate dey follow di difference in water vapour pressure for skin surface, and petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ film no mix with water so e dey slow dis evaporation.
c-035.example: For dry winter indoor (relative humidity about 20%), water for bare lips dey escape fast. If you apply Vaseline thinly, evaporation go reduce noticeably and cracking go reduce.
c-035.actionItem: Tonight before you sleep, wet your lips with water and apply one thin layer of lip balm.

c-036.title: Hand cream last longer if you apply am when your hand still wet
c-036.summary: If you apply am on wet hand, di moisturiser effect wey dey trap water go increase. Di same amount go make your hand more moist so you go use less cream.
c-036.principle: Skin water loss dey follow diffusion law $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$, glycerin dey pull water and Vaseline dey stop evaporation.
c-036.example: Within 3 minutes afta shower or hand wash, wipe lightly with towel only and apply pea-size cream, you fit reduce di amount wey you dey apply two or three times a day even for dry winter. If you wear gloves when you sleep, di effect go big.
c-036.actionItem: Today afta you wash your hands, apply pea-size hand cream before you dry am completely.

c-037.title: Choose face wash wey get mild acid (pH around 5.5) like skin
c-037.summary: Skin surface get mild acidic protective layer, so soap wey get high pH fit break am. For dry winter, mild acidic cleanser dey irritate less.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Skin surface na pH 4.5 to 5.5 and common soap na pH 9 to 10, so $\mathrm{[H^+]}$ dey about ten thousand times lower.
c-037.example: pH 5.5 and pH 9.5 get hydrogen ion concentration difference of $10^4$ times. Face wash wey dem write 'mildly acidic' for di label dey make you feel less tight afta washing and e reduce di moisturiser wey you go use.
c-037.actionItem: Next time wey you wan buy face wash, check di pH value for di product description and note how your skin feel afta washing.

c-038.title: Why power bank capacity dey reduce when e cold
c-038.summary: For low temperature, lithium-ion battery chemical reaction and ion movement dey slow, so di usable capacity go reduce. If you put am inside inner pocket, e go discharge less.
c-038.principle: For reaction rate $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, if $T$ reduce, $k$ go small and battery internal resistance go increase.
c-038.example: Near 0℃, capacity fit reduce by 20 to 30%, and at -10℃ e go be more. 10,000 mAh power bank fit give only about 7,000 mAh for winter outdoor, so e go feel like say number of charges don reduce.
c-038.actionItem: Today when you go out, put power bank and smartphone inside inner pocket of your jacket to keep dem warm with body heat.

c-039.title: Calculate power bank for plane with Wh
c-039.summary: Lithium battery fit only go inside carry-on, no be checked baggage, and di capacity limit na for Wh. If you look only mAh, e go confuse you, so calculate am yourself.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (lithium-ion nominal 3.7V). 100Wh or below dem allow, 100 to 160Wh need airline approval.
c-039.example: 20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7V = 74Wh no problem, and 27,000 mAh na 99.9Wh wey close to di limit. 30,000 mAh (111Wh) need approval.
c-039.actionItem: Today, multiply di mAh of your power bank by 3.7V to change am to Wh and check whether Wh dey for di label.

c-040.title: Prevent carbon monoxide poisoning when you dey use heater or charcoal for winter
c-040.summary: If fuel burn incompletely for place wey no get ventilation, odourless carbon monoxide go form. No use charcoal, coal briquettes or camping heater inside house.
c-040.principle: If oxygen no dey enough, carbon monoxide go form $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$, and CO dey bind hemoglobin about 200 times stronger than oxygen.
c-040.example: For CO concentration of 200ppm for air, headache go come for few hours, and above 800ppm e dey dangerous within one hour. Check di boiler exhaust pipe connection and ventilation and install CO alarm.
c-040.actionItem: Today, check di boiler exhaust pipe connection and check di CO alarm battery.

c-041.title: If gas flame yellow, fuel dey waste
c-041.summary: Normal gas flame na blue, and if e yellow or orange e mean incomplete combustion wey dey increase soot and carbon monoxide. Clean di burner to recover efficiency.
c-041.principle: Complete combustion: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. If oxygen no enough $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: If yellow flame dey make di pot bottom black with soot, heat go transfer less and fuel go use di same or more. If you remove food residue from di burner holes with toothpick, e go mostly return to blue flame.
c-041.actionItem: Today, clean your gas burner holes with toothpick and check di flame colour.

c-042.title: Car lead-acid battery, prevent winter discharge to save replacement cost
c-042.summary: If cold and short drives dey repeat, lead-acid battery go discharge and e go shorten its life. For discharged state, di electrolyte dey thin and e fit freeze for freezing weather.
c-042.principle: Discharge: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. Sulphuric acid dey finish so di freezing point of electrolyte go rise.
c-042.example: Electrolyte for fully charged battery dey freeze at about -60℃, but if e discharge, e fit freeze at about -7℃. If you drive for more than 30 minutes once a week or top up with charger, you fit delay replacement cost of about 100,000 won.
c-042.actionItem: Today before you start di car, off heater, seat warmer and audio, and schedule 30-minute drive once a week.

c-043.title: Seasoning cast iron pan na polymerisation reaction wey oil dey harden
c-043.summary: If you bake thin layer of oil for new cast iron pan at high heat to form hard film, rust and sticking go reduce. If you apply am thick, e go sticky.
c-043.principle: Unsaturated fatty acids dey react with oxygen and polymerise. Rust dey form as $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: After you apply very small cooking oil and wipe am with kitchen towel, bake am at 220℃ oven for 1 hour and film go form. If you dry am immediately afta use, one seasoned pan fit last many years, so e go cost less.
c-043.actionItem: Today, after you wash cast iron or iron pan, put am on fire to dry di water, and wipe thin oil on top.

c-044.title: Clean tarnished silver spoon with aluminium foil and baking soda
c-044.summary: Di black silver sulphide for silver surface go return to silver by electrochemical reaction. You no rub am so di silver no wear off much. E dey smell like sulphur so ventilate.
c-044.example: Dissolve 1 tablespoon baking soda for 500mL hot water and soak am for 2 to 5 minutes with di silver touching di foil. No use am for products wey get pearl, gemstones or glued handles.
c-044.actionItem: Today, soak one tarnished silver spoon inside hot water with foil and baking soda.

c-045.title: No eat di blue-green verdigris for copper pot
c-045.summary: If copper meet acid and moisture, blue-green verdigris go form and e dey toxic. No leave acidic food inside copper pot for long and check di condition of di inside coating.
c-045.principle: Copper oxide dey dissolve for vinegar: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. Verdigris na $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Copper pot wey get tin or stainless steel coating for inside dey safe. For di outside verdigris, rub with 1:1 vinegar and salt paste for 5 minutes and rinse am. If di inside coating don peel, no cook with am.
c-045.actionItem: Today, check di inside coating condition of your copper pot, and if e don peel, no use am for cooking.

c-046.title: Burnt pot wey you soak with boiling baking soda use less energy
c-046.summary: Instead of to rub hard with hot water for long, if you boil am with weak alkaline solution to soften am, burnt stain go loosen with less force. Avoid am for aluminium pot because e go change colour.
c-046.principle: When you heat am, $\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ form sodium carbonate and pH go rise to about 11.
c-046.example: If you put 2 tablespoons baking soda inside 500mL water and boil for 10 minutes on low heat, di burnt stain go loosen. E reduce water and soap and save hot water compared to when you leave tap running and dey rub.
c-046.actionItem: Today, put water and 2 tablespoons baking soda inside burnt pot, boil for 10 minutes, let am cool and scrub.

c-047.title: For cloth wey get blood, use cold water first
c-047.summary: For blood stain, rinse first with cold water of 20℃ or below, no be warm water, before e go comot.
c-047.principle: Proteins like hemoglobin and fibrinogen for blood dey denature and clot when heat touch dem and dem go stick to di fibre. Hydrogen peroxide dey break down when e meet catalase for blood: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: Cotton shirt wey you rinse with 60℃ hot water go make di blood stain turn brown and harden, but if you soak am for 15℃ cold water for 5 minutes and drop few drops of 3% hydrogen peroxide, foam (oxygen) go form and most of am go comot. Use am only for white cloth, and test coloured cloth for hidden place first.
c-047.actionItem: Today if stain happen, use cold water instead of hot and rinse from di back to di front.

c-048.title: Use detergent according to water hardness, only di right amount
c-048.summary: Even if you add detergent pass di recommended amount, cleaning power almost no change, and e only add rinsing water and detergent cost.
c-048.principle: Detergent surfactant no fit lift more dirt once e pass critical micelle concentration (CMC). Calcium ion for hard water dey precipitate soap: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: If you put 80mL for 2kg washing machine wey recommended amount na 40mL, di cleaning effect go be similar but because of leftover detergent you go need one more rinse. If you save 40mL for each of 20 washes a month, you go save 9.6L a year, close to 20,000 won.
c-048.actionItem: Today before you wash, check di mark for detergent cap and measure only di recommended amount.

c-049.title: Ultrafine dust dey form inside di atmosphere
c-049.summary: A big part of PM2.5 dey form from chemical reaction inside di atmosphere, no be from chimney, so for spring high concentration, KF94 mask dey work.
c-049.principle: Sulphur oxides and nitrogen oxides dey react with ammonia to form secondary particles: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: For high ultrafine dust time for Korea, ammonium nitrate and ammonium sulphate fit be nearly half of PM2.5. KF94 dey filter more than 94% of 0.4μm particles, and e must fit your face close to work.
c-049.actionItem: Today if di dust forecast na 'bad', before you go out press di nose clip for your mask so e fit without gap.

c-050.title: Water-repellent coating for car glass na silane film wey dey bounce water
c-050.summary: Water-repellent coating dey form siloxane or fluorine molecule film for glass surface so rain and snow go form drops and roll down. Your view go better and winter driving go safe.
c-050.principle: Di $\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ group for glass dey bond with silane to form $\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$ film, and di hydrophobic chain for outside go raise di contact angle $\theta$ of water drop to about $100^\circ$ or more.
c-050.example: Bare glass get contact angle of about $30^\circ$ so water spread, but coated glass get $100^\circ$ or more, so at 60 to 80km/h wind, di water drops go fly comot. Coating dey usually wear after few months.
c-050.actionItem: This week, wipe di windscreen to remove oil film, apply water-repellent coating thinly and rub am with dry cloth.

c-051.title: Cotton and polyester, why dem dey dry for different speed
c-051.summary: If you choose polyester for sportswear and cotton for underwear and towel, e go easy to manage sweat and moisture.
c-051.principle: Cotton cellulose get plenty -OH groups so e dey form hydrogen bond with water and absorb up to about 25% moisture, but polyester dey hydrophobic because of its ester bonds and e only absorb about 0.4%. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: If you wet di same 100g T-shirt with sweat, cotton go hold di sweat and e go take more than 2 hours to dry, but polyester go dry within about 1 hour. But polyester fit hold smell molecules inside di fibre so you must wash am.
c-051.actionItem: Next time wey you dey buy cloth, check di blend ratio for di label and see whether sportswear get high polyester percentage.

c-052.title: Gas bill dey base on heat, no be volume
c-052.summary: City gas bill dey calculate based on heat, wey be volume used (㎥) multiply by heat conversion factor (MJ/㎥). If you know di heat unit for your bill, e go easy to compare heating use.
c-052.principle: Methane combustion: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. 1 ㎥ of city gas na about $42\ \mathrm{MJ}$.
c-052.example: If monthly gas use na 50 ㎥, e be about $50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$. If you lower di boiler setting temperature and reduce use by 10%, you go save about 210MJ.
c-052.actionItem: Today, find this month usage (㎥) for your gas bill, compare am with last month and write am down.

c-053.title: Remove rust with citric acid
c-053.summary: Red rust for small iron tools go mostly disappear if you soak dem inside citric acid solution.
c-053.principle: Iron(III) oxide dey form chelate with citric acid and dissolve: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, then $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ dey bond with citrate ion.
c-053.example: Dissolve 25g citric acid (5%) inside 500mL water, soak rusty scissors for 4 to 6 hours and scrub with brush, and rust go comot. Never mix am with chlorine cleaner, and after cleaning, dry am immediately and apply thin oil.
c-053.actionItem: Today, soak one small rusty tool inside 5% citric acid and tomorrow dry am and oil am.

c-054.title: Oxygen bleach dey work for warm water
c-054.summary: Sodium percarbonate dey work best for water around 40℃ and e go cheaply restore white laundry.
c-054.principle: Sodium percarbonate dey split inside water into hydrogen peroxide and sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, then $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: If you dissolve 25g sodium percarbonate inside 5L water of 40℃ and soak yellowed white socks for 1 hour, dem go turn white. E cheaper than commercial bleach and no get chlorine smell, and no use am for wool or silk.
c-054.actionItem: Today, soak one load of white laundry with 5g/L sodium percarbonate inside 40℃ water.

c-055.title: For pollen season, wash your nose with saline
c-055.summary: For spring allergy, if you rinse your nose with 0.9% saline, di pollen wey stick to di mucous membrane go wash comot.
c-055.principle: 0.9% NaCl wey get di same osmotic pressure as body fluid (isotonic) no dey swell or shrink mucous cells. Osmotic pressure: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: Dissolve 4.5g salt (0.9%) inside 500mL boiled and cooled water to use, and avoid to use tap water directly. Plain water na hypotonic so e dey sting.
c-055.actionItem: Today after you return home, wash each nostril once with commercial saline spray.

c-056.title: Shoe smell no be from sweat, na bacteria wey chop sweat dey cause am
c-056.summary: Sweat itself almost no get smell, bacteria inside shoe dey break down fat and protein for sweat and make smelly fatty acids. Baking soda dey neutralise dis acidic smell and e dey reduce moisture.
c-056.principle: Short-chain fatty acids (like isovaleric acid) wey dey cause smell dey react with weak base: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: If you put 1 to 2 teaspoons baking soda inside one pair of shoes and leave am overnight, di acidic smell go reduce and moisture go absorb. Next day shake am comot and wear am.
c-056.actionItem: Today when you remove your shoes, sprinkle one spoon baking soda inside and leave am overnight.

c-057.title: Number for bottom of plastic, whether e fit go microwave
c-057.summary: Di recycling number for bottom of container dey help you know whether you fit use am for microwave and hot food.
c-057.principle: PP (number 5) get high melting point of about 160℃ so dem dey use am for microwave, and PS (number 6) foam container dey deform at about 80℃. Polymerisation: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: PP lunch box dey deform little even if you put soup wey pass 100℃, but if you heat hot oily food inside disposable PS cup noodle container, e fit melt. Also check 'microwave safe' mark for di label.
c-057.actionItem: Today, check di bottom number of 3 containers wey you dey use often and remove those wey no be number 5 from microwave.

c-058.title: Vitamins A, D, E, K must be eaten with oil to absorb
c-058.summary: Fat-soluble vitamins no dissolve for water, so dem need fat before dem fit enter micelles inside small intestine and absorb. If you eat carrot or supplement on empty stomach, absorption fit reduce.
c-058.principle: Non-polar molecules dey dissolve and move inside micelles wey bile acid make. If fat no dey, micelle formation go small and absorption rate go drop.
c-058.example: E dey known say beta-carotene absorption go be several times higher for carrot wey you stir-fry with one teaspoon olive oil than raw carrot. E better to take vitamin D supplement during meal too.
c-058.actionItem: Today if you dey take vitamin D or fat-soluble supplement, take am during meal wey get fat.

c-059.title: Use baking soda for tea cup stain
c-059.summary: If you rub baking soda paste for tea or coffee stain inside cup, di mild abrasive and alkaline action go remove am.
c-059.principle: Tannin and polyphenol from tea dey dissolve better for alkaline. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, weak alkaline pH about 8.3
c-059.example: If you mix 1 tablespoon baking soda with 1 teaspoon water and rub am with sponge for 1 minute, even di brown film for 5-year-old cup go mostly comot. You no go need to spend money buy separate cleaner.
c-059.actionItem: Today, clean one mug wey get water scale with baking soda paste.

c-060.title: Coffee grounds no be fertiliser immediately
c-060.summary: You must dry coffee grounds well and mix only small amount, and if you spread plenty, e fit cause mould and stop growth instead.
c-060.principle: Compost dey work best when carbon to nitrogen ratio (C/N) na about 25 to 30:1. Coffee grounds na about 20:1, e rich for nitrogen and caffeine residue fit stop seed from sprouting.
c-060.example: If you mix only 10% or less of di volume of potting soil (100mL grounds for 1L soil) for dry state, e go safe to use. If you spread am thick while wet, mould go form.
c-060.actionItem: Today, spread di coffee grounds wey you drink on newspaper and let dem dry.

c-061.title: If aspirin smell like vinegar
c-061.summary: If aspirin bottle smell like vinegar, e mean say moisture don break am down, so no take am and throw am away.
c-061.principle: Acetylsalicylic acid dey break down when e react with water: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (salicylic acid + acetic acid)
c-061.example: If you keep am for place wey humidity pass 80% like bathroom shelf, hydrolysis go start within few months. Keep am for cool dry drawer with di lid closed, and e good to put one sachet of silica gel together.
c-061.actionItem: Today, move di medicine and supplements wey dey your bathroom to dry drawer.

c-062.title: Waterproof jacket, bring di coating back with heat
c-062.summary: If water drops no dey form beads for your waterproof jacket again, you fit revive di water-repellent coating with low-temperature drying after washing.
c-062.principle: For DWR coating, hydrophobic fluorine and hydrocarbon chains dey stand up for di fibre surface so di surface tension of water dey form beads. Contact angle $\theta>90^\circ$, Young equation: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Detergent residue and dirt dey lay di chains down, so after you wash with neutral detergent, dry am for 20 minutes for medium temperature (about 40 to 60℃) dryer or iron am lightly, den di chains go stand up again and water drops go form beads. If e no work, use water-repellent spray wey dem dey sell.
c-062.actionItem: Today, spray water on your waterproof jacket and check whether beads dey form.

c-063.title: Wetin 20-10-10 for fertilizer bag mean
c-063.summary: Di N-P-K numbers for fertilizer bag na di nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium content (%), so you must choose di ratio wey match di crop.
c-063.principle: Plants dey use nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+) to grow leaves, phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$) to grow roots and flowers, and potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$) to grow stems and fruits. Hydrolysis of urea: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: 1kg of 20-10-10 fertilizer get 200g nitrogen, 100g phosphate and 100g potassium. Fertilizer wey get plenty nitrogen suit leafy vegetables, and fertilizer wey high for phosphorus and potassium suit flowers and fruits. If you pass di amount wey dem write for di label, di roots go burn.
c-063.actionItem: Today, search once for di N-P-K ratio wey match di kind of plant wey you dey grow.

c-064.title: Alkaline and lithium AA, where to use which
c-064.summary: Alkaline batteries good for remote controls, and lithium primary batteries last longer for cold weather or high-current devices.
c-064.principle: Alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. For low temperature, aqueous electrolyte dey slow down, but lithium primary batteries dey work down to -40℃ because dem get non-aqueous electrolyte.
c-064.example: For digital camera, 2 alkaline AA often fit take about 300 pictures and lithium AA about 800 or more. But for low-current things like remote controls and wall clocks, alkaline cheap well so e better.
c-064.actionItem: Today, write down which one between alkaline and lithium suit each of your devices.

c-065.title: Di colour of hydrangea na di soil acidity dey decide am
c-065.summary: Di blue and pink colour of hydrangea depend on di soil pH, so you fit adjust di soil to get di colour wey you want.
c-065.principle: For acidic soil (pH about 5.5 or below), aluminium dey dissolve as $\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$ and e join with anthocyanin to make am blue, but for neutral to alkaline soil e dey precipitate as $\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$ and di flower turn pink: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: If you give pink hydrangea about 3g of aluminium sulfate per 1L of water at one-month intervals, blue colour go increase after few months. For opposite, if you raise di pH to 6.5 or above with lime, e go turn pink. Too much go damage di roots.
c-065.actionItem: Today, put pH test paper for your flower pot soil and decide di hydrangea colour wey you want.

c-066.title: Why wool sweater dey shrink
c-066.summary: Wool sweater dey shrink with hot water and friction, so wash am by hand with lukewarm water and neutral detergent.
c-066.principle: Wool na protein keratin, and di scale-like surface dey tangle by friction, wey be felting. Alkali and heat dey hydrolyze peptide bonds: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: If you wash am with neutral detergent for water below 30℃ by pressing for 2 to 3 minutes, no squeeze am, remove water with towel, and dry am lying flat, e go almost no shrink. Normal cycle for 40℃ washing machine fit shrink am by one size at once and you go throw away expensive sweater.
c-066.actionItem: Today, check di washing symbol for di label of your wool clothes and prepare neutral detergent separately.

c-067.title: Vitamin C no strong against light and air
c-067.summary: Vitamin C supplement must dey kept away from sunlight and moisture, for dark bottle wey dem close di lid well.
c-067.principle: Ascorbic acid dey oxidize wen e meet oxygen: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), and heat and light dey increase di rate.
c-067.example: If you leave powdered vitamin C for open bottle for 25℃ and 70% humidity, e go turn brown within few weeks and di potency go drop. If you keep am for cool place, you fit use di same product steadily until di expiry date.
c-067.actionItem: Today, move your supplements from window or kitchen shelf to cool drawer.

c-068.title: Choose insect repellent DEET or icaridin
c-068.summary: Before outdoor activity, if you use product wey get 20 to 30% DEET or 10 to 20% icaridin, e go protect you for few hours.
c-068.principle: DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) dey confuse di smell receptors of mosquito and make am hard for dem to find person. Di higher di concentration, di longer e last, but di effect dey saturate for one level.
c-068.example: Usually DEET 30% protect for about 6 hours and 10% for about 2 hours, and above 50% di increase in effect small. No spray am directly on di face, pour am for your hand and apply, and no use am for baby wey no reach 2 months.
c-068.actionItem: Today, check di ingredient and concentration for di repellent label and keep am for your outdoor bag.

c-069.title: Stainless steel 304 and 316, how to read di label
c-069.summary: For container wey dem go use near di sea or for salty food, 316 stainless steel wey get molybdenum dey resist corrosion better.
c-069.principle: Stainless steel get about 10.5% or more chromium and e dey form $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ passive film for di surface: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. 316 get 2 to 3% molybdenum added so e dey resist chloride ion (Cl−) corrosion.
c-069.example: 304 (18-8) dey enough for normal kitchen use, but for environment wey get plenty salt, pitting (hole corrosion) dey happen. For di same thermos, even if 316 cost about 20 to 30% more, e last longer for beach use.
c-069.actionItem: Today, look for di 304 or 316 mark for di bottom of di stainless steel products wey you dey use.

c-070.title: Fluoride for toothpaste dey change di tooth surface to harder crystal
c-070.summary: Fluoride ions dey change di hydroxyapatite for tooth enamel to fluorapatite, wey dey resist acid better. If you no rinse plenty with water after brushing, di fluoride go stay longer.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. Fluorapatite dey start to dissolve for about pH 4.5, so e dey resist acid better than hydroxyapatite (about pH 5.5).
c-070.example: If you use toothpaste wey get 1000 to 1500ppm fluoride di size of pea, and rinse only once lightly with water immediately after brushing, you fit keep di fluoride residue effect.
c-070.actionItem: Tonight after you brush, no rinse your mouth plenty times, rinse only once lightly.

c-071.title: Why aluminium pot dey turn black
c-071.summary: If you leave acidic food for aluminium pot for long time, e go dull, so use another container to store am.
c-071.principle: Di $\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ film for aluminium surface dey dissolve for acid: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. E dey also get damaged by alkaline detergent so be careful.
c-071.example: If you leave tomato sauce (pH about 4.5) for aluminium pot for one day, di surface go discolour and e fit taste like metal. For di discolouration, if you put 2 tablespoons of citric acid or cream of tartar for 1L of water and boil for 10 minutes, most of am go come off.
c-071.actionItem: Today, no leave remaining soup and sauce inside di pot, move dem to glass or stainless steel container.

c-072.title: Di truth about di yellow stain for armpit
c-072.summary: Di yellow stain for di armpit of white shirt na from sweat and di aluminium for deodorant, so oxygen bleach dey work well.
c-072.principle: Protein and fatty acids for sweat dey combine with aluminium salt to form insoluble precipitate, and oxygen bleach dey oxidize di organic parts: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: If you mix 1 tablespoon of sodium percarbonate with 1 cup of 40℃ water to thick paste, leave am on di stain for 30 minutes and den wash am, di colour go come off well. Chlorine bleach fit even make protein stain turn yellow.
c-072.actionItem: Today, apply oxygen bleach paste beforehand to di armpit of di white shirt wey you wear.

c-073.title: Di smell of new furniture na formaldehyde signal
c-073.summary: Di smell of new furniture or wallpaper na because of volatile organic compounds (VOC), so open windows for few days to let am go out.
c-073.principle: Wen urea resin for plywood adhesive dey break down, formaldehyde dey release: $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Di release amount dey increase as temperature and humidity dey rise.
c-073.example: If you ventilate 3 times a day for 30 minutes during di first 2 weeks after you bring new furniture and add bake-out wey you raise di room to 25 to 30℃, di concentration go drop well. Di recommended indoor formaldehyde standard na 0.1ppm or below.
c-073.actionItem: Today, ventilate 3 times a day for 10 minutes or more with cross ventilation.

c-074.title: Water for trip place, boiling and using water purification tablet
c-074.summary: If you boil unsafe water for 1 minute or more or disinfect am with chlorine purification tablet, you fit kill most pathogens.
c-074.principle: Chlorine-based purification tablet dey make hypochlorous acid for water wey dey oxidize microorganisms: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Put 1 tablet inside 1L of clear water and leave am for 30 minutes (longer if na to guard against Cryptosporidium). Dem must first filter cloudy water with cloth, and if you pass 2,000m above sea level, increase di boiling time to 3 minutes.
c-074.actionItem: Today, pack one water purification tablet or portable filter inside your travel bag.

c-075.title: Fleece laundry bag, reduce microplastics
c-075.summary: If you put synthetic fibre clothes inside laundry bag and wash with cold water, you fit reduce microfibre release well.
c-075.principle: Polyester na ester polymer wey no dey break down and e dey break into pieces by friction: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: One wash of one fleece jacket dey release thousands to hundreds of thousands of microfibres. If you use laundry bag and filter, e go catch plenty of dem and reduce di amount wey enter river, and washing with low temperature dey save energy too.
c-075.actionItem: Today, zip your fleece and polyester clothes, put dem inside laundry bag and wash dem with cold water.

c-076.title: For rechargeable batteries, choose low self-discharge nickel-metal hydride
c-076.summary: Normal nickel-metal hydride rechargeable batteries dey self-discharge about 20% a month even if you no use dem. Low self-discharge type still get 70 to 85% after one year, so dem good for remote controls and clocks.
c-076.principle: Nickel-metal hydride battery reaction: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Self-discharge dey happen as hydrogen dey slowly move between di electrolyte and di electrodes.
c-076.example: If you use one low self-discharge AA rechargeable battery (about 2000 mAh) and charge am 500 times, e fit replace hundreds of disposable alkaline batteries, so di long-term cost go drop well.
c-076.actionItem: Today, if you get batteries wey you use for remote control or clock, make plan to change dem to low self-discharge rechargeable batteries.

c-077.title: Remove ballpoint pen ink stain with alcohol, no be water
c-077.summary: Ballpoint pen ink na oil-based ink wey dye dissolve inside organic solvent, so e almost no dey spread for water. If you dab am with cloth wey get disinfecting ethanol, di dye go dissolve and come out.
c-077.principle: Substances wey get similar polarity dey mix well. Oil-based dye dey dissolve far worse for water ($\varepsilon \approx 80$) than for ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 25$).
c-077.example: If you put dry paper towel under di stain and dab from outside to inside with cotton bud wey get 70% ethanol, di ink go move to di towel without spreading. Test am first for small area.
c-077.actionItem: Today, if ballpoint pen mark dey for clothes or furniture, test alcohol first for place wey no dey show.

c-078.title: Wilted vegetables fit come back to life if you soak dem for cold water
c-078.summary: Wilted lettuce and spinach dey limp because di water inside di cells don reduce. If you soak dem for cold water for 20 to 30 minutes, water go enter again by osmosis and dem go crisp, so you go throw less.
