c-078.principle: If di solute concentration inside di cell higher than di water outside, water dey move inside. Osmotic pressure $\Pi = iMRT$ dey create turgor pressure wey dey swell di cell.
c-078.example: If you soak one handful of lettuce wey wilt after one day for cold water for 30 minutes, di weight go increase by 5 to 10% and di crispness go return. But leaves wey don soft or spoil no apply.
c-078.actionItem: Today, soak wilted leafy vegetables for your fridge for cold water for 30 minutes, shake off di water and eat am.

c-079.title: To reduce house dust mite allergen, wash with water wey pass 60℃
c-079.summary: Mites and allergen proteins for bedding no dey reduce well with cold water wash. For hot water around 60℃, di proteins dey denature so di mites die and di allergen reduce.
c-079.principle: Heat dey unfold di tertiary structure of protein and make enzyme and allergen lose function (thermal denaturation). Usually for 55 to 60℃, mites dey die within few minutes.
c-079.example: If you wash bed sheets and pillowcases for 60℃, allergen go reduce well, but 30℃ wash get small effect. If di fabric label no allow am, you fit replace am with high-temperature dryer drying.
c-079.actionItem: Today, check di washing label of your pillowcase or bed sheet and wash am with di hottest cycle wey dem allow.

c-080.title: Camping gas, butane no dey come out for winter
c-080.summary: Isobutane can dey get weak flame near freezing point, so for late winter camping, use gas wey get propane mixed.
c-080.principle: Liquefied gas no dey vaporize below im boiling point. Butane about $-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Combustion: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: Below 0℃, butane can pressure dey low so di flame go weak and di time to boil water fit double. Keep di can inside sleeping bag or near your body to make am warm, and if you use am inside tent, CO poisoning risk dey so ventilate.
c-080.actionItem: Today, check di ingredient label (butane and propane ratio) of your camping gas can.

c-081.title: Read sunscreen ingredients
c-081.summary: Before spring ultraviolet rays rise, know di difference between inorganic filter (zinc oxide) and organic filter before you choose.
c-081.principle: Zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) dey reflect and scatter UV, and organic filters like avobenzone dey absorb am and release am as heat: $h\nu + \text{filter} \to \text{filter}^* \to \text{heat}$
c-081.example: SPF 50 dey block about 98% of UVB and SPF 30 about 97%, so di difference small. For di face, you need about 0.5g (two lines di length of index and middle fingers) and reapply every 2 to 3 hours.
c-081.actionItem: Today before you go out, squeeze sunscreen di length of two fingers and apply am.

c-082.title: If you drain di water from food waste, di smell and volume go reduce
c-082.summary: Di bad smell of food waste na gas like hydrogen sulfide wey microorganisms dey release as dem dey break down protein. If you squeeze out di water first before you throw am, microbial growth go slow so di smell go reduce and di weight go reduce too.
c-082.principle: Breakdown of sulfur amino acids for protein: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Di lower di water activity $a_w$, di slower di microbial growth rate.
c-082.example: 70 to 80% of food waste na water. If you squeeze am well and reduce di moisture by only 20%, di weight go reduce by about 15% so disposal cost and bad smell go reduce together.
c-082.actionItem: Today before you throw food waste, put am inside sieve and squeeze out di water well.

c-083.title: Expiry date dey set by di temperature dependence of reaction rate
c-083.summary: If temperature rise by 10℃, spoilage reactions for food dey roughly double in speed. So you must follow di storage temperature wey dem write before expiry date and consume-by date go get meaning.
c-083.principle: Arrhenius equation: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. For spoilage reaction wey get normal activation energy, di rate dey become about 2 to 3 times for every 10℃ rise.
c-083.example: If milk for 4℃ fridge fit last 7 days, for 14℃ e fit spoil within about 3 to 4 days. E better to put am inside di fridge, no be for di door shelf (where temperature dey vary well).
c-083.actionItem: Today, check your fridge temperature to see whether e dey within 0 to 4℃.

c-084.title: No be sodium percarbonate, use washing soda for grease
c-084.summary: For old grease for kitchen exhaust fan and gas cooker, washing soda (sodium carbonate), wey get stronger alkali than baking soda, dey clean am well.
c-084.principle: Oil (triglyceride) dey saponify for alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. Washing soda $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ get pH about 11.
c-084.example: If you dissolve 1 tablespoon of washing soda for 1L of hot water, soak for 10 minutes and den wipe, di old grease go loosen. E dey irritate di skin so wear rubber gloves, and no use am for aluminium or coated pan.
c-084.actionItem: Today, soak one cooker hood filter inside washing soda solution.

c-085.title: Ultrafine dust wey dey come out during frying
c-085.summary: Frying and grilling dey raise indoor PM2.5 well, so turn on di hood and open window while you dey cook.
c-085.principle: If oil heat pass about 180℃, e dey thermally break down and form particles and acrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (glycerol dehydration)
c-085.example: Measurements dey show say indoor PM2.5 fit rise to hundreds of μg/m³ wen you grill mackerel for pan, and e dey reduce well if you turn on di hood. Keep di hood on for 10 more minutes after cooking.
c-085.actionItem: Today, turn on di hood first before you start to cook and leave am for 10 minutes after cooking.

c-086.title: After beach trip, rinse bicycle and car
c-086.summary: Salt for sea breeze dey corrode metal quick, so after beach trip, rinse your car and bicycle with plain water.
c-086.principle: Sodium chloride solution become electrolyte and e dey form corrosion cell for iron: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: For humid environment wey get salt, iron dey corrode several times faster than for dry place. If you wash di underside and chain with water within 24 hours after coastal driving and apply chain oil, you go prevent rust well.
c-086.actionItem: If you don return from di beach, today rinse di underside of di car and di bicycle chain with water.

c-087.title: How to wash off pesticide, water first then baking soda
c-087.summary: For fruits and vegetables, running water na di basic, and studies dey show say if you soak am for baking soda water for 12 minutes, some surface pesticides go reduce more.
c-087.principle: Some pesticides (like thiabendazole) dey break down easily for weak alkali. 1% baking soda ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) solution get pH about 8.1.
c-087.example: For experiment wey dem soak apples for 1% baking soda solution (10g per 1L of water) for 12 minutes, di surface pesticide residue reduce more than water washing. For fruits wey dem dey eat with skin, rinse dem again with running water after you soak.
c-087.actionItem: Today, soak apple or grapes for 10g/L baking soda water and rinse am to try am.

c-088.title: Bird droppings and insect marks na protein, so soak dem quick before you wipe
c-088.summary: Bird droppings and insect fluids get acidic substances and protein, so if dem dry, dem dey stick to di paint surface and spread. If you soak dem well with wet cloth and wipe gently, paint damage go small.
c-088.principle: Wen protein dry, dem dey tangle and harden and form hydrogen bonds with di surface. Water and weak alkaline detergent (pH 8 to 9) dey break dis bond.
c-088.example: Bird droppings wey dem leave for more than one day fit damage di paint surface noticeably within 1 to 2 days, so e safer to put wet microfibre towel on top for 5 minutes before you wipe am off.
c-088.actionItem: Today, if you see dry bird droppings for your car or window, put wet cloth on top for 5 minutes to soak am before you wipe am off.

c-089.title: Baking powder and baking soda na different ingredients
c-089.summary: Baking soda na only sodium bicarbonate so e need acid before e go rise, and baking powder already get acidic component inside so e dey rise even if e meet water. If you swap dem, di taste fit bitter or e no go rise well.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. 1 teaspoon (about 5g) of baking soda fit release nearly about 1L of carbon dioxide.
c-089.example: If di recipe get 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda and yogurt (acid), di acid go make di soda react. If you put only soda for batter wey no get acid, di soda wey no react go leave bitter soapy taste.
c-089.actionItem: Today, check di labels of baking soda and baking powder for your kitchen shelf and keep dem separate for different containers.

c-090.title: Apple and banana must dey kept separately
c-090.summary: Ethylene gas wey apple dey release dey make banana ripen quick, so keep fruits away from each other.
c-090.principle: Ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ na plant hormone wey dey activate cell wall-degrading enzymes to speed up ripening. Production: di release of $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$ dey increase sharply wen fruit dey ripen.
c-090.example: If you put unripe banana inside di same bag as apple, e go ripen one or two days faster so you fit use am on purpose. For opposite, if you wan keep am long, put apple separately and di storage time go increase by one or two days so food waste go reduce.
c-090.actionItem: Today, separate apple and banana inside different compartment or container.

c-091.title: Tannin for tea and coffee dey block iron supplement absorption
c-091.summary: Tannin and polyphenols for tea and coffee dey combine with iron ions to form complex wey hard to absorb. E better to keep at least 1 to 2 hours gap from iron supplement or meal wey get plenty iron.
c-091.principle: Tannin dey form chelate with iron: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Dis complex hard to absorb for di gut.
c-091.example: Dem dey report say tea wey you drink with meal fit reduce non-heme iron absorption by 40 to 60%. If you drink am 1 hour after di meal, di effect dey far less.
c-091.actionItem: Today, if you take iron supplement or you eat meal wey get spinach or beans, delay tea or coffee by one hour.

c-092.title: You fit reduce tears wen you dey cut onion by refrigerating am
c-092.summary: Wen you cut onion, di cells dey burst and enzyme dey make gas wey dey irritate di eyes. If you refrigerate di onion for 30 minutes, di enzyme reaction go slow and tears go reduce.
c-092.principle: Alliinase dey change sulfoxides to irritant substance: propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) dey irritate di nerves for di eyes to make tears. Di rate of enzyme reaction dey lower in proportion to temperature.
c-092.example: For onion wey you chill to 4℃ for 30 minutes, di rate wey irritant dey form reduce to about half or less compared with room temperature (25℃) onion. Di root side get plenty enzyme so cut am last.
c-092.actionItem: Today, put onion inside di fridge 30 minutes before you use am.

c-093.title: Wrinkles for clothes na hydrogen bonds wey settle for new position
c-093.summary: Fibres like cotton, wen dem receive water and heat, di hydrogen bonds between di molecular chains dey loosen and den harden for new shape as e cool. If you release am with steam and heat and flatten am before e cool, di wrinkles go straighten.
c-093.principle: Di $\mathrm{{-}OH}$ groups for cellulose chains dey form hydrogen bonds with each other. Moisture and heat dey break dis bonds, and as e dey cool, dem dey bond again for di flattened shape.
c-093.example: Di suitable iron temperature na about 200℃ for cotton and 110℃ or below for synthetic fibre. If you hang clothes for bathroom after hot shower, light wrinkles fit straighten by demsef with moisture and heat.
c-093.actionItem: Today, check di washing label of di shirt wey you go wear and straighten di wrinkles with steam according to di allowed temperature.

c-094.title: For yellow dust and fine dust day, wash face with surfactant for 30 seconds
c-094.summary: Fine dust dey stick to di oil (sebum) for skin so water alone no dey remove am well. Di key na to wash di oil and dust together with foam cleanser.
c-094.principle: Surfactant get tail wey like oil and head wey like water, so above critical micelle concentration, e dey trap sebum and dust inside micelles so water go wash dem away. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{sebum + dust trapped inside})$
c-094.example: If you rub foam cleanser with lukewarm water of 30 to 35°C for 30 seconds and rinse, most of di dust for di face go comot. Di skin surface pH na about 4.7 to 5.5 so weakly acidic (pH 5 to 6) product good.
c-094.actionItem: Today after you go out, make plenty foam with lukewarm water and wash your face gently for 30 seconds (avoid hot water).

c-095.title: Dry air inside plane need moisturizing and water intake
c-095.summary: Relative humidity for plane cabin dey usually 10 to 20%, wey be desert level, so moisture for skin and nose lining dey comot quick. E dey help to use moisturizer and drink one cup of water often.
c-095.principle: Relative humidity $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. For cabin, dem dey heat outside air bring am in, so di saturation vapour pressure high and di actual vapour pressure low so $RH$ low.
c-095.example: Normal indoor humidity na 40 to 60%, but for 10 to 20% inside di cabin, water loss dey 2 to 3 times faster. During long flight, e dey recommended to drink about 100 to 200mL of water every hour.
c-095.actionItem: For your next flight, carry moisturizing cream inside container wey no pass 100mL.

c-096.title: Blanch spring greens in boiling water for only 30 seconds
c-096.summary: If you blanch am short, di enzymes go stop so di colour go bright and di bitter taste and grassy smell go reduce. If you boil am long, di chlorophyll go change and e go turn yellowish olive colour.
c-096.principle: Heat dey remove air for di tissue and e dey deactivate discolouring enzymes. For heat and acid, wen di magnesium for chlorophyll replace with hydrogen ions, e become brown pheophytin. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: If you put 10g salt (1%) for 1L of boiling water, blanch 100g of spinach for 30 seconds and rinse am for cold water, di green colour go stay. If you boil am for more than 5 minutes, e go turn olive colour.
c-096.actionItem: Today if you buy spring greens, blanch dem for 30 seconds for 1% salt boiling water and cool dem straight for cold water.

c-097.title: Firewood must dry to 20% moisture or below before e give good heat
c-097.summary: Wet firewood dey use heat first to evaporate water before e burn, so e get plenty smoke and less heat. Firewood wey dem protect from rain and dry for 6 months or more dey efficient.
c-097.principle: Di heat of evaporation of water na $\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. From di combustion heat of firewood (about $18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ dry basis), heat dey lost equal to di moisture.
c-097.example: Green wood wey get 40% moisture get about 30% or more less usable heat than dry firewood (15 to 20%) and e dey produce plenty soot too. Split di firewood open to check whether di centre dry.
c-097.actionItem: Today, if you get firewood wey you go use outdoors, stack am for place wey get airflow where rain no fit reach.

c-098.title: Brew green tea with 70 to 80℃ water so e no go too bitter
c-098.summary: Catechins for green tea dey dissolve plenty for high temperature to make am bitter and astringent, and di umami amino acid theanine dey come out well even for low temperature. Water wey you cool to 70 to 80℃ get good balance.
c-098.principle: Solubility usually dey increase with temperature. Di catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) dey extract quick above 80℃ and di astringency go increase.
c-098.example: Tea wey you brew with 90℃ water for 3 minutes get noticeably more catechin extracted than tea wey you brew with 70℃ water so e go taste more bitter. If you pour boiled water from one cup to another once, e go drop about 10℃.
c-098.actionItem: Today wen you dey brew green tea, pour boiled water into cup once to cool am and den brew for 2 minutes.

c-099.title: Glacial acetic acid no be vinegar, na 99% acetic acid
c-099.summary: Vinegar na 4 to 8% aqueous solution of acetic acid, but glacial acetic acid na about 99% pure acetic acid wey fit burn di skin and eyes. If you wan use am for food, check say e get food-grade mark and dilute am well.
c-099.principle: Vinegar: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ about $0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4 to 5%). Glacial acetic acid na about $17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ so e strong pass 20 times or more. Pure acetic acid dey freeze like ice below 16.6℃ so dem dey call am glacial acetic acid.
c-099.example: For recipe wey use normal 5% vinegar, if you use di same amount of 99% glacial acetic acid, about 20 times stronger acid go enter. If di label no get food dilution method, e safer no to buy am.
c-099.actionItem: Today, check di acidity (%) and ingredients for di vinegar label for your house.

c-100.title: Alcohol dey change to acetaldehyde for di liver and dey cause hangover
c-100.summary: Alcohol dey break down to acetaldehyde for di liver, and until dis one change again to acetic acid, e dey cause headache and nausea. Even if you drink water, di breakdown speed for di liver no go increase.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. Normal adult liver only dey break down about $7\ \mathrm{g}$ of pure alcohol per hour.
c-100.example: For di liver to break down one bottle of soju (about 360mL, about 50g of alcohol), e go take more than 7 hours. Water just dey reduce dehydration and e no dey make di breakdown speed faster.
c-100.actionItem: Today if you get drinking party, take one glass of water with am and decide di amount wey you go drink.

c-101.title: Campfire must dey put out completely with water
c-101.summary: For fire to happen, e need three things: fuel, oxygen and heat, and if you remove even one, e go go off. Pour enough water on di firewood, stir am, and check until di ash cold so you go prevent re-ignition.
c-101.principle: Among di three elements of combustion, water dey put out fire by taking heat. Di heat of evaporation of water $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ dey absorb plenty of di heat of di embers.
c-101.example: One lump of charcoal (about 100g) dey give out few MJ of heat, and if you pour 1L of water, e fit absorb up to about 2.3MJ as heat of evaporation. Put di back of your hand near am and keep pouring until you no feel heat.
c-101.actionItem: Wen you dey use fire outdoors, fetch one bucket of water beforehand before you tidy up.

c-102.title: Sodium for nutrition facts × 2.54 = amount of salt
c-102.summary: Di sodium figure no be salt (sodium chloride), na di mass of sodium ion. If you convert am to salt amount, di daily intake go feel more real.
c-102.principle: If you divide di molar mass of NaCl 58.44g/mol by Na 22.99g/mol, e be about 2.54, so if you multiply sodium by 2.54 you get di amount of salt. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: One pack of instant noodles wey get 1,800mg sodium equal to about 4.6g of salt, wey take most of di WHO recommended daily salt below 5g (sodium 2,000mg).
c-102.actionItem: Today, multiply di sodium mg of one processed food for your house by 2.54 to convert am to salt g.

c-103.title: You fit turn off di fire and finish noodles with residual heat
c-103.summary: After you boil noodles for 2 to 3 minutes for boiling water, even if you turn off di fire and cover di lid, di starch go still dey cook. Na way to reduce gas use.
c-103.principle: Starch gelatinization dey start from about 60 to 70℃ and e dey continue as long as di water temperature stay above 90℃. Di higher di temperature, di faster di reaction rate.
c-103.example: Water for pot wey get lid dey drop only about 5 to 8℃ within 5 minutes after you turn off di fire, so di gelatinization of di noodle starch go continue. You fit reduce gas use time by 3 to 4 minutes.
c-103.actionItem: Today wen you dey boil pasta or noodles, turn off di fire after 2/3 of di time wey dem write for di package and cover di lid.

c-104.title: For flower vase water, small sugar and vinegar dey make fresh flowers last longer
c-104.summary: Even cut flowers dey breathe and burn sugar. If you give dem weak sugar and acidity, you fit supply nutrition and reduce bacteria for di water.
c-104.principle: Cut flowers dey use glucose as energy by respiration, and weakly acidic water (pH about 3.5 to 4) dey slow down di blocking of di xylem by bacterial growth. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: If you mix 10g of sugar (1%) and 5mL of vinegar for 1L of water, di pH go be about 3.7, and if you change di water every 2 days, e usually last few more days.
c-104.actionItem: Today, change di vase water to 1L of clean water wey get 10g of sugar and 5mL of vinegar and cut di stem end for slant.

c-105.title: Wipe sticker residue with cooking oil
c-105.summary: Di sticky mark wey remain after you remove label no dey comot with water but e dey dissolve with oil. Most cases fit solve without strong solvent.
c-105.principle: Adhesive na non-polar polymer so e no dey dissolve for polar water, and e dey mix well with non-polar oil (like dissolves like). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{like dissolves like}$
c-105.example: If you put few drops of cooking oil on di mark, wait 5 minutes, wipe am, and den remove di oiliness with dish soap, most label marks for glass and ceramic go comot.
c-105.actionItem: Today, put cooking oil on di sticky mark for bottle or plate, wait 5 minutes and wipe am off (acetone fit damage plastic).

c-106.title: Nuts dey go rancid easily because di unsaturated fat dey oxidize
c-106.summary: Unsaturated fatty acids for nuts and sesame oil dey oxidize wen dem meet air and dey give stale smell. If you seal and freeze dem, rancidity go delay by few months.
c-106.principle: Lipid autoxidation: e start with $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$ and aldehydes dey form to give smell. Di reaction rate dey roughly halve for every 10℃ drop for temperature.
c-106.example: For room temperature (25℃), walnuts dey start to taste rancid within few weeks to few months, but if you seal dem and freeze for -18℃, 6 to 12 months dey possible. If bitter taste or stale smell dey, throw am away.
c-106.actionItem: Today, put di remaining nuts inside zip bag or airtight container and put dem inside freezer.

c-107.title: You fit reduce di itching of mosquito bite with heat
c-107.summary: Wen mosquito saliva enter di body, immune reaction dey release histamine wey dey cause swelling and itching. If you hold about 50℃ heat for few seconds, di protein inside di saliva go denature and di itch signal go reduce.
c-107.principle: Histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ dey stimulate nerve endings, and heat dey unfold di tertiary structure of saliva protein to reduce di reaction (thermal denaturation).
c-107.example: Reports dey say if you hold about 50℃ heat patch for about 10 seconds, di itching go reduce for few hours. To prevent burns, no hold hot object directly on di skin for long.
c-107.actionItem: For dis trip, carry anti-itch ointment or cooling gel for wen mosquito bite you.

c-108.title: Potassium sorbate for food label na preservative wey dey stop mould
c-108.summary: Potassium sorbate na preservative wey dey stop mould and yeast for acidic environment and dem dey use am for cheese, drinks and bread. E dey considered safe within di allowed limit, but sensitive people fit check di ingredient.
c-108.principle: Sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$): di lower di pH, di more di undissociated form wey go pass di cell membrane to work.
c-108.example: For pH 4.8, about 50% of sorbic acid na effective undissociated form, but for pH 6.8 only about 1%. Na why e dey work better for acidic foods.
c-108.actionItem: Today, look for preservative marking for di ingredient names of two foods wey you dey eat often.

c-109.title: Used batteries no be general waste, throw dem inside collection box
c-109.summary: Batteries get metals like zinc, manganese and nickel, so if dem bury dem as general waste, dem fit seep into di soil. If you gather dem for used battery collection box, dem fit recover di metals again.
c-109.principle: Reaction of alkaline battery: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. If dem recover dis metals, dem become new resources.
c-109.example: One AA battery na about 23g and about 20% or more of am na metals like zinc and manganese. If you gather 100, dem fit recycle plenty metal from about 2.3kg of batteries.
c-109.actionItem: Today, gather di used batteries for your house inside one container and carry dem go di collection box for your area.

c-110.title: Revive hardened brown sugar with one slice of bread
c-110.summary: Brown sugar dey harden because di water inside di molasses don evaporate and di crystals dey stick together. If you seal am with one slice of bread or wet kitchen towel, di moisture go return and e go soften.
c-110.principle: Sugar dey absorb moisture so e dey pull in water vapour $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$ and di molasses film for di surface go soften again. Equilibrium dey set between di vapour pressure for di air and di sugar surface.
c-110.example: If you put 1 slice of bread inside 500g of hardened brown sugar and seal am, e dey usually soften within one day. If you dey rush, cover am with wet paper towel and microwave for 20 seconds to loosen am.
c-110.actionItem: Today, if you get hardened sugar, put am inside airtight container with one slice of bread.

c-111.title: If you soak kelp for cold water for long, di umami go come out well
c-111.summary: Glutamic acid for kelp dey come out slowly even for cold water, and if you boil am hard, slime go come out and di broth go cloudy and sticky. If you soak am for cold water for 30 minutes or more and remove am just before e boil, di broth go clear.
c-111.principle: Glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ dey dissolve for water, and slimy polysaccharides like alginic acid dey dissolve plenty if you boil am for long.
c-111.example: If you put two 10cm pieces of kelp for 1L of water for 30 minutes and remove dem as di water start to boil (about 90℃), di umami go come out enough. Di kelp wey you remove fit recycle for braised dishes.
c-111.actionItem: Tonight wen you dey make broth, soak kelp for cold water for 30 minutes before you boil am.

c-112.title: You fit know if you drink enough water from di colour of your urine
c-112.summary: Di yellow colour of urine na because of pigment wey dem dey call urochrome and e dey get darker if water low. If e na light yellow, e usually mean say you dey drink enough.
c-112.principle: For concentration $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$, if water intake reduce and $V$ become small, di same amount of urochrome $n$ go look darker.
c-112.example: If di daily urine volume na about 1.5L and di colour na light straw, e usually dey enough. Dark amber na signal to drink more water, but di colour fit change if you dey take B vitamins or medicine.
c-112.actionItem: Today, check di colour of your urine once and if e dark, drink one cup of water.

c-113.title: Petrol grade na octane rating and you just need to use di one wey match di car
c-113.summary: Octane rating na di number wey show how well di fuel resist knocking, wey be self-explosion wen fuel dey compress. If di car manual get recommended grade, putting expensive fuel wey high pass am no get effect.
c-113.principle: Octane rating na di value wey dem compare knock resistance for di standard where isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) na 100 and heptane na 0.
c-113.example: If di car manual recommend octane 91 (regular) and you put 94 (premium), e only cost few hundred won more per litre and di efficiency almost no rise. Use premium only wen di car need am, like high-compression engines.
c-113.actionItem: Today, check di recommended octane rating for di car manual or di label inside di fuel filler flap.

c-114.title: Dem dey write full ingredients of cosmetics from di highest content to di lowest
c-114.summary: For full ingredients for cosmetics label, dem dey write ingredients wey be 1% or more in order of quantity, and ingredients wey be below 1% for any order. Di first few ingredients make up most of di product, so if di advertised ingredient dey behind, di amount small.
c-114.principle: For most products, water ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) dey come first. If di concentration $w = \dfrac{m_{\text{component}}}{m_{\text{total}}} \times 100\%$ be below 1%, dem allow am to write for any order.
c-114.example: If di full ingredients of toner na water, glycerin, butylene glycol in dat order, di first three ingredients fit be 90% or more of di product. If di advertised ingredient dey for di very back, e usually be below 1%.
c-114.actionItem: Today, read di first five ingredients for di full ingredient list of one cosmetic wey you dey use.

c-115.title: For camping food, make am pass di 4 to 60℃ zone quick
c-115.summary: Bacteria dey multiply fast for roughly 4 to 60℃ and dem dey call am danger temperature zone. For camping, keep meat and egg dishes for ice box below 4℃ and wen you dey cook am, heat am well reach di centre.
c-115.principle: Di number of bacteria dey increase as $N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. E. coli fit double about every 20 minutes near 37℃.
c-115.example: For food wey you leave for 2 hours for midsummer room temperature (30℃), bacteria fit become about $2^{6} = 64$ times. Cook meat for 1 minute or more wey di core temperature reach 75℃ or above.
c-115.actionItem: For dis camping, fill di ice box with ice and carry thermometer along.

c-116.title: Even if you put salt inside noodle water, di boiling point almost no go rise
c-116.summary: Na misunderstanding say salt dey make water hotter. To save gas, lid and low fire dey work better than salt.
c-116.principle: Di more dissolved particles dey, di higher di boiling point rise ('boiling point elevation'), but di value na very small. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Even if you put 10g of salt inside 1L of water, di boiling point go only rise by about 0.17°C so di cooking time stay di same and only di seasoning dey set.
c-116.actionItem: Today wen you dey boil noodles, use salt only for seasoning, and wen e boil, cover di lid and reduce to low fire.

c-117.title: For grass stain, alcohol first, den enzyme detergent
c-117.summary: Grass stain get chlorophyll (oily component) and protein mixed, so water alone no fit remove am. Even if you just follow di treatment order, e go clean well.
c-117.principle: Chlorophyll dey dissolve for ethanol, and protein stain dey break into peptides by protease for enzyme detergent. Hot water dey harden protein and make am fix instead. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: If you soak di stain with 70% ethanol for 5 minutes and den wash am with enzyme detergent for 30 to 40°C water, di grass stain go fade well.
c-117.actionItem: Today, put disinfecting ethanol on di grass stain for 5 minutes and wash am for 30 to 40°C (check colour change first for place wey no show).

c-118.title: If you eat spinach iron with lemon, absorption dey increase
c-118.summary: Plant iron (non-heme iron) no dey absorb well but vitamin C dey change am to form wey fit absorb. For opposite, tannin for tea and coffee dey block absorption.
c-118.principle: Non-heme iron mostly dey exist as $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ but na only $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ dey absorb for di gut, and vitamin C dey reduce ferric iron to ferrous iron and form chelate with iron. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: If you add about 100mg of vitamin C (di amount for one lemon) to di meal, non-heme iron absorption fit increase by about 2 to 3 times.
c-118.actionItem: Today, squeeze lemon juice on your spinach or bean dish, and drink tea or coffee 1 hour after di meal.

c-119.title: Use salt ice to cool drinks quick outdoors
c-119.summary: If you mix salt with ice, di temperature go drop far below 0°C and drinks go cool within few minutes. For picnic you fit use am instead of fridge.
c-119.principle: Because of freezing point depression, di water wey salt don dissolve for dey freeze only for temperature below 0°C, so as di ice dey melt, e dey take heat from di surroundings and di temperature dey drop (eutectic point -21°C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
c-119.example: If you mix ice and salt for mass ratio 3:1, di temperature go drop to about -15 to -20°C, and if you put can inside and roll am, e go cool to around 5°C within few minutes.
c-119.actionItem: Today for picnic, mix 3 parts ice to 1 part salt for di ice box and roll di drink can for 3 to 5 minutes (check say di can no freeze and burst).

c-120.title: Even if meat brown, e no mean say e don spoil immediately
c-120.summary: Di colour of meat dey depend on di state of iron for myoglobin and e no always match freshness. Check di date and smell together.
c-120.principle: Oxymyoglobin wey combine with oxygen na bright red, and if di iron oxidize e become brown metmyoglobin. Inside vacuum or tight packaging, oxygen low so e be dark purple. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (red),  $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (brown)
c-120.example: Minced beef dey turn bright red within 15 to 30 minutes wen e touch air, and after few days for fridge e fit turn brown, but colour alone no dey enough to judge say e don spoil.
c-120.actionItem: Today wen you dey buy meat, check not only di colour but also di consume-by date, di packaging condition, and whether sour smell or stickiness dey.

c-121.title: If you cut garlic and wait 10 minutes before you cook am, allicin go come alive
c-121.summary: Wen you cut or crush garlic, di enzyme alliinase dey change alliin to allicin, and dis allicin na di basis of garlic antibacterial and health components. If you heat am immediately, di enzyme go stop and less allicin go form.
c-121.principle: Alliin $\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$ allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). Di enzyme dey denature quick above about 60 to 70℃.
c-121.example: Reports dey say if you leave minced garlic for 10 minutes before you cook am, e go keep several times more allicin-derived components than if you cook am immediately. Limit di amount wey you go eat at once to about 1 to 2 cloves.
c-121.actionItem: Today if you use garlic for cooking, cut am and leave am for 10 minutes before you heat am.

c-122.title: If you filter frying oil and keep am for dark place, you fit use am longer
c-122.summary: Oil dey go rancid wen e touch heat, light and oxygen and e dey get bad smell. Even if you just store am well, you no go waste oil.
c-122.principle: Unsaturated fatty acids dey oxidize by radical chain reaction to form peroxides and aldehydes. Heating and food debris dey speed up di reaction. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Cooking oil wey get high unsaturation make you use am within about 3 months after you open am, and for frying oil, e good to filter out di debris and use am only 2 to 3 times.
c-122.actionItem: Today, filter di frying oil wey you use with coffee filter, put am for dark bottle and keep am for cool place, and if e smell like paint, throw am away.

c-123.title: Even stainless steel go rust if you leave salty soup for long
c-123.summary: Stainless steel no dey rust because of thin chromium oxide film, but if chloride ions pass through dis film, small holes and rust spots go form.
c-123.principle: If chromium pass 10.5%, $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ film go form for di surface and e dey repair itself if oxygen dey, but $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ dey destroy di film for some spots and cause pitting corrosion. $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: 316 wey get 2% molybdenum dey resist salt pass 304 (about 18% chromium, 8% nickel). If you leave salt water for some hours, pitting corrosion fit form.
c-123.actionItem: Today wash stainless steel pot wey you use hold soup or salty food immediately, then wipe am dry.

c-124.title: Afternoon coffee still remain more than half for night
c-124.summary: Caffeine dey leave di body slowly, so late coffee fit affect your night sleep. Even to move forward di time of your last coffee go help.
c-124.principle: Caffeine half-life na about 5 hours (3 to 7 hours), and e dey reduce by fixed percentage like first-order reaction. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: If you drink 150mg caffeine by 3 pm, 8 hours later by 11 pm about 50mg (1/3) still remain. Dem recommend total of 400mg or less per day.
c-124.actionItem: Today decide say your last caffeine drink must be at least 8 hours before bedtime, and after that drink decaf or barley tea.

c-125.title: For high mountain, water dey boil at 95°C and cooking dey slow
c-125.summary: As altitude rise, air pressure dey drop so water dey boil for lower temperature. Dis na why cup noodles or rice no dey cook well.
c-125.principle: When atmospheric pressure drop, boiling point dey go down (about 3.3°C per 1,000m). If you apply rule of thumb say reaction rate double every 10°C, cooking time go increase. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: For 1,500m above sea level, water dey boil at about 95°C and di rate become $2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$ times, so cooking time go increase by about 40%.
c-125.actionItem: Today if you get mountain climbing plan, note say according to altitude, cup noodles time go be 1.4 times, and rice must cook longer with lid on.

c-126.title: No preheat coated pan empty on high fire
c-126.summary: Teflon (PTFE) coating dey stable up to about 260°C but above dat e dey decompose and release harmful smoke. For home, to preheat empty pan on high fire na di most common cause.
c-126.principle: PTFE dey stable because C-F bond strong well well, but above about 300°C e dey decompose and release fluorine-based gas, wey dey deadly to birds. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: If you put empty pan on high fire, e fit pass 300°C within 2 to 5 minutes. If you use medium fire and add oil or ingredients, most times e dey stay below 200°C.
c-126.actionItem: Today use coated pan on medium fire or lower and put oil first, no heat am empty, and avoid metal tools.

c-127.title: If you drink vinegar undiluted, e go dissolve tooth enamel
c-127.summary: Vinegar pH na about 2.5, wey low pass pH 5.5 where tooth enamel start to dissolve. If you must drink am, e safer to dilute am well and rinse with water after.
c-127.principle: Dissolution of tooth enamel: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Di lower di $\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$, di faster e dey dissolve.
c-127.example: Vinegar wey get pH 2.5 get hydrogen ion concentration wey high 1000 times pass pH 5.5 standard. Mix one tablespoon vinegar for at least 200mL water, drink with straw, and brush teeth 30 minutes later.
c-127.actionItem: Today if you drink vinegar or sour drink, rinse once with water and brush your teeth 30 minutes later.

c-128.title: Put sliced bread for freezer, no be fridge
c-128.summary: Bread dey turn hard no be because e dry, but because starch dey crystallize again, and e dey happen fastest for fridge.
c-128.principle: Retrogradation, wey be when amylose and amylopectin of cooked starch arrange regularly again, dey fastest at 0 to 5°C and almost stop below -18°C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Bread for room temperature dey harden for 2 to 3 days, and for fridge e dey harden faster, but if you freeze am at -18°C, you fit keep am for about 3 months, and if you heat am above 60°C, di crystals go loosen and e go soft.
c-128.actionItem: Today divide your remaining sliced bread one slice by one slice and freeze am, and when you wan eat, heat am again with toaster or steamer.

c-129.title: Tomato stain for plastic container: use sunlight and oil
c-129.summary: Di red pigment for tomato sauce dey mix well with oil and soak inside plastic. Oil and ultraviolet work better pass water.
c-129.principle: Lycopene na non-polar pigment wey dissolve inside plastic, and di 11 conjugated double bonds dey absorb light so e dey look red, and ultraviolet dey break dis bonds and make am colourless. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Rub am with one drop of oil, wash with dish soap, then put am for sunlight for 2 to 3 hours, and most times e go fade.
c-129.actionItem: Today put one drop of cooking oil for di stained plastic container and rub am, wash with soap, then put am for window sunlight for 2 to 3 hours (to use glass container from start dey prevent am).

c-130.title: For diarrhoea and dehydration, use oral rehydration drink wey get salt and sugar together
c-130.summary: When glucose and sodium dey absorb together, water dey follow enter. E dey rehydrate more than to drink water alone.
c-130.principle: Di SGLT1 transporter for intestine cells dey carry 1 glucose molecule and 2 sodium together, and water dey follow absorb by osmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Di WHO home recipe na 6 teaspoons sugar (about 25g) and 1/2 teaspoon salt (about 3g) inside 1L of water wey dem boil and cool. If dehydration serious, or for infants or high fever, go hospital.
c-130.actionItem: Today prepare one or two packs of commercial oral rehydration salts (ORS) for your emergency medicine box.

c-131.title: Swimming pool eye sting no be chlorine, na chloramine
c-131.summary: Red eyes no be because pool disinfectant too strong, na because of chloramine wey form when e meet sweat and urine. Shower na di best prevention.
c-131.principle: Chlorine dey become hypochlorous acid (HOCl) for water to disinfect, and when e combine with ammonia nitrogen, irritating chloramine go form. If pH na 7.5, HOCl na about 50%. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: Pool recommendation na pH 7.2 to 7.8 and free chlorine 1 to 3ppm. If you take 1 minute soap shower before swimming, e go reduce organic matter plenty.
c-131.actionItem: Today before you go swimming pool, take soap shower for 1 minute, and no urinate during swimming.

c-132.title: Calculate hardness from calcium and magnesium for bottled water label
c-132.summary: Even bottled water wey look di same get different hardness, so di taste of coffee and tea and di limescale dey differ. Only di numbers for di label fit show if na soft or hard water.
c-132.principle: Hardness na di sum of calcium and magnesium ions wey dem convert to calcium carbonate mass. For coffee brewing, dem recommend about 50 to 175mg/L. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Water wey get calcium 80mg/L and magnesium 26mg/L na $2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, wey be very hard water (above 180), so limescale go form well for electric kettle.
c-132.actionItem: Today calculate di hardness of di bottled water wey you dey drink from di Ca and Mg values for di label.

c-133.title: Calorie na heat of combustion, carbohydrate, protein and fat na 4, 4 and 9kcal/g
c-133.summary: Dem set food energy based on di heat wey e produce when dem burn am outside di body. You fit calculate di energy directly from di g for di nutrition label.
c-133.principle: If 1 mol of glucose burn, e produce 2,803kJ (about 15.6kJ/g, 3.7kcal/g). Atwater factor na 4kcal/g for carbohydrate and protein, and 9kcal/g for fat. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Snack wey get 50g carbohydrate, 20g fat and 10g protein na $50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: Today use di nutrition label of one snack and calculate di energy directly from di g of carbohydrate, protein and fat.

c-134.title: If you dry clothes for sun, e get bleaching effect
c-134.summary: Ultraviolet for sunlight dey oxidise and break down pigment stains wey remain for fabric, and e dey make white clothes whiter. Even without sodium percarbonate, you fit use sunlight reduce small stains.
c-134.principle: Photo-oxidation: ultraviolet photon dey break di $\pi$ bond of pigment and e dey react with oxygen to change am to colourless substance. Di photon energy $E = h\nu$ must big pass di bond energy.
c-134.example: If you hang white T-shirt wey get stain wet for direct sunlight for 4 to 6 hours, light stain go fade well. But coloured clothes fit fade by di same principle, so turn dem inside out when you dey dry dem.
c-134.actionItem: Today hang white laundry wey get stain wet for place wey sun dey reach.

c-135.title: If super glue stick for your hand, soak am for soapy water
c-135.summary: Super glue dey harden because of moisture for skin, but you fit slowly loosen am with warm soapy water. If you force am comot, di skin go tear.
c-135.principle: Cyanoacrylate dey polymerise in chain by moisture (OH⁻), and e dey become hard polymer within few seconds to 1 minute. Soapy water and friction dey soften and push di glue layer comot. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{moisture})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: If you soak am for warm soapy water for 10 to 15 minutes and roll am with thumb, most times e go loosen. If e stick to your eyes or lips, no rub am, go hospital.
c-135.actionItem: Today when you dey use super glue, ventilate di place, and if your fingers stick, soak dem for warm soapy water for 15 minutes then roll dem to comot.

c-136.title: If you add acid, fish smell go reduce
c-136.summary: Di main cause of fish smell na basic substance wey dem call trimethylamine. If you sprinkle acid like lemon juice or vinegar, e go neutralise and di smell go less fly up.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. Amine wey don turn ion no dey evaporate, so di smell dey reduce.
c-136.example: If you sprinkle 1 teaspoon (about 5mL) lemon juice for fish and leave am 5 minutes, di fish smell go reduce clearly. Di method of soaking am for milk 20 minutes na di same principle, where protein dey hold di smell substance.
c-136.actionItem: Today when you dey grill fish, first sprinkle lemon juice or vinegar once.

c-137.title: If altitude rise, oxygen partial pressure drop and you go dey breathless
c-137.summary: Oxygen percentage for air na about 21% everywhere, but if altitude rise, air pressure dey drop so oxygen partial pressure reduce. For 3000m above sea level, you fit only breathe in about 70% of wetin you get for sea level.
c-137.principle: Dalton's law of partial pressures: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ dey constant and $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ dey drop.
c-137.example: For sea level (101kPa), oxygen partial pressure na about 21kPa, and for 3000m above sea level (about 70kPa) e be about 14.7kPa. If you climb slowly within 500m per day, risk of altitude sickness go reduce.
c-137.actionItem: If you get high altitude travel plan, plan your schedule so you go climb up slowly.

c-138.title: If canned food swell or dent badly, throw am away
c-138.summary: If can swell, e mean say microorganism don produce gas inside, and e fit be dangerous germ like botulinum. No open swollen can, throw am away.
c-138.principle: Microbial fermentation gas: reaction like $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ dey produce $\mathrm{CO_2}$, and di pressure inside di can go rise.
c-138.example: Normal canned food get nearly vacuum inside, so di lid flat or small dey go inside. If e swell, or e make loud hissing sound when you open am, or e get bubbles, no eat am.
c-138.actionItem: Today take out di canned food wey dey your house and check say no swollen or rusty can dey.

c-139.title: Oil for sink drain go solidify and block am when e cool
c-139.summary: Hot oil na liquid, but when e cool, saturated fat go solidify and stick to di drain pipe wall and mix with dirt. No pour oil for drain, wipe am with paper and throw am for ordinary trash.
c-139.principle: Melting point of saturated fat na about 30 to 60℃, and when cooking oil cool, e go do $\mathrm{liquid \to solid}$ phase change. If e meet calcium ion, e go also form fatty acid calcium salt (soap scum).
c-139.example: If you pour 200mL frying oil inside drain, e go solidify for pipe wall to thickness 1 to 2mm, and if e repeat few times e fit block. Before you wash plates, wipe greasy dishes first with kitchen towel.
c-139.actionItem: Today first wipe greasy pan with kitchen towel before you wash am.

c-140.title: Water for PET bottle inside car for summer, you fit drink am?
c-140.summary: PET bottle wey you leave for hot car for long fit release more trace substances like antimony. For one or two days, di risk low, but e better to avoid water wey you leave for long time.
c-140.principle: Leaching dey increase with temperature: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (Arrhenius equation, if $T$ rise, $k$ increase)
c-140.example: For mid-summer, car temperature fit rise to 60 to 70°C, and leaching speed go be many times faster than for 20°C.
c-140.actionItem: Today no drink di PET bottle water wey remain inside your car, and use stainless steel tumbler for travel.

c-141.title: Di advantage of R-32 air conditioner refrigerant
c-141.summary: R-32 need less refrigerant quantity to give di same cooling capacity than R-410A, and e global warming potential (GWP) na about one-third. Na item wey worth to check when you dey choose new air conditioner.
c-141.principle: R-32: $\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$, if latent heat of vaporization $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ big, di refrigerant circulation go reduce.
c-141.example: GWP na about 2088 for R-410A and about 675 for R-32. Di refrigerant charge also reduce by about 20 to 30%, so efficiency go rise small.
c-141.actionItem: When you dey buy or check air conditioner, check di refrigerant type (R-32 or R-410A) for di product label.

c-142.title: Why soda dey go flat
c-142.summary: Carbonic acid dey dissolve well for pressure and low temperature, and e dey escape when e warm or pressure release. If you keep am cool and close di cap immediately, di fizz go last long.
c-142.principle: Henry's law: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ dey reduce if temperature rise.
c-142.example: Pressure inside bottle na about 3 to 4 atmospheres, and at 25°C, di $\mathrm{CO_2}$ solubility go drop to about half of wetin e be at 4°C.
c-142.actionItem: Today after you drink some of your soda, close di cap immediately and keep am standing for fridge.

c-143.title: Baking soda for fridge deodorising
c-143.summary: Baking soda na weak base, so e dey neutralise acidic smell substances for fridge (like fatty acids). But e adsorption capacity small, so you must change am every 2 to 3 months.
c-143.example: If you put about 100g (1/2 cup) baking soda for one container, e enough to reduce weak smell for one small fridge.
c-143.actionItem: Put one cup baking soda for shallow dish and keep am for fridge shelf, write di date, and change am 3 months later.

c-144.title: Sweet potato sweet pass if you bake am slowly at 70 to 75℃
c-144.summary: Di enzyme beta-amylase for sweet potato dey break starch to sweet maltose, and e dey most active at about 70 to 75℃ and e stop above 90℃. Di slower you bake, di longer di sweetness range.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. Enzyme activity get optimum temperature.
c-144.example: If you bake for 150℃ or lower for 50 minutes or more instead of baking for only 5 minutes for 180℃ oven, di temperature inside di sweet potato go stay for di 70 to 75℃ range longer, and e go form much more maltose. Na why roasted sweet potato dey sweet.
c-144.actionItem: Today when you dey bake sweet potato, try bake am slowly for low temperature for long time.

c-145.title: Why egg dey become soft-boiled at 62 to 65℃ na protein denaturation
c-145.summary: Di proteins for egg white and yolk dey set for different temperatures. Egg white dey set from about 62 to 65℃, and yolk dey set at about 65 to 70℃, so soft-boiled and hard-boiled dey differ.
c-145.principle: Heat denaturation dey unfold di tertiary structure of protein and make dem tangle together. Ovotransferrin dey denature at about 62℃ and ovalbumin at about 80℃.
c-145.example: If you boil for 6 minutes for boiling water, di white go set and di yolk go flow like soft-boiled, and if you boil more than 10 minutes e go be hard-boiled. Because of salmonella risk, elderly people and pregnant women must eat hard-boiled.
c-145.actionItem: Today set timer for 6 minutes and 10 minutes when you dey boil egg and check di difference.

c-146.title: Water-soluble vitamins dey comot with urine even if you eat plenty
c-146.summary: Vitamin C and B group dey dissolve for water, so more than wetin you need no dey gather for body, e dey comot with urine. Di extra for high-dose supplement fit mostly be waste.
c-146.principle: Water-soluble molecules dey polar, so dem dey dissolve well for blood and urine and kidney dey filter dem. But fat-soluble vitamins dey gather for fat tissue.
c-146.example: Di daily recommended vitamin C for adult na about 100mg, and if you eat 1000mg at once, absorption rate go drop below 50% and a large part of di rest go comot. One fruit fit already give about 50mg.
c-146.actionItem: Today if you dey take vitamin supplement, check say di quantity plus wetin you dey get from food no pass di recommended amount.

c-147.title: Sea salt and refined salt get different sodium chloride percentage and minerals
c-147.summary: Refined salt get about 99% or more sodium chloride (NaCl), and sea salt get about 80 to 90% mixed with magnesium, calcium and moisture. Either way, di salty taste and sodium similar, so di important thing na to eat less.
c-147.principle: Sodium proportion na $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. If di salt quantity dey di same, di higher di NaCl percentage, di more sodium too.
c-147.example: 5g salt contain about 1.97g sodium if e na pure NaCl, and if sea salt na 85% NaCl, e be about 1.67g. WHO recommend less than 5g salt per day.
c-147.actionItem: Today check di sodium content (mg/100g) for di nutrition label of your house salt.

c-148.title: Eyeglass lens wey dey change colour with light
c-148.summary: Photochromic lens, di silver halide inside di lens dey separate into silver particles when ultraviolet reach am and e dey darken, and when di light go, e dey return. Inside car, glass dey block ultraviolet so e dey darken less.
c-148.example: Photochromic lens for sunlight, di transmittance dey drop from about 85% to di 20% range within 1 minute, and e dey take 5 to 15 minutes to return to normal indoors.
c-148.actionItem: When you dey drive for strong sun day, carry ordinary sunglasses wey block ultraviolet and no confuse dem with photochromic lens.

c-149.title: Electric car dey waste less energy than petrol car
c-149.summary: Petrol engine only use about 20 to 30% of fuel energy to move di wheels and di rest dey waste as heat. Electric car dey pass about 80 to 90% of electrical energy to di wheels, so e need less energy for di same distance.
c-149.principle: 1L of petrol get heat of about $32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$), and if efficiency $\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ na about 25%, useful work na about 2.2kWh.
c-149.example: Car wey dey go about 12km with 1L petrol dey use 2.2kWh to go 12km, but electric car only need about 2kWh for 12km (efficiency about 6km/kWh). If you count di loss for power generation stage, di gap go reduce.
c-149.actionItem: Today for short distance journey, walk or use public transport to save fuel.

c-150.title: Cooking oil smoke point and frying oil
c-150.summary: If oil pass its smoke point, smoke and acrolein go form and dey irritate eyes and throat. For high fire cooking, oil wey get high smoke point dey safe.
c-150.example: Smoke point na about 190°C for olive oil (extra virgin), about 240°C for canola oil, and about 230°C for refined sunflower seed oil.
c-150.actionItem: For frying and grilling, choose refined oil wey get high smoke point, and if smoke come out, reduce di fire immediately and ventilate.

c-151.title: Why iced tea dey turn cloudy
c-151.summary: If strongly brewed black tea cool, caffeine and tannin dey combine and clump into particles and e go turn cloudy. If you add hot water, e go clear, and if you cold-brew am, e go less cloudy.
c-151.principle: Caffeine + tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ complex: di lower di temperature, di lower di solubility and e dey precipitate.
c-151.example: If you cool black tea wey you brew at 100°C to 4°C, e go turn cloudy within few minutes, and cold brew (4°C, 8 hours) get much less cloudiness.
c-151.actionItem: Today make iced tea by putting tea bag for 500mL cold water and cold-brew am for fridge for 8 hours.

c-152.title: Amygdalin for plum seed dey dangerous if you eat am raw
c-152.summary: Unripe plum and di seed get amygdalin, and if e break down, hydrogen cyanide fit come out. For plum syrup, remove di seed or age am for at least 6 months before you strain am, and no eat di seed.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. If enzyme touch am, hydrogen cyanide go form.
c-152.example: Di amygdalin inside one plum seed na very small quantity, but if you chew plenty raw, e fit dey dangerous. For unripe green plum, remove di seeds and soak with sugar 1:1 and age for 6 months, then remove di fruit flesh.
c-152.actionItem: Today when you dey make plum syrup, no eat di seeds, and write for calendar di time to remove dem.

c-153.title: Spray can fit burst if you put am for hot place
c-153.summary: Aerosol can get compressed gas and flammable propellant inside, so pressure go rise if temperature rise. If you leave am for car for summer or near fire, e fit burst, so you must follow di label to store am below 50℃.
c-153.principle: Gas pressure dey proportional to temperature: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ na Kelvin). Liquefied propellant vapour pressure dey rise sharply with temperature.
c-153.example: If can wey get 5 atmospheres at 20℃ (293K) reach 60℃ (333K), by simple calculation e go be about 5.7 atmospheres, and if you add di vapour pressure increase of liquefied propellant, e go be much higher. For mid-summer, car inside fit pass 60℃.
c-153.actionItem: Today gather di spray products for your house and move dem go cool place wey heat no dey reach.

c-154.title: Why jelly no dey set if you add pineapple or kiwi
c-154.summary: Na because di protein-digesting enzymes for fresh pineapple and kiwi dey cut gelatin into small pieces. If you heat am once or use canned one, di enzyme go stop and di jelly go set.
c-154.principle: Bromelain and actinidin dey hydrolyse peptide bonds: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Enzyme dey denature above about $70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-154.example: 100mL gelatin wey get fresh pineapple no go set even after some hours, but pineapple wey you heat above 80℃ for 1 minute or canned one go set normally. Di same enzyme dey also use to tenderise meat.
c-154.actionItem: Today when you dey put fresh fruit for jelly or pudding, first scald pineapple and kiwi for boiling water for 1 minute before you use dem.

c-155.title: Damp smell from dry towel
c-155.summary: Di smell for laundry wey never dry well na because of fatty acids like 4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid wey Moraxella bacteria dey produce. Di key na to dry am quick before di bacteria increase.
c-155.principle: Bacteria metabolism: skin lipid $\rightarrow$ $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid) and other volatile fatty acids
c-155.example: If wet laundry no dry for inside house within 5 hours or more, smell go start, and dryer above 60°C go reduce bacteria well.
c-155.actionItem: After washing, hang am immediately and turn on fan or dehumidifier to dry am within 5 hours.

c-156.title: Wetin be pink slime for bathroom
c-156.summary: Di pink sticky slime no be mould, na red pigment film wey bacteria like Serratia produce. Moisture and soap scum dey be food for dem, so to dry am na di best prevention.
c-156.principle: Bacteria growth $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (if division time $t_d$ na about 30 minutes, e go increase by hundreds of thousands of times for one day)
c-156.example: For humid bathroom at 25 to 35°C, bacteria number dey increase about 4,000 times every 6 hours. If e dry, di growth go stop.
c-156.actionItem: After shower, use squeegee push water comot from wall and floor, and turn on exhaust fan for 30 minutes.

c-157.title: How to store cut watermelon
c-157.summary: For cut watermelon, water and sugar dey comot through di cut surface and bacteria dey grow. Cover di cut surface with cling film, keep am for fridge, and eat am within two days to be safe.
c-157.principle: Evaporation dey proportional to exposed area and temperature. At 4°C, bacteria growth speed dey reduce to about 1/20 of 25°C.
c-157.example: Cut watermelon for room temperature (30°C), bacteria number go increase tens of times after 2 hours, and for fridge (4°C) e dey safe for about 2 days.
c-157.actionItem: Keep di leftover watermelon in big pieces with di rind, stick cling film tight to di cut surface, and keep am for fridge.

c-158.title: For summer lunch box, vinegar rice and cooled side dishes dey safe
c-158.summary: For acidic environment (pH below 4.6), most food poisoning bacteria hard to grow. If you add one spoon vinegar to lunch box rice or cool di side dishes before you pack dem, e go dey safe longer.
c-158.principle: Dissociation equilibrium of weak acid $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$, so $[\mathrm{H^+}]$ go increase and if pH drop, bacteria growth rate go slow.
c-158.example: If you add 1 tablespoon (15mL) vinegar to 2 cups rice (about 300g), di pH of di rice go drop to around 5, and bacteria growth go slow. Cool di lunch box completely before you close am and put am with ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: Today for lunch box, cool di rice well before you close am, and put ice pack together.

c-159.title: Why tools dey rust for humid days
c-159.summary: Iron dey become iron oxide (rust) when water and oxygen dey, and e dey faster if humidity pass 60%. Oil film or desiccant dey slow di rust.
c-159.example: For relative humidity of 60% or more, bare iron surface go rust within few days, and below 40% humidity e almost no dey progress.
c-159.actionItem: Wipe tools thinly with cloth wey get machine oil, and put silica gel for di toolbox.

c-160.title: Be careful when you use mothballs (naphthalene) for wardrobe
c-160.summary: Mothball dey change from solid straight to gas (sublimation) to drive insects comot. Di vapour dey harm di respiratory system, so you need ventilation and distance.
c-160.principle: Sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$, if temperature rise, vapour pressure go increase.
c-160.example: Naphthalene vapour pressure na about 11Pa at 25°C, and at 40°C e go increase to about 4 times. Make e no touch clothes directly.
c-160.actionItem: Before you wear clothes wey you use mothball for, air dem for balcony for 2 to 3 hours, and keep mothballs where children hand no go reach.

c-161.title: Garlic and fish smell dey reduce if you rub hand for stainless steel
c-161.summary: Dem say di smell of sulphur compounds from garlic and onion dey reduce if you rub your hand for stainless steel. If you wash with soap, di remaining sulphur compounds go wash comot.
c-161.principle: Sulphur compound $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ dey adsorb to di oxide film ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$) for metal surface and e volatility dey reduce.
c-161.example: Many people experience say di smell reduce if you rub your hands for stainless steel tap for 30 seconds after chopping garlic, but scientific evidence for how big di effect be dey limited. You fit use lemon juice and vinegar together too.
c-161.actionItem: Today after you chop garlic, rub your hands for stainless steel sink for 30 seconds and wash with soap.

c-162.title: Why bread mould dey grow fast for rainy season
c-162.summary: Bread get high water activity, so mould dey grow fast when humidity pass 70%. Mould threads dey spread inside di bread, so even to cut only di part wey show na risk.
c-162.principle: Water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (sliced bread about 0.95, mould dey grow at about 0.80 or more)
c-162.example: For humid day, sliced bread for 25°C room temperature go get mould within 3 to 4 days, and if you freeze am (-18°C), e go last for few weeks.
c-162.actionItem: Today wrap di sliced bread wey you no go fit finish one slice by one slice in cling film and freeze am, and toast am when you wan eat.

c-163.title: Why rain water dey slightly acidic
c-163.summary: Rain water na slightly acidic with pH about 5.6 because carbon dioxide for air dissolve inside, and acid rain na pH below 5.6. E no dey harm skin at dis level, but metal and stone dey corrode slowly.
c-163.example: If $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$, then pH na $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$. Pure water na pH 7.
c-163.actionItem: After rain, wipe di water from di chain of bicycle wey dey stand outside and rub one drop of oil.

c-164.title: If you cool cooked rice, resistant starch go increase and di sugar wey body go absorb go reduce
c-164.summary: If you cool rice, part of di starch dey change to resistant starch wey hard to digest. Even if you reheat am after fridge, some of dis resistant starch go remain and blood sugar rise fit be small more gentle.
c-164.principle: Starch retrogradation na when gelatinised amylose cool and form crystal structure again. Di digestive enzyme amylase no dey break dis crystals down well.
c-164.example: Dem say rice wey dem reheat after 12 to 24 hours for fridge get several times more resistant starch than freshly cooked rice, but di quantity wey increase na only few percent of di total starch. No leave rice for room temperature, put am for fridge quick.
c-164.actionItem: Today keep leftover rice for fridge within 1 hour.

c-165.title: Effect of fabric softener for towel after washing
c-165.summary: Fabric softener, di cationic surfactant dey coat di fabric to make am soft, but e dey reduce water absorption. For towels, e better to reduce how often you use am or use vinegar substitute.
c-165.principle: Cationic surfactant $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ dey adsorb to negatively charged fabric $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ and form hydrophobic film.
c-165.example: Towels wey you use fabric softener on fit lose about 20 to 30% of absorption. When you dey wash 10 towels, reduce di use of softener to 1 time out of 3.
c-165.actionItem: Today wash towels without fabric softener and shake dem well before you dry dem.

c-166.title: If you recycle aluminium can, e only need about 5% of di energy for new making
c-166.summary: Aluminium dey use huge electricity when dem dey make am new from ore, but if dem melt am and recycle, dem fit save about 95%. If you rinse di cans clean and separate dem for recycling, di effect go bigger.
c-166.principle: Bauxite electrolysis: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. New aluminium of 1kg need about $14\ \mathrm{kWh}$, and recycled aluminium need about $0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$ only.
c-166.example: If you recycle one aluminium can (about 14g), e save about 0.2kWh. 100 cans na about 20kWh, wey be similar to di power of about 5 hours of air conditioner use.
c-166.actionItem: Today after you drink, empty di can, rinse am and put am inside aluminium recycling bin.

c-167.title: Food wey get mould no dey safe even if you cut only di part wey you see
c-167.summary: Mould dey spread thread-like hyphae under di part wey you see, and some dey produce toxin. For soft food like bread, fruit and jam, na safer to throw di whole thing away if you see mould.
c-167.principle: Aflatoxin $\mathrm{B_1}$ na $\mathrm{C_{17}H_{12}O_6}$ so e dey resist heat and e only break down above about $270\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. E no go disappear even if you boil or bake am.
c-167.example: Guideline say for dense food like hard cheese or carrot, you fit cut generously 2.5cm around di mould part, but for soft food wey get plenty water like sliced bread, jam and tofu, you must throw di whole thing away.
c-167.actionItem: Today check say no mould dey di sliced bread and jam for your fridge.

c-168.title: Di smell of city gas na substance wey dem add on purpose
c-168.summary: City gas (methane) naturally no get smell, so dem dey add small thioether and mercaptan substances wey get 'rotten egg' smell so you go fit know when e leak. If you smell am, no use flame or electric switch, first ventilate.
c-168.principle: Methane dey explode for about 5 to 15% for air: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Odour substances wey dem add to odourless methane include $\mathrm{CH_3SH}$ and others.
c-168.example: If methane of 0.4 to 1.2m³ (5 to 15%) leak inside 8m³ room, e don reach explosion range. If you smell gas, close di valve, open window, no touch light or fan switch, and report from outside.
c-168.actionItem: Today know where di gas valve dey, and make habit to close am after use.

c-169.title: Fluorescent whitening agent for white clothes detergent dey make white 'look' whiter
c-169.summary: Fluorescent whitening agent dey absorb ultraviolet and emit blue light to hide yellow tint so clothes go look whiter. E no dey remove dirt, na visual effect, and you no need am for coloured clothes.
c-169.principle: Fluorescence na when e absorb ultraviolet (about 350nm) and emit blue light (about 430nm), wey come out at slightly longer wavelength because energy $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ don reduce small.
c-169.example: White T-shirt wey you wash one time with fluorescent whitening agent fit emit more blue light under sunlight and look about 5 to 10% brighter. For coloured clothes, ordinary detergent without di mark dey enough.
c-169.actionItem: Today when you dey wash, check di detergent label for white clothes and coloured clothes for fluorescent whitening agent mark.

c-170.title: If phone fall inside water, to put am inside rice container almost no get effect
c-170.summary: Rice no dey absorb moisture well, so di speed to draw water drops from inside phone no differ much from drying am for open air. E better to off di power, no charge am, and dry am for place wey air dey pass.
c-170.principle: Drying speed dey proportional to vapour pressure difference. Rice absorbency dey much weaker than silica gel, and di time wey corrosion reaction of electrical short dey progress na wetin matter.
c-170.example: Silica gel dey absorb moisture up to about 40% of e own weight, but rice absorb much less. Off di power and dry am for 24 to 48 hours or more before you turn am on. If e fall inside salt water, first contact service centre.
c-170.actionItem: If your phone wet, instead of rice container, off di power and put am for place wey air dey pass.

c-171.title: For burn, cool am under running cold water for 20 minutes first
c-171.summary: Just after burn, if you cool am with running cold water (15 to 25℃) for 10 to 20 minutes, e go remove di heat wey dey spread deep inside di skin and reduce damage. No use ice, toothpaste or soybean paste.
c-171.principle: Heat from hot object dey transfer to tissue by $q = mc\Delta T$ and e dey denature protein. Running water dey take away heat quick.
c-171.example: 60℃ water fit cause serious burn for skin within 5 seconds. 20 minutes cold water dey reduce di burn depth and ease pain, but ice wey too cold dey constrict blood vessels and actually harm di tissue.
c-171.actionItem: Today remember di order: if you get burn for kitchen, immediately cool am under running cold water for 20 minutes.

c-172.title: Wetin be 'oxygen absorber' inside food
c-172.summary: Di small sachet for seaweed or jerky packaging na iron powder wey dey react with oxygen to remove oxygen inside di package. If oxygen reduce, fat oxidation and mould go slow.
c-172.example: One oxygen absorber sachet (about 2g iron) dey absorb about 200mL oxygen, and e almost remove di 21% oxygen for 1L air package.
c-172.actionItem: No eat di oxygen absorber inside di sachet, and for new packaged food, leave am inside as e dey and store am.

c-173.title: Check egg freshness by floating am for water
c-173.summary: Egg shell get tiny holes, so as time pass, moisture and carbon dioxide dey escape and di air pocket dey grow big. If e sink, e fresh, and if e float, e old.
c-173.principle: Buoyancy $F_{\mathrm{b}} = \rho_{\mathrm{water}}\,V g$, if di air pocket grow so average density $\rho < \rho_{\mathrm{water}}$, e go float.
c-173.example: Egg density just after laying na about 1.09g/mL, and after 3 to 4 weeks if e reduce to about 1.02g/mL, e go start to float for water wey no get salt.
c-173.actionItem: For egg wey you doubt, before you break am, put water for bowl and float am. If e rise up, no eat am.

c-174.title: Why honey dey turn white and hard
c-174.summary: If glucose inside honey pass di limit wey e fit dissolve for water, e go become crystals and harden. E no be spoil, na normal thing, and you fit return am with double boiler.
c-174.principle: Glucose solubility: if e pass saturation limit $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(aq)} \rightarrow \mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(s)}$
c-174.example: Honey get about 31% glucose, about 38% fructose and about 17% water, and crystallisation dey faster below 14°C. If you put am for double boiler for 40°C water, e go loosen.
c-174.actionItem: For hard honey, no use microwave, soak di whole bottle for water below 40°C to loosen am before you use.

c-175.title: Why dem dey put cooking oil and supplements for brown bottle
c-175.summary: Light, especially ultraviolet and blue light, dey oxidise fat and vitamins and spoil dem. Brown glass dey block light wey get wavelength about 450nm or lower well.
c-175.principle: Photo-oxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2} \xrightarrow{h\nu} \mathrm{ROO\cdot}$ (chain oxidation), photon energy $E = hc/\lambda$
c-175.example: Brown glass dey block more than 90% of light near 400nm, and oil for transparent bottle fit start to go rancid within few weeks for sunlight.
c-175.actionItem: Keep sesame oil and perilla oil for dark cupboard, no be window side wey light dey enter.

c-176.title: How instant cold compress pack dey become cold
c-176.summary: When ammonium nitrate or urea inside di pack dissolve for water, e dey absorb heat and di temperature go drop. Na endothermic reaction wey you fit use immediately if you burst and shake am.
c-176.example: If 1 mol (80g) ammonium nitrate dissolve for water, e dey absorb 25.7kJ, and e fit reduce di temperature of 100mL water by about 15 to 20°C below room temperature.
c-176.actionItem: Carry instant cold compress pack for camping or exercise, and no put am directly for skin, wrap am with towel and use am for 15 minutes only.

c-177.title: Lithium-ion battery: why e no dey tolerate heat
c-177.summary: High temperature dey speed up electrolyte decomposition and SEI film growth and permanently reduce capacity. You no suppose leave smartphone and power bank inside car for mid-summer.
c-177.principle: Degradation rate $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$: if temperature rise by about 10°C, rate go double (Arrhenius rule of thumb)
c-177.example: If capacity reduce by about 20% after one year at 25°C, for 45°C e fit reduce by about 35 to 40% for di same period.
c-177.actionItem: For summer, no leave devices wey get battery for car, put dem inside bag and carry dem.

c-178.title: Why kimchi dey turn sour fast for summer
c-178.summary: Lactic acid bacteria for kimchi dey multiply faster di higher di temperature and dem dey produce more lactic acid. Below 10°C, e dey ripen slowly and di taste go last long.
c-178.principle: Lactic acid fermentation: $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \rightarrow 2\,CH_3CH(OH)COOH}$ (as pH drop, sour taste dey increase)
c-178.example: At 20°C, pH go drop to about 4.2 within 3 to 4 days and e go turn sour, but for 4°C fridge, e dey change slowly over few weeks.
c-178.actionItem: Put only wetin you go eat inside small container and keep di rest for di coldest part of di fridge.

c-179.title: Sunscreen na oil-based so water wash alone no dey remove am well
c-179.summary: Di UV-blocking ingredients and oils for sunscreen hardly dissolve for water, so some go remain if you use water only. If oil cleanser or cleansing balm dissolve di oily part first, then you finish with foam cleanser, e go wash off well.
c-179.principle: Like dissolves like principle: substances wey get similar polarity dey mix. Non-polar oil dey dissolve for non-polar cleanser, and for water you need surfactant (micelle).
c-179.example: Waterproof sunscreen na design so about 80% or more still remain even after you soak am for water for three hours. E effective to massage with cleansing oil for 30 seconds, emulsify with water, then rinse.
c-179.actionItem: Today if you apply sunscreen, use oil cleanser first and then wash with foam cleanser.

c-180.title: Battery leakage wey don turn white powder na alkaline, so wear gloves and wipe am
c-180.summary: Di white powder wey old alkaline battery dey leak na potassium carbonate wey potassium hydroxide form after e react with carbon dioxide for air. E dey irritate skin and eyes, so wear gloves and wipe am with cotton swab wey get vinegar or lemon juice.
c-180.principle: $\mathrm{2KOH + CO_2 \to K_2CO_3 + H_2O}$ form white crystals, and weak acid vinegar dey neutralise am like $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + 2CH_3COOH \to 2CH_3COOK + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-180.example: Di leaked liquid na strong alkali of pH 13 to 14, so e dey irritate if e touch bare hand. Wipe am with cotton swab wey get vinegar and finish with dry cloth. E safer to remove batteries from devices wey you no dey use.
c-180.actionItem: Today remove di batteries from remote or toys wey you no use for long time.

c-181.title: Why ice no dey transparent
c-181.summary: Air and impurities wey dissolve for water dey trap for di centre of di ice as e freeze, so e dey look white. If you use water wey dem boil and cool, e go clearer, but e no go become completely transparent.
c-181.principle: Gas solubility $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P$: when water freeze, solubility almost become 0 and bubbles go trap
c-181.example: Ice wey you freeze with boiled and cooled water get fewer bubbles and e go clear well, and if you freeze from one side (directional freezing), e go become transparent ice.
c-181.actionItem: Today pour boiled and cooled water inside ice tray and freeze am for di ice wey you wan use.

c-182.title: How to store hydrogen peroxide
