c-182.summary: Hydrogen peroxide dey break down to oxygen and water when e touch light, heat or metal. Keep am cool inside brown bottle, and old bottle no dey work well again.
c-182.example: 3% hydrogen peroxide fit lose plenty concentration about 6 months after you open am, and above 30°C di breakdown dey faster.
c-182.actionItem: Write di opening date for hydrogen peroxide bottle wey you buy from pharmacy, and keep am for dark cool place.

c-183.title: If you sweat and drink only plenty plain water, risk of hyponatraemia dey
c-183.summary: If you sweat for long and drink only large quantity of plain water, di sodium for your blood go dilute and you fit get headache and nausea. Drink drinks or snacks wey get salt together.
c-183.principle: Sweat dey carry water and Na$^+$ comot together. If you only refill with plain water, plasma sodium concentration $C_{\mathrm{Na}}=\frac{n_{\mathrm{Na}}}{V}$ go drop as only di denominator $V$ dey increase, and water dey move inside cells because of osmosis. Normal range na about 135 to 145 mmol/L.
c-183.example: If you sweat about 2L for 3 hours mountain hike for mid-summer, about 2g sodium (equal to 5g salt) go comot. If you then drink 3L of plain water at once, di Na$^+$ for your blood fit drop below 135 mmol/L.
c-183.actionItem: Today when you dey exercise or walk for long, carry salty snack (nuts, crackers) or diluted sports drink together with water, and no drink more than 500mL at once.

c-184.title: Bleach wey you dissolve for hot water lose only im disinfecting power
c-184.summary: If you dissolve bleach for hot water, di disinfecting component dey break down quick and only di sharp chlorine smell go increase. Dissolve am for cold or lukewarm water and use am immediately.
c-184.principle: HOCl, di active component of sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), no strong against heat, so e dey decompose by $2\mathrm{HOCl}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{O_2}$ equation. For every rise of about 10℃, di decomposition rate dey roughly double or more.
c-184.example: If you dissolve small amount of household bleach (about 4 to 5% NaOCl) inside 500mL of water, e dey effective for several hours at 20℃, but for 60℃ water, plenty of am go disappear within few minutes and more irritating gas go fly comot.
c-184.actionItem: Today wen you dey disinfect with bleach, dilute am for cold water and use am immediately, ventilate di place, and never mix am with acidic detergent.

c-185.title: Heat seaside oysters and shellfish at 85℃ for 1 minute to block Vibrio
c-185.summary: If you cook oysters and shellfish wey you chop for seaside for summer at 85℃ or above for at least 1 minute to di inside, you fit greatly reduce di worry about Vibrio bacteria. Raw one dey especially dangerous for people wey get weak immunity.
c-185.principle: Di proteins of Vibrio bacteria dey denature by heat and lose dia function. Di number of bacteria dey reduce as $N=N_0\,10^{-t/D}$, and di higher di temperature, di shorter di $D$ (time to reduce by 10 times).
c-185.example: Vibrio dey multiply fast for 25 to 35℃ sea water. Even after di shell open, cook am 3 to 5 minutes more and keep di inside temperature at 85℃ or above for 1 minute, and di safety margin go bigger.
c-185.actionItem: Today if you dey chop seafood, cook am well inside di shell instead of raw, and wash di knife and chopping board wey you use for raw one immediately.

c-186.title: Blisters wey dey form if lime or lemon juice touch your skin and you stay for sun
c-186.summary: If lime or lemon juice touch your skin and you stay under sun, e fit turn red like burn and blisters fit form. If e touch you, wash am with soap and avoid sunlight.
c-186.principle: Furocoumarins for citrus peel and juice dey absorb ultraviolet A (320 to 400nm) and cause phototoxic reaction wey dey bind with skin DNA and proteins. Di energy na $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$, and e dey bigger as di wavelength short.
c-186.example: If you no wipe your hand after outdoor cocktail or squeezing lime and you stay for sun for 1 to 2 hours, after 24 to 72 hours, red marks and blisters go appear for di shape of di juice, and pigmentation fit remain for several months.
c-186.actionItem: Today if you touch citrus, wash your hand immediately with soap and water, and before you wash, cover di skin wey dey exposed to sunlight.

c-187.title: If jellyfish sting you, wash with sea water instead of fresh water
c-187.summary: If you wash jellyfish sting with fresh water, di remaining stinging cells fit burst more. Rinse with sea water and remove di tentacles with tool instead of bare hand.
c-187.principle: Jellyfish nematocysts dey fire stinging cells by osmotic pressure and chemical stimulation. Fresh water get lower osmotic pressure than sea water (about 35g/L salinity), so water fit enter di nematocyst because of di $\Pi=iMRT$ difference and encourage am to fire.
c-187.example: If you get sting for beach, rinse with sea water for at least 30 seconds, scrape off di tentacles with edge of card, and if pain serious, soaking am for about 45℃ water for around 20 minutes dey commonly recommended. First aid dey differ by species, so if you get difficulty to breathe or similar, call 119 immediately.
c-187.actionItem: Today if you dey go sea, check di jellyfish warning, and prepare sea water rinse and one credit card to use if sting happen.

c-188.title: Why swimsuit dey loose after swimming pool and how to choose
c-188.summary: Swimsuit dey loose after few visits to swimming pool because chlorine dey break down di stretch material. Choose chlorine-resistant material and rinse am immediately after use.
c-188.principle: Di spandex (polyurethane) chains dey oxidize by HOCl for pool disinfectant and break. Di chain length dey reduce and elasticity dey drop, and ordinary spandex dey spoil much faster than chlorine-resistant PBT-type swimsuit material.
c-188.example: Ordinary nylon/spandex swimsuit dey show clear sagging after 30 to 50 uses for pool, while PBT blend dey last several times longer. Residual chlorine for pool na usually 1 to 3mg/L.
c-188.actionItem: Today after swimming, rinse your swimsuit immediately with cold water, no twist am, and dry am for shade.

c-189.title: Why ice cream wey melt and freeze again dey gritty
c-189.summary: If ice cream melt and freeze again, big and rough ice grains go form and e go dey gritty. If e don melt once, e better to chop am immediately than to freeze am again.
c-189.principle: Small ice crystals get big surface energy so dem dey melt, and water go move to big crystals and dem go grow (Ostwald ripening). Di relationship wey di smaller di particle radius $r$, di higher di solubility na $\ln\frac{S_r}{S_\infty}=\frac{2\gamma V_m}{rRT}$.
c-189.example: Ice crystals for well-made ice cream na about 50μm or smaller so e dey smooth, but if e melt and freeze again, dem go grow to 100μm or more and e go dey gritty for mouth. Di same thing dey happen if di freezer temperature dey go up and down often.
c-189.actionItem: Today, put ice cream for di inside of di freezer instead of di door side to reduce temperature fluctuation, and close di lid immediately after you chop am.

c-190.title: No put dry ice inside closed car
c-190.summary: Dry ice no dey melt but e dey turn gas, and e fit raise di CO$_2$ concentration inside closed car to dangerous level. Wen you dey carry am, open di window and put am for di trunk or ventilated space.
c-190.principle: Solid CO$_2$ dey sublime as $\mathrm{CO_2(s)}\rightarrow \mathrm{CO_2(g)}$ (-78.5℃). 1kg turn about 500L of gas, and if CO$_2$ concentration pass 4%, headache and dizziness go start and higher than dat dey dangerous.
c-190.example: 2kg of dry ice dey produce about 1,000L of CO$_2$. If e evaporate completely inside about 3,000L interior of passenger car, di concentration fit rise to about 25%, wey very dangerous.
c-190.actionItem: Today if you must move dry ice, do am with ventilation, wear gloves to touch am, and no put am inside sealed container.

c-191.title: Corn sweetness dey reduce as time pass after dem pluck am
c-191.summary: From di moment dem pluck corn, di sugar dey turn starch so di sweetness dey reduce and e go dey bland. If you boil am di same day wey you buy am or keep am for fridge, you fit keep di sweetness longer.
c-191.principle: Enzymes for corn kernel dey convert sugars like glucose to starch: $n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\rightarrow(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Enzyme reaction dey slow for low temperature so refrigeration dey delay am.
c-191.example: Freshly picked sweet corn fit turn about 40% of im sugar to starch if you leave am for room temperature for one day, but for 0 to 4℃ refrigeration e dey progress much slower. If you keep am inside di husk, water loss too go reduce.
c-191.actionItem: Today if you buy corn, no leave am for room temperature, refrigerate am inside di husk, and if possible, boil and chop am within one day.

c-192.title: Why tomato dey lose aroma if you refrigerate am
c-192.summary: If you refrigerate ripe tomato, di aroma go weaken and di texture go turn mealy. Keep fully ripe tomatoes for room temperature and chop dem within few days before you eat.
c-192.principle: Tomato dey suffer chilling injury below 12℃, so di activity of enzymes wey dey synthesize aroma compounds (for example cis-3-hexenal) dey drop and di membrane structure dey damage. Enzyme rate dey vary with temperature as $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-192.example: Even if you keep tomato for 5℃ fridge for only 3 days, di volatile aroma components fit reduce well. If you keep am for room temperature, fully ripe tomato good to chop within about 3 to 5 days.
c-192.actionItem: Today keep fully ripe tomato for cool place with di stem facing down, and if you don refrigerate am already, take am out 30 minutes before you eat am.

c-193.title: How to revive separated mayonnaise
c-193.summary: No throw away mayonnaise wey oil and egg don separate. If you add am small small into one fresh egg yolk and stir, you fit revive am. Di lecithin for di fresh yolk go hold di emulsion again.
c-193.principle: Mayonnaise na emulsion wey oil spread inside water, and di lecithin for di yolk dey lower di surface tension $\gamma$ for di water-oil interface so di droplets no go merge. If oil enter too fast or di temperature no correct, di droplets go merge and phase separation go happen.
c-193.example: About 200g of separated mayonnaise go turn smooth again if you slowly add am one spoon at a time into 1 fresh yolk and 1 teaspoon of water. One yolk fit usually emulsify oil up to about 200mL.
c-193.actionItem: Today if you dey make mayonnaise, start with oil drop by drop and increase am slowly, use fresh eggs, and refrigerate am after you make am.

c-194.title: Menthol cooling products no dey lower body temperature
c-194.summary: Cooling spray or sheets wey get menthol only make you feel cool, dem no really lower your body temperature. To cool down for hot weather, drink water and stay for shade first.
c-194.principle: Menthol dey activate di cold receptor TRPM8 for di skin and di nerves dey send signal say e cold. Real heat transfer need temperature change like $Q=mc\Delta T$, but menthol itself almost no dey take heat from di body.
c-194.example: Even if you apply cooling product wey get about 1% menthol, di skin temperature almost no change, around 0.5℃, but di cool feeling dey last tens of minutes. For heatwave above 33℃ wey get heatstroke risk, e dangerous to trust only di feeling.
c-194.actionItem: Today for hot day, no depend only on cooling products, drink water and rest for shade to really lower your body temperature.

c-195.title: For spicy mouth, one sip of milk instead of water
c-195.summary: Wen you chop spicy food and your mouth dey burn, water no help much, but milk or yoghurt better. Na because capsaicin dey stick well to oil components and proteins.
c-195.principle: Capsaicin ($\mathrm{C_{18}H_{27}NO_3}$) na fat-soluble molecule wey almost no dissolve for water. Di fat for milk dey dissolve am and di casein protein dey bind am and help remove am from di receptors.
c-195.example: After you chop spicy ramen, 200mL of water only dey wash am for short time, but one cup of milk (200mL, about 7g fat, about 6g protein) dey clearly reduce di burning within few minutes.
c-195.actionItem: Today wen you dey chop spicy food, take milk or plain yoghurt with am, and if your mouth dey burn, hold one sip for your mouth before you swallow.

c-196.title: Burnt part of charcoal-grilled meat dey produce benzopyrene
c-196.summary: Di blackened burnt part of meat wey you grill directly over charcoal fit get benzopyrene, wey be possible carcinogen. Cut off di burnt part and grill am so flame no touch am.
c-196.principle: Wen meat fat drip on charcoal and dey thermally decompose, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH) dey form and stick to di meat through smoke. Di representative compound na benzopyrene ($\mathrm{C_{20}H_{12}}$).
c-196.example: Benzopyrene dey increase for smoke and burnt parts wen you grill fatty pork belly directly over fire. If you clean di grill often and use foil or grill plate instead of grate, you fit reduce PAH well.
c-196.actionItem: Today if you grill meat, avoid di flame from dripping fat, grill am for low heat, and cut off di charred black part before you chop.

c-197.title: For key hole, use graphite powder instead of oil
c-197.summary: For stiff key hole, graphite powder (pencil lead powder) lubricant better than ordinary oil. Oil dey make dust stick, and over time e go make am stiffer.
c-197.principle: Graphite na solid lubricant wey get layered structure where carbon layers dey slide easily. E dey lower di friction coefficient $F=\mu N$ for friction force $\mu$ and e no dey sticky so e no dey gather dust.
c-197.example: If you blow graphite powder one or two times into di key hole, friction go reduce and di key go turn smooth. But ordinary oil dey mix with dust and harden after few months and fit block di key hole.
c-197.actionItem: Today if your key stiff, spray small graphite lubricant inside di key hole or colour di key grooves with pencil and insert and remove am few times.

c-198.title: For bicycle chain, use chain oil, no be WD-40
c-198.summary: WD-40 get strong solvent and cleaning character for rust removal, so e no go last as lubricant for bicycle chain. After cleaning, apply oil wey dem make specially for chain.
c-198.principle: WD-40 na volatile solvent with thin oil film so e dey evaporate or wash comot quick. Lubricating oil get high viscosity so e dey keep film for contact surfaces and dey reduce friction loss $P_{\mathrm{loss}}=F_f\,v$.
c-198.example: Clean and well-lubricated chain get about 98 to 99% efficiency, but dry and dirty chain fit lose 3 to 5 percentage points or more. If you dey ride at 150W, 3% na loss of about 4.5W.
c-198.actionItem: Today if your chain dey make noise, wipe am with dry cloth, apply one drop of chain oil for each link, and wipe off di excess oil.

c-199.title: If you join aluminium and stainless steel, one side go corrode first
c-199.summary: If two different metals touch for wet condition, di more active metal go corrode first. Wen you bolt aluminium and stainless steel together, put insulating washer between dem.
c-199.principle: If two metals wey get different potentials and electrolyte dey, dem become small cell and aluminium dey dissolve as $\mathrm{Al}\rightarrow \mathrm{Al^{3+}}+3e^-$ for di anode. Standard potential na about -1.66V for Al and about -0.44V or above for stainless steel (Fe-based), so di difference big.
c-199.example: If you use stainless steel screw directly for aluminium railing for coastal terrace, white powder corrosion fit form for di contact point within few months to 1 year. Na because di potential difference big and sea water dey act as electrolyte.
c-199.actionItem: Today, check places where different metals touch, and if na place wey water dey gather, use insulating washer or paint to stop di two metals from touching directly.

c-200.title: No put food inside galvanized bucket
c-200.summary: If you put acidic food (vinegar, pickled fruit, kimchi) inside galvanized bucket or iron plate, zinc fit dissolve and cause vomiting and stomach pain. Use food-grade container.
c-200.principle: Di zinc coating dey react with acid and dissolve as $\mathrm{Zn}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Zn^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2}$. Acidic food get pH 4 or below so di reaction dey fast.
c-200.example: If you leave lemonade or vinegar pickle wey get pH about 3 inside galvanized bucket for several hours for camping, zinc fit dissolve to tens of mg/L and e get risk of vomiting and nausea. Di recommended daily intake for adults na about 8 to 11mg.
c-200.actionItem: Today for camping or outdoor cooking, use only containers wey get food-grade mark, and use galvanized bucket only to fetch water.

c-201.title: For imported ceramic cup, check lead leaching from glaze
c-201.summary: Imported ceramic cup wey get shiny glaze fit leach lead into acidic drink. Check di food-grade mark and lead leaching test result, and no keep acidic drink inside for long.
c-201.principle: Lead compounds for glaze dey dissolve into acid as $\mathrm{PbO}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pb^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2O}$. Di lower di pH, like vinegar or fruit juice, and di longer di time, di more di leaching.
c-201.example: For test wey dem soak am inside 4% acetic acid for 24 hours, di Korean standard for cups na lead leaching of 0.4mg/L or below. Decorative ceramics wey no get test report fit exceed dis standard.
c-201.actionItem: Today for imported ceramic cups, check di food-grade mark and safety test result, and no put acidic drinks like juice or wine inside decorative cups wey no dey confirmed.

c-202.title: Perfume wey you leave inside car, di scent dey change
c-202.summary: If you leave perfume inside hot car, di scent go change and di fresh feeling go disappear. Keep am for cool, dark place.
c-202.principle: Light top-note molecules of perfume dey highly volatile, so as temperature rise, vapour pressure dey increase and dem dey evaporate quick. Vapour pressure dey grow exponentially with temperature as $\ln P=-\frac{\Delta H_{\mathrm{vap}}}{RT}+C$, and heat, light and oxygen dey oxidize di scent components.
c-202.example: For mid-summer, di interior of parked car fit rise to 60℃ or above, so volatilization na several times faster than for 20℃ room. If you leave am for few weeks, di citrus top note fit reduce and di colour fit darken.
c-202.actionItem: Today, keep perfume for cool dark drawer instead of inside car or bathroom, and close di cap tight after use.

c-203.title: Ointment and cream wey you leave inside car for summer dey separate
c-203.summary: If you leave ointment or cream inside car for summer, water and oil fit separate and di components fit change so di effect go reduce. Keep medicine for di temperature wey dem write for di product (usually 30℃ or below).
c-203.principle: Cream na emulsion wey water and oil mix, and emulsifier dey stabilize di interface. As temperature rise, di effect of emulsifier and di viscosity dey drop so droplets dey merge and phase separation dey happen. Reaction rate dey sensitive to temperature as $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-203.example: For mid-summer, di interior of parked car fit rise above 60℃, and cream fit turn watery or oil fit float within few hours. Product wey don separate once fit no return to di original state even if you mix am again.
c-203.actionItem: Today wen you dey go out, no leave ointment, sunscreen or medicine inside car, put dem inside your bag and carry dem.

c-204.title: For camping alcohol stove, methanol and ethanol no be di same
c-204.summary: As fuel for camping alcohol stove, methanol dey toxic and its flame hardly visible so e dangerous, and denatured ethanol na safer choice. Check say di fire don light, and put out di fire wen you wan add fuel.
c-204.principle: Ethanol combustion na $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+3\mathrm{H_2O}$, and methanol combustion na $2\mathrm{CH_3OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+4\mathrm{H_2O}$. Methanol flame almost transparent and di body dey metabolize am to formic acid and others, so e very toxic.
c-204.example: Heat of combustion of ethanol na about 27kJ/g and methanol about 20kJ/g, so for di same amount ethanol dey give more heat. Even small amount of methanol wey you swallow fit cause blindness and poisoning.
c-204.actionItem: Today wen you dey use alcohol stove, check di fuel type, and refill fuel only after di fire don go off and e don cool.

c-205.title: No keep grass trimmer petrol for more than three months
c-205.summary: Petrol wey you dey use as fuel for grass trimmer or generator, if you keep am for more than three months, e go spoil and engine no go start well and carburettor go block. Buy only wetin you go use, and if some remain, use fuel stabilizer.
c-205.principle: Di light components of petrol dey evaporate and sticky gum dey form by oxidation and e dey block di fuel line. Petrol wey get ethanol dey absorb water and phase separate. Oxidation dey proceed through $\mathrm{RH}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow$ peroxides and others.
c-205.example: For sealed container, petrol fit start to get problem after usually 3 to 6 months, and ethanol-blend fuel after 1 to 3 months. If you fill di container full and keep am cool, air contact go reduce and e go last longer.
c-205.actionItem: Today if you no plan to use grass trimmer for long, empty di fuel or add stabilizer, and seal di remaining fuel and keep am for cool place.

c-206.title: If you put petrol inside diesel car, turn off di engine first
c-206.summary: If you put petrol by mistake inside diesel car, no start di engine, call tow truck immediately. Di fuel pump and injectors fit damage.
c-206.principle: Diesel engine dey use compression ignition (e dey compress air to high pressure and heat so e dey ignite by itself), but petrol hard to ignite and e get low viscosity so e no dey lubricate. Compression ratio of diesel engine na about $\varepsilon=15\sim 20$.
c-206.example: If petrol mix, lubrication for di high-pressure pump go weaken, metal wear fit happen, and repair cost fit reach several million won. If you no start di engine and empty di fuel tank, you fit usually prevent di damage.
c-206.actionItem: Today wen you dey refuel, check di colour of di nozzle handle and di fuel type, and if you put wrong one, no turn on di ignition key and contact mechanic.

c-207.title: Urea solution (AdBlue) dey spoil for high summer temperature
c-207.summary: If you keep urea solution for long for high temperature, di urea go decompose, di concentration go drop and ammonia smell go come out. Keep am for shady cool place and no use old one.
c-207.principle: Urea solution (32.5% urea aqueous solution) dey hydrolyze and release ammonia by $\mathrm{(NH_2)_2CO}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{NH_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$, and for SCR system e dey reduce nitrogen oxides by $4\mathrm{NH_3}+4\mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 4\mathrm{N_2}+6\mathrm{H_2O}$.
c-207.example: Urea solution usually last about 1 year for 25℃ or below, but for 30℃ or above e go reduce to several months, and for 50℃ environment of car trunk, quality fit drop within few weeks. Di concentration go deviate from di standard 32.5%.
c-207.actionItem: Today keep urea solution for cool place without direct sunlight, and check di condition of bottle wey you don leave for car trunk for long before you use am.

c-208.title: Engine oil, look oxidation and additive depletion, no be only mileage
c-208.summary: Time to change engine oil dey depend not only on mileage but also on time, number of short trips, and hot weather. Use di period wey manufacturer set as basis, but change am earlier for severe conditions.
c-208.principle: Engine oil dey oxidize for high temperature so viscosity dey increase and sludge dey form, and additives like detergent-dispersants dey deplete so di ability to catch acid and soot dey reduce. Oxidation rate na $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ and e roughly double for every rise of about 10℃.
c-208.example: If manufacturer recommend 10,000km or 1 year, for severe conditions like only short trips or driving for heatwave, e better to change am within about 5,000 to 7,500km or 6 months. Even if you drive only 5,000km a year, change am after 1 year.
c-208.actionItem: Today, check di change interval from di service sticker or car manual and compare am with di date of your last change.

c-209.title: Dey benefit dey if you put nitrogen inside tyres?
c-209.summary: If you put nitrogen inside tyres, pressure dey drop slightly less, but di effect no big. Di most important thing na di habit to check air pressure once a month, no be di type of gas.
c-209.principle: Rubber dey allow oxygen pass about 3 to 4 times more than nitrogen. Air na about 78% N$_2$ and 21% O$_2$, so nitrogen filling dey reduce O$_2$ permeation and slow di pressure loss. For fixed volume, pressure na $P=\frac{nRT}{V}$ and e dey proportional to number of moles and temperature.
c-209.example: Ordinary air tyre dey lose about 1 to 2psi (about 7 to 14kPa) a month and nitrogen dey lose slightly less than dat. Di effect wey pressure reduce by about 1psi wen temperature drop 10℃ dey happen for both nitrogen and air.
c-209.actionItem: Today, measure tyre pressure wen di tyres cold and set am to di specified pressure wey dem write for di car door frame.

c-210.title: Packed lunch wey stay for room temperature still keep toxins even if you boil am again
c-210.summary: If packed lunch or kimbap wey you leave for room temperature for summer start to spoil, even if you reheat or boil am, toxins go remain and fit cause food poisoning. If you dey suspicious, throw am away.
c-210.principle: Enterotoxins wey Staphylococcus aureus produce as e dey multiply for room temperature dey strong against heat, and most of dem remain even if you heat for 100℃ for more than 30 minutes. Even if di bacteria die, di protein structure of di toxin no easily break, so symptoms dey occur.
c-210.example: Di bacteria dey multiply fast for 20 to 37℃ and fit produce toxins within few hours, and vomiting and stomach pain fit come within 1 to 6 hours after you chop am. Food wey you leave for room temperature for more than 2 hours after cooking (1 hour if 30℃ or above) dey dangerous.
c-210.actionItem: Today, put lunch box inside cooler bag with ice pack, and no chop food wey you don leave for room temperature for more than 2 hours after cooking, throw am away.

c-211.title: No wash dishes with detergent for valley stream or sea
c-211.summary: If you wash dishes with detergent for valley stream or beach, di water go pollute, fish go die and algal bloom fit form. Wash dishes for di place wey campsite designate.
c-211.principle: Surfactants for detergent dey damage di gill membranes of aquatic organisms, and phosphates dey increase nitrogen and phosphorus nutrients and cause algae to explode and cause eutrophication. Wen algae die, oxygen dey get use for decomposition so dissolved oxygen (DO) dey reduce.
c-211.example: Even one drop of ordinary kitchen detergent (about 0.05mL) fit affect aquatic life for tens of litres of water. If dissolved oxygen for river drop below 5mg/L, e hard for fish to live.
c-211.actionItem: Today for outdoors, carry food scraps comot, and wash dishes for di wastewater disposal place for di campsite.

c-212.title: Mosquito dey follow breath and sweat smell
c-212.summary: Mosquito dey follow di carbon dioxide wey person dey breathe out and di lactic acid smell for sweat to find where to bite. If you wipe sweat and apply repellent, you fit reduce di chance of bite.
c-212.principle: Receptors for mosquito antennae dey track concentration gradient, moving to di side wey CO$_2$ and lactic acid ($\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$) concentration high. CO$_2$ for exhaled breath na about 4%, wey be 100 times di air (about 0.04%).
c-212.example: Person dey breathe out about 1kg of CO$_2$ a day, and after exercise di lactic acid for sweat dey increase so mosquito fit come from tens of metres away. Products wey get 10 to 30% DEET usually dey protect for several hours.
c-212.actionItem: Today, before you go outside, wipe sweat, apply repellent on exposed skin and clothes, and empty standing water.

c-213.title: Sewer smell from drain dey come up wen water seal dry
c-213.summary: If sewer smell dey come up from drain, e likely say di water inside di trap (water seal) don dry. Pour one bucket of water to fill di water seal and block di smell.
c-213.principle: Di water wey dey gather for di U-shaped part of di trap (water seal) dey block sewage gas. If di water seal evaporate, hydrogen sulfide ($\mathrm{H_2S}$) wey microbes for sewage produce go come up. Di depth of di water seal na usually about 50mm.
c-213.example: Water seal for bathroom floor drain wey no dey used fit dry within 1 to 2 weeks and smell fit come. If you pour about 500mL of water, di water seal go fill again. For summer, evaporation dey fast so e dey dry more often.
c-213.actionItem: Today, pour one bucket of water inside di unused bathroom and balcony drain to fill di water seal, and repeat once a month.

c-214.title: Why air conditioner get sour smell
c-214.summary: Di sour smell from air conditioner dey happen because bacteria and mould don grow inside for di condensate and dust wey gather. You fit reduce am if you dry di inside with fan mode before you turn am off.
c-214.principle: Water wey condense for di surface of di cooling fins dey form as $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}\rightarrow \mathrm{H_2O(l)}$, and microbes dey multiply inside dust and organic matter and volatile metabolites (fatty acids, alcohols and others) dey create di sour smell.
c-214.example: If you turn am off immediately after cooling operation, inside humidity remain above 80% and bacteria go multiply easily. If you run fan for 10 to 30 minutes before you turn am off, most of di inside go dry and di smell go reduce well.
c-214.actionItem: Today, before you turn off di air conditioner, run am for fan mode for 15 minutes and take out di filter to shake off di dust and dry am.

c-215.title: Di white thing for chocolate no be mould
c-215.summary: Di white patch for chocolate surface usually no be mould, na fat bloom wey cocoa butter melt and harden and rise up. Di taste only go turn slightly rough, e safe to chop.
c-215.principle: Cocoa butter get many crystal forms (polymorphs), and di stable form V dey transition to di more stable form VI as temperature change and e dey rise to di surface and look white. Di melting temperature of form V na about 34℃.
c-215.example: If you store am at 28℃ or above or di temperature dey go up and down often, bloom fit form within few days to few weeks. Di best temperature to store chocolate na about 15 to 18℃ and relative humidity 50% or below.
c-215.actionItem: Today, keep chocolate for cool place without direct sunlight, and wen you take am out of di fridge, leave am for room temperature inside di package to prevent condensation.

c-216.title: Mackerel and tuna dey produce histamine if you leave dem for room temperature
c-216.summary: Red-flesh fish like mackerel, tuna and saury, if you leave dem for room temperature for long, dem dey produce histamine and e fit cause facial flushing, headache and hives. Heat no dey remove am, so keep dem fresh.
c-216.principle: Bacterial histidine decarboxylase dey convert di histidine for fish to histamine: $\mathrm{C_6H_9N_3O_2}\rightarrow \mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$. Histamine dey stable against heat so even cooking almost no destroy am.
c-216.example: Histamine fit form within few hours for room temperature (25℃) and e much slower for 4℃ refrigeration. Di food standard na usually 200mg/kg or below, and if you chop 100mg or more, symptoms fit occur.
c-216.actionItem: Today, refrigerate or freeze red-flesh fish immediately after you buy am, and no chop fish wey you leave for room temperature for more than 2 hours.

c-217.title: Why old tent and raincoat dey turn sticky
c-217.summary: Di inside waterproof coating of old tent or raincoat dey turn sticky and peel because di polyurethane don hydrolyze from moisture and heat. If you store am completely dry, you fit slow am down.
c-217.principle: Di ester bonds of di polyurethane (PU) coating dey react with water and break as $\mathrm{R{-}COO{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow \mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{R'{-}OH}$, di chains dey short and e dey turn sticky. Di hotter and more humid e be, di faster e go be.
c-217.example: PU-coated tent dey usually begin hydrolysis after 3 to 5 years. If you fold am wet and keep am for place above 30℃, stickiness fit form even within one season.
c-217.actionItem: Today, spread tent and raincoat after dem completely dry and store dem for cool place, and if e don start to turn sticky, consider to replace am with new one.

c-218.title: Why capsule detergent remain as lump
c-218.summary: Capsule detergent dey remain as lump without dissolving because of cold water or small water or overloading. Put di capsule first for di bottom of di drum and put di laundry on top.
c-218.principle: Di PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) film wey cover di capsule dey dissolve for water, and di dissolving speed dey depend strongly on water temperature. Di speed dey slow as temperature low, like $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, so e no dey dissolve well for cold water.
c-218.example: PVA film dey dissolve for about 1 to 3 minutes for 40℃ water, but for cold water below 15℃ e fit take more than 10 minutes. If you put too much laundry, di capsule go get pressed by di cloth and water no go reach am.
c-218.actionItem: Today, no touch capsule detergent with wet hand, put am first inside di washing drum and put di laundry on top, and use liquid detergent for cold water cycle.

c-219.title: Camping glow stick dey glow by chemical reaction
c-219.summary: Camping glow stick, if you snap am, di two liquids inside dey mix and produce light by chemical reaction. E dey glow without electricity or heat, and if e warm e go brighter and short, if e cold e go dim and last long.
c-219.principle: Hydrogen peroxide and oxalate ester inside di glass tube dey react and form high-energy intermediate, and dis energy dey excite fluorescent dye to emit light (chemiluminescence). Reaction rate dey sensitive to temperature as $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-219.example: Glow stick dey usually glow 6 to 12 hours for 20℃, but for 40℃ e go brighter and go off within 1 to 2 hours, and if you put am inside freezer di light go weaken and go brighten again if you warm am. E almost no produce heat so fire risk low.
c-219.actionItem: Today for night camping or power outage preparation, put one or two glow sticks inside your bag, and if di liquid inside leak, make sure e no touch your skin.

c-220.title: Fireworks colour na flame test of metal elements
c-220.summary: Di colours of fireworks na light wey metal elements wey dem mix for gunpowder dey emit. Strontium dey give red, copper dey give blue, and barium dey give green.
c-220.principle: Di heat of di flame dey excite di electrons of metal atoms, and wen di electrons return to lower energy level, dem dey emit light wey match $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$. Each element get different energy levels so e dey produce unique colour.
c-220.example: Sr dey give red of about 650nm, Ba dey give green of about 520nm, Cu dey give blue of about 450nm, and Na dey give yellow of about 589nm. Blue na di hardest to make because copper compounds dey easily decompose above about 1,200℃.
c-220.actionItem: Today if you watch fireworks, try guess which metal na wetin you see from di colour, and no go near am because gunpowder smoke residue dey.

c-221.title: Disinfect water with transparent PET bottle and sunlight
c-221.summary: If you put clear water inside transparent PET bottle and leave am under sun for 6 hours, e be emergency disinfection method (SODIS) wey dey reduce pathogens. Cloudy water must dey filtered first and e no be perfect drinking water treatment.
c-221.principle: Ultraviolet A (320 to 400nm) and heat dey damage di DNA and proteins of pathogens and inactivate dem. Di effect dey proportional to di UV dose $H=I\,t$ (illuminance × time), and if water temperature na 50℃ or above, di effect dey increase well.
c-221.example: If you put water inside 1 to 2L transparent PET bottle for 6 hours for clear day, e dey reduce most bacteria, and if sky cloudy e need two days. If turbidity pass 30 NTU, di effect dey drop.
c-221.actionItem: Today if you wan test am for emergency, use only clean water and lay di bottle for sun for 6 hours, but normally prefer boiled or purified water.

c-222.title: Cling film PVC and PE no be di same
c-222.summary: Two types of cling film dey: PVC and PE (polyethylene), and each material get different safe range for microwave use and contact with fatty food. Check di material and heat resistance temperature for di packaging.
c-222.principle: PVC film get plasticizer for flexibility, and if e touch fatty food or e dey heated, di plasticizer fit migrate into di food. PE film no need plasticizer and im heat resistance temperature na about 110℃, wey differ from PVC (some products show about 130℃ or above).
c-222.example: If cling film touch food wey you dey heat for microwave, fatty food fit pass 100℃ and di film fit melt or plasticizer fit migrate. Leave 2 to 3cm of space between di cling film and di food.
c-222.actionItem: Today before you use cling film, check di material and heat resistance mark, and for microwave, use am so e no touch di food.

c-223.title: When hot oil touch Styrofoam cup noodle container
c-223.summary: If you put hot oily food inside Styrofoam (polystyrene) container, di container go soften and small styrene component fit dissolve out. Follow di heat resistance temperature wey dem write for di container.
c-223.principle: Polystyrene dey soften around glass transition temperature of about 100℃, and e dey dissolve well for oil so styrene monomer ($\mathrm{C_8H_8}$) fit migrate into di food. Di migration amount dey increase with temperature and contact time.
c-223.example: Cup noodle soup of about 90℃ dey below di softening point of polystyrene so e generally dey within acceptable range, but hot cooking oil or very oily food above 100℃ fit melt di container. Use disposable container only once.
c-223.actionItem: Today, move hot oily food comot from Styrofoam container to heat-resistant glass or ceramic bowl.

c-224.title: Biodegradable plastic bag no dey rot for house
c-224.summary: Most biodegradable plastic bags dey decompose only for di high temperature of composting facilities, and dem almost no dey rot for home garden or dustbin. Follow di recycling mark.
c-224.principle: PLA (polylactic acid) dey hydrolyze to $(\mathrm{C_3H_4O_2})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow n\,\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$ (lactic acid) by reacting with water. Dis reaction dey speed up above glass transition temperature of about 58℃, so e need industrial composting conditions (about 58℃, humid environment).
c-224.example: For industrial composting facility (58℃, moist), PLA dey decompose in about 90 to 180 days, but for 20℃ home environment e fit take several years or almost no decompose. E no dey decompose well for sea too.
c-224.actionItem: Today if you receive bag wey get biodegradable mark, put am for general waste, and if possible use reusable shopping bag.

c-225.title: Why garden hose dey crack and crumble under sunlight
c-225.summary: Garden hose wey you leave outdoors dey turn hard and crack as years dey pass because di ultraviolet rays of sunlight dey break di polymer chains. When you no dey use am, coil am for shade.
c-225.principle: UV photon energy $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$ dey break di C–Cl and C–H bonds of polymers like PVC to make radicals, and dem react with oxygen and di chains dey cut. As di chains short, di material become brittle.
c-225.example: Garden hoses wey get UV stabilizer dey last 3 to 5 years, but if you leave am under sunlight all di time, plasticizer fit escape and e fit crack within 1 to 2 years. Midsummer noon wey UV index high na di most harmful.
c-225.actionItem: Today after you use di hose, drain di water and coil am for shade or inside di hose reel box so e go avoid sunlight.

c-226.title: Why rubber band and rubber gloves dey crack
c-226.summary: Rubber band or rubber gloves dey one day crack and break because ozone for di air dey attack di double bonds of di rubber. If you store am stretched, e go crack faster.
c-226.principle: Ozone dey add to di C=C double bonds of natural rubber (polyisoprene) to become $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{O_3}\rightarrow$ ozonide and di bond dey break. Cracks dey form easily in vertical direction for di surface of di stretched state.
c-226.example: Ozone concentration for air na usually 0.02 to 0.06ppm, and even at dis level stretched rubber fit crack within few weeks to few months. If you store am for cool place, di lifespan go increase well.
c-226.actionItem: Today, store rubber bands and rubber gloves unstretched, sealed inside cool dark drawer.

c-227.title: Why white sneakers dey turn yellow
c-227.summary: White sneakers dey turn yellow even if you just store dem because di polyurethane for di sole dey oxidize by light and oxygen and di phenolic antioxidant dey change. Store dem for cool dark place.
c-227.principle: Di aromatic components of polyurethane dey oxidize by UV and oxygen to form yellow chromophores, and phenolic antioxidants dey react with nitrogen oxides to turn yellow quinone-type substances. Photo-oxidation rate dey increase in proportion to di UV dose.
c-227.example: If you keep am for bright window, e go turn yellow noticeably within few weeks to few months, and e dey progress several times faster than for dark shoe cabinet. Di yellowing dey form for thin surface layer so oxygen bleach fit reduce part of am.
c-227.actionItem: Today, keep white sneakers for breathable dark shoe cabinet instead of sunny window, and put dem inside cotton bag instead of plastic.

c-228.title: Why new jeans colour dey fade for first wash
c-228.summary: Blue dye dey comot from new jeans for first wash because indigo dye only stick as particles for di fibre surface. For di first time, wash am alone inside out for cold water.
c-228.principle: Indigo na dye wey no dissolve for water, so dem dye am for reduced (water-soluble) form and e oxidize for air to become insoluble particles wey stick to di fibre surface. E no chemically bond with di fibre, e just stick outside, so friction and water dey wash am comot.
c-228.example: One pair of new jeans (about 600g) fit lose about 1 to 2g of dye for di first wash, so if you wash am with white clothes, dem go turn blue. For cold water (30℃ or below) di dye loss small.
c-228.actionItem: Today, wash new jeans alone for di first time, inside out for cold water, and no mix am with white clothes, and dry am for shade.

c-229.title: Fresh cement na alkaline so e dey burn skin
c-229.summary: Wet cement and concrete na strong alkali, so if e touch you and you no know and stay long, chemical burn go form for skin.
c-229.principle: Di calcium component of cement dey meet water to form $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ and pH dey become about 12.5, and alkali dey hydrolyze skin proteins and fats and dissolve tissue. $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$
c-229.example: Cases dey reported where person kneel on wet concrete for 1 to 2 hours and get second-degree burn without pain. pH 12.5 na about 300,000 times higher in $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ than pH 7.
c-229.actionItem: If cement touch you, brush off di dry powder and wash with running water for at least 15 minutes, and today for work, wear waterproof gloves and long trousers.

c-230.title: Be careful of heat and gas wen you use drain unblocker
c-230.summary: Caustic soda drain cleaner dey get hot wen e dissolve for water, and if e meet aluminium, hydrogen gas dey come out.
c-230.principle: NaOH dey release about 44.5kJ/mol of heat wen e dissolve for water, and with aluminium e dey make hydrogen. $2\mathrm{Al} + 2\mathrm{NaOH} + 6\mathrm{H_2O} \to 2\mathrm{Na[Al(OH)_4]} + 3\mathrm{H_2}$
c-230.example: If 100g (2.5 mol) of NaOH dissolve, about 111kJ dey release, wey fit raise 1L of water by about 26℃. For narrow pipe, e fit get hotter locally and boil and splash.
c-230.actionItem: Today if you dey use drain cleaner, ventilate, wear safety goggles and gloves, and never mix am with other cleaners or aluminium container.

c-231.title: Epoxy glue must mix exactly 1 to 1 before e go harden
c-231.summary: Epoxy must meet resin and hardener for di fixed ratio before e go harden strongly, and if di ratio wrong, e go remain sticky.
c-231.principle: Epoxy groups and di active hydrogens of amines dey react for 1:1 equivalent and form network structure. Di amount of hardener dey determined by $m_{\mathrm{hardener}} = \frac{\mathrm{AHEW}}{\mathrm{EEW}} \times m_{\mathrm{resin}}$.
c-231.example: If you mix 5mL of resin and 5mL of hardener (1:1), if di ratio deviate by 20% or more, stickiness easily remain. Full cure usually na about 24 hours, and you must wait one day before e go bear load.
c-231.actionItem: Today if you dey use epoxy, measure am according to di ratio for di product manual, scrape and mix am to di bottom for at least 2 minutes, and apply thin layer.

c-232.title: Aquarium water dey stabilize as ammonia turn nitrate
c-232.summary: New aquarium dey build up ammonia and nitrite until nitrifying bacteria grow, and e dey dangerous for fish.
c-232.principle: Nitrifying bacteria dey convert toxic ammonia to nitrite, and again to less toxic nitrate. $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + 1.5\,O_2 \to NO_2^- + 2H^+ + H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NO_2^- + 0.5\,O_2 \to NO_3^-}$
c-232.example: New aquarium usually take 4 to 6 weeks to stabilize, and e safe to add more fish after ammonia and nitrite reach 0ppm. Manage nitrate below 40ppm with 20 to 30% water change once a week.
c-232.actionItem: Today, measure ammonia, nitrite and nitrate with aquarium test strip, and wen you dey change water, no wash di filter media with tap water, rinse am inside di aquarium water wey you remove.

c-233.title: No pour water on oil fire, cover am with lid
c-233.summary: If you pour water on fire wey dey burn for oil, di burning oil go splash everywhere with steam.
c-233.principle: Fire need fuel, oxygen and heat all together to burn, so you must cut off oxygen with lid. Water dey sink under di oil and boil instantly and di volume dey increase about 1,700 times. $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(g)}$
c-233.example: If 1 cup (200mL) of water touch oil wey pass 300℃, about 340L of steam go form instantly and fit spray di burning oil reach ceiling.
c-233.actionItem: Today, keep lid wey fit di size of pot near your kitchen gas stove for where you fit reach am, and remember di order: if fire start, turn off di fire and cover am with lid.

c-234.title: Why you dey feel sleepy if you leave only recirculation on for long-distance driving
c-234.summary: If you use only recirculation mode for long, carbon dioxide go build up inside di car and drowsiness and reduced concentration fit come.
c-234.principle: For closed interior, CO2 wey breathing produce no dey ventilate so di concentration dey rise in proportion to time. $\Delta C \approx \frac{G}{V}\,t$ ($G$: generation rate, $V$: interior volume)
c-234.example: Outdoor CO2 na about 420ppm, but for car wey get several people, if you use only recirculation for 30 minutes to 1 hour, e don dey measured to pass 2,000ppm. Generally, drowsiness don dey reported from 1,000ppm and above.
c-234.actionItem: Today wen you dey drive, switch to fresh air mode every 20 to 30 minutes or open di window briefly to ventilate.

c-235.title: Run di first tap water for morning for small time
c-235.summary: Water wey stay inside pipes overnight fit get metal ions wey dissolve inside am, so e better to run am small before you use am.
c-235.principle: Copper and lead for pipes and taps dey slowly oxidize into di water and dissolve out. $\mathrm{Pb \to Pb^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{Cu \to Cu^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Di longer di stagnation time, di higher di concentration.
c-235.example: For water wey don stay for more than 6 hours, run am for 30 seconds to 1 minute until cold water dey come out before you use am. For 6L per minute, 1 minute na about 6L, and if you use dis water for plants or cleaning, e no be waste.
c-235.actionItem: This morning, before you put cup, run water for 30 seconds to 1 minute and collect am to use for plants or mopping.

c-236.title: Even if you drink alkaline water, e go neutralize for stomach soon
c-236.summary: Even if you drink alkaline water, stomach acid go neutralize am soon and e no fit change di pH of your body, so small reason dey to pay high price.
c-236.principle: Gastric juice na about 0.01 to 0.1 M HCl wey get pH 1.5 to 3.5, and di $\mathrm{OH^-}$ of alkaline water dey react immediately with stomach acid. $\mathrm{HCl + OH^- \to H_2O + Cl^-}$
c-236.example: 1L of pH 9 alkaline water get only $\mathrm{OH^-}$ of $10^{-5}$ mol, so e dey neutralize only 1% of 100mL of pH 2 gastric juice (H+ $10^{-3}$ mol). Blood pH dey maintained at 7.35 to 7.45 by breathing and di kidneys.
c-236.actionItem: Before you buy alkaline water product, check di health benefit claims wey no get evidence, and today, drink ordinary tap water or purified water to stay hydrated enough.

c-237.title: Dem no get much benefit if you keep batteries inside fridge
c-237.summary: Modern alkaline batteries get very slow self-discharge even for room temperature, so di benefit of refrigerated storage small and condensation risk dey.
c-237.principle: Self-discharge na chemical reaction so e dey fast by Arrhenius equation as temperature rise. $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ On di other hand, if you lower di temperature, e go slow, but alkaline batteries already very slow.
c-237.example: Alkaline batteries dey self-discharge only about 2 to 3% a year for 20℃ and dem fit last 5 to 10 years. Even if you refrigerate am, na only about 1% a year you go save, and water drops wey form wen you take am out fit corrode di terminals.
c-237.actionItem: Today, keep batteries for cool dry drawer, group dem by di same type, and no mix new and old ones for one device.

c-238.title: For camping charcoal, briquette, white charcoal and black charcoal no be di same
c-238.summary: Charcoal dey differ in ignition speed, smoke, and how long di heat last depending on di degree of carbonization, so choose am according to di use.
c-238.principle: Di higher di degree of carbonization, di less volatile matter and di higher di carbon ratio so e get less smoke and e dey burn longer. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ ($\Delta H \approx -394$ kJ/mol), and if oxygen no enough, e become $2\mathrm{C + O_2 \to 2CO}$.
c-238.example: 1kg of charcoal dey release about 29MJ (about 8kWh) of heat, and white charcoal wey dem bake at about 1,000℃ get less smoke and e dey burn long but e hard to light. Black charcoal dey light easily but e get more smoke and volatile matter, and briquette get plenty ash because of di binder.
c-238.actionItem: Today if you dey buy camping charcoal, choose am according to di purpose, and never burn charcoal inside tent or enclosed space (carbon monoxide poisoning risk).

c-239.title: Why you suppose chop carbohydrate immediately after exercise
c-239.summary: For di first 1 to 2 hours after exercise, di muscles dey take sugar best, so if you chop carbohydrate at dis time, glycogen go refill quick.
c-239.principle: Muscle glycogen wey exercise don empty dey resynthesize thanks to insulin and di muscle glucose transporter. $(\mathrm{Glucose})_n + \mathrm{Glucose} \to (\mathrm{Glucose})_{n+1}$
c-239.example: Muscles dey store about 400g of glycogen, and after hard exercise, to chop 1 banana (about 27g carbohydrate) and one glass of milk na enough for ordinary person. For ordinary exercise wey you go rest for one day or more, you no need to stick to dis time.
c-239.actionItem: Today if you exercise, within 1 hour after you finish, try to chop carbohydrate and protein together, like banana, one bowl of rice or milk.

c-240.title: Di bright colour of dried apricot na because of sulfite
c-240.summary: Orange dried apricots na sulfite dem use to prevent browning, and brown dried apricots na sign say dem no add anything, and people wey get asthma must be careful.
c-240.principle: $\mathrm{SO_2}$ dissolve in water to become bisulfite ion and e dey inhibit browning enzymes and oxidation. $\mathrm{SO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HSO_3^- + H^+}$
c-240.example: Sulfur-treated dried apricot fit usually still get hundreds to 2,000mg/kg of $\mathrm{SO_2}$, and many countries require labelling for 10mg/kg or more. Asthma patients wey dey sensitive to sulfite fit get difficulty to breathe.
c-240.actionItem: Today wen you dey buy dried fruit, check 'sulfite (sulphur dioxide)' for di ingredient label, and if you dey sensitive, choose brown sulfur-free product.

c-241.title: Low-sodium salt get plenty potassium so kidney disease patients must be careful
c-241.summary: Low-sodium salt na one wey dem replace part of sodium with potassium, so people wey get kidney disease or wey dey take medicine wey dey remove potassium must consult doctor.
c-241.principle: E dey reduce sodium by replacing part of $\mathrm{NaCl}$ with $\mathrm{KCl}$, but potassium intake dey increase. By mass, Na na 39.3% of NaCl and K na 52.4% of KCl.
c-241.example: 5g of product wey get 70% sodium and 30% potassium get about 1.4g sodium (30% less than 2.0g for 5g of ordinary salt) and about 0.79g potassium. If kidney function drop, potassium go build up and arrhythmia risk dey.
c-241.actionItem: Today before you buy low-sodium salt, check di potassium chloride ratio for di ingredient list, and if you get kidney disease or you dey take related medicine, ask your doctor first.

c-242.title: 14K and 18K gold no be pure gold
c-242.summary: Di K (carat) number na pure gold content, so 18K na 75% gold, 14K na about 58%, and di rest na other metals.
c-242.principle: Purity dey expressed in 24ths. $\text{purity} = \frac{K}{24}$ If you alloy am, e go turn harder and di colour go change, and 24K pure gold soft and e be about 99.9%.
c-242.example: 10g 18K ring get 7.5g pure gold, and 14K get about 5.8g. For Korean marking, 18K na usually engraved 750 and 14K na 585.
c-242.actionItem: Today wen you dey buy gold product, check di engraving (750, 585 and so on) and weight and calculate di pure gold content yourself.

c-243.title: Coffee beans dey oxidize as gas dey escape after roasting
c-243.summary: Coffee beans dey release carbon dioxide immediately after roasting and then dem dey gradually oxidize, so e good to drink dem within about 1 to 4 weeks from di roasting date.
c-243.principle: Di $\mathrm{CO_2}$ wey roasting produce dey slowly escape, and aroma components and fats dey react with oxygen and spoil. $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$
c-243.example: 1g of coffee beans dey release few mL of CO2 after roasting, and wen you grind am, di surface area dey increase so di aroma dey reduce well within few minutes to few hours. Beans wey you store for room temperature after opening usually dey noticeably lose flavour in 2 to 4 weeks.
c-243.actionItem: Today wen you dey buy coffee beans, choose product wey get roasting date, grind am immediately wen you wan drink, and keep am sealed for cool place without light (refrigerated storage get moisture risk).

c-244.title: Why oil-repellent coating for phone screen dey peel off
c-244.summary: Di fingerprint-resistant coating for phone screen na thin film of few to tens of nm, so e dey gradually wear off as you wipe and rub am.
c-244.principle: Fluorine-based polymer film dey lower surface energy so oil droplets dey bead instead of spreading. Di contact angle dey determined by $\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{SV} - \gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$, and wen di film wear, $\theta$ go reduce.
c-244.example: Di thickness of oil-repellent film na roughly few to tens of nm, wey be about one ten-thousandth of di thickness of hair (about 80,000nm). If sand and keys for pocket dey rub am and you dey clean with alcohol repeatedly, e go wear noticeably within few months to 2 years.
c-244.actionItem: From today, wipe di screen with dry microfibre cloth, and no use wet wipes wey get plenty alcohol or rough cloth.

c-245.title: Remove plastic from dry-cleaned clothes and air dem
c-245.summary: Clothes wey just comot from dry cleaning fit still get solvent inside, so you must remove di plastic and air dem before you wear or store dem.
c-245.principle: Di cleaning solvent perchloroethylene get boiling point 121℃ and vapour pressure of about 1.9kPa for 20℃, so e dey evaporate slowly. $\mathrm{C_2Cl_4(l) \to C_2Cl_4(g)}$ If you trap am inside plastic, di vapour no fit escape.
c-245.example: If you leave clothes inside wardrobe with di plastic on, di vapour go trap and smell and exposure go increase. If you hang dem for place wey get breeze for some hours to one day, most of am go fly comot. Some laundries dey use petroleum-based solvent.
c-245.actionItem: Today, comot di plastic from clothes wey you collect from laundry immediately and hang dem for balcony or well-ventilated place for some hours.

c-246.title: Condensing boiler dey recover heat from water vapour for exhaust gas
c-246.summary: Condensing boiler na boiler wey dey condense di water vapour for exhaust gas wey dem for throw away, and e dey use even dat latent heat for heating.
c-246.principle: When city gas burn, water dey form and $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$ when dis water vapour condense, latent heat of about 2.26MJ/kg dey release. To recover dis heat, di returning heating water must dey below about 55℃.
c-246.example: If you burn 1m³ of city gas, about 1.6kg of water go form and about 3.6MJ (about 10% of total heat) of extra latent heat go dey produce. So you fit save about 10 to 15% energy compared to ordinary boiler.
c-246.actionItem: Today, if you dey use condensing boiler, lower di heating set temperature (return temperature below 55℃) make condensation dey happen well.

c-247.title: Candle dey burn vaporised wax, no be melted wax
c-247.summary: Candle flame no be melted wax wey dey burn, na di wax vapour wey dey vaporise after wick suck am up.
c-247.principle: Melted wax dey climb di wick through capillary action, vaporise from heat, and di vapour dey react with oxygen. $\mathrm{C_{25}H_{52} + 38\,O_2 \to 25\,CO_2 + 26\,H_2O}$
c-247.example: One ordinary candle dey burn about 7g of wax per hour and e dey give about 80W of heat. If di wick too long, e go burn incompletely and soot go increase.
c-247.actionItem: Today, before you light candle, trim di wick to about 5mm to reduce soot, and no leave di place while di flame dey on.

c-248.title: Boil pasta with less water to reduce energy
c-248.summary: For 100g pasta, about 1L water dey enough, so if you change di habit of boiling 3L water, di heat go reduce well.
c-248.principle: Heat to boil water na $Q = mc\Delta T$, and pasta starch dey absorb water and gelatinise from 60 to 70℃, so you no need plenty water.
c-248.example: To raise 1L water from 20℃ to 100℃ need about 334kJ (0.093kWh), and if you reduce 3L to 1L, you go save about 0.19kWh each time. If you cover di pot when e dey boil, e go reduce more.
c-248.actionItem: Today, when you dey boil pasta, use only about 1L water per 100g, cover di pot while e dey boil, and stir often make e no stick.

c-249.title: If fluorescent tube break, ventilate first because of mercury
c-249.summary: Fluorescent tube get small mercury inside, so if e break, first comot people and pets, ventilate, and den clean am.
c-249.principle: Mercury na metal wey dey evaporate even for room temperature. $\mathrm{Hg(l) \to Hg(g)}$ Vapour pressure for 20℃ na about 0.16Pa, and for closed room di vapour go gather.
c-249.example: One compact fluorescent lamp (CFL) usually get few mg of mercury. After e break, ventilate for 5 to 10 minutes or more, no use vacuum cleaner, use thick paper and tape gather di pieces, seal dem, and throw dem inside di collection bin.
c-249.actionItem: Today, check di fluorescent tubes wey remain for house and di ones wey don finish dia life, put dem inside di original box, and know where di nearest used-tube collection bin dey.

c-250.title: Use less water for new-harvest rice than old rice
c-250.summary: New-harvest rice get plenty moisture, so you must use only about 90% of di usual cooking water so e no go soft too much.
c-250.principle: As rice dey old, moisture dey reduce and e dey absorb more water. Cooking water na roughly $m_{\mathrm{water}} = m_{\mathrm{rice}} \times r$, and $r$ na about 1.1 for new rice and about 1.2 for old rice.
c-250.example: For 2 cups rice (about 360mL), usual water na about 400mL, but for new rice, try reduce am by about 40mL to about 360mL. New rice moisture na about 15 to 16%, and old rice na 13 to 14%.
c-250.actionItem: Today, when you dey cook new rice, try use only about 90% of di usual water, and if e soft too much, reduce am more next time.

c-251.title: Mix pancake batter with cold water for short time make e crispy
c-251.summary: For pancake batter, if you mix am with cold water for short time, less chewy gluten go form and e go fry crispy.
c-251.principle: Glutenin and gliadin for flour dey form network (gluten) when dem meet water and dey receive mixing force. $\text{Glutenin} + \text{Gliadin} + \mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\text{mixing}} \text{gluten}$ Cold water dey slow dis process.
c-251.example: Put 1 cup of cold water into 1 cup of flour (about 120g) and stir only about 10 times, and e no matter if small lumps remain. If you replace about 20% of di flour with starch, di gluten go dilute and e go crispier.
c-251.actionItem: Today, if you go fry pancake, mix am with ice cold water for only 10 to 15 seconds, and no stir di batter long pass 10 minutes.

c-252.title: Blanch and soak bracken fern so di toxin go reduce
c-252.summary: Raw bracken fern get ptaquiloside, wey fit cause cancer, so you must boil and soak am before you eat, and even den e better no make you dey eat am often.
c-252.principle: Ptaquiloside dey break down with heat and alkali. $\text{Ptaquiloside} \xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{OH^-}} \text{Pterosin B}$ (non-toxic)
c-252.example: Boil am for 5 to 10 minutes in boiling water, den soak am for cold water for about one day, and if you add about 5g (0.5%) baking soda per 1L water, di breakdown go dey better. Even so e no go reach exactly zero, so no eat am often or plenty.
c-252.actionItem: Today, if you go use bracken fern, boil am well for boiling water, soak am for cold water, den cook am.

c-253.title: Why taro dey make you itch and di solution
c-253.summary: Taro skin and juice get needle-shaped calcium oxalate crystals, so if you touch am with bare hand, e go sting and itch.
c-253.principle: Calcium oxalate crystals (raphides) dey prick di skin and cause itching, and for acid or heat, some dey dissolve or lose dia effect. $\mathrm{CaC_2O_4 + 2H^+ \rightleftharpoons Ca^{2+} + H_2C_2O_4}$
c-253.example: Di crystals dey tens to hundreds of μm long (0.02 to 0.2mm), sharp enough to pierce di skin dead layer. When e itch, washing with warm water wey get small vinegar dey help, and boiling dey reduce di acrid taste well.
c-253.actionItem: Today, when you dey prepare taro, wear rubber gloves and peel am under running water.

c-254.title: Pine needles na natural preservative wey dey help songpyeon last
c-254.summary: Terpene for pine needles wey dem put under songpyeon get mild antibacterial effect, but e no be preservative, so you must still take care of storage.
c-254.principle: Terpenes like alpha-pinene for pine needles ($\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}}$) dey disrupt bacteria cell membranes and slow growth. Di effect weak, so e only dey help preservation by some hours to one day.
c-254.example: Songpyeon dey usually last one day for cool room temperature, for fridge di rice cake go harden (retrogradation), and if you freeze am, you fit keep am for about 1 month. If you trust only pine needles and leave am for room temperature for summer, e fit spoil.
c-254.actionItem: Today, after di remaining songpyeon cool, wrap dem one by one with plastic wrap and freeze dem, and steam dem before you eat.

c-255.title: Red ginseng na steamed one wey di saponin structure don change
c-255.summary: Red ginseng na fresh ginseng wey dem steam and dry, and for dis process, di sugars for ginseng saponins (ginsenosides) dey fall comot, so components wey dey only for red ginseng dey form.
c-255.principle: Steam heat and moisture dey hydrolyse di sugar chains of ginsenosides. $\text{Rb}_1 \xrightarrow{\text{steam, H}^+} \text{Rg}_3 + 2\ \text{glucose}$
c-255.example: Dem dey make red ginseng by steaming fresh ginseng for about 95 to 100℃ for some hours, den dem dry am, and for dis process components like Rg3, Rg5 and Rk1 dey form. We no fit say for sure say e get benefits, and ginsenoside content dey different for each product.
c-255.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy red ginseng product, compare di age (whether 6-year root) and di labelled ginsenoside content (Rg1+Rb1+Rg3 total).

c-256.title: White powder for grape skin no be pesticide
c-256.summary: Di cloudy white powder for grape skin na natural wax (bloom) wey di grape make by itself, and e also be sign say di grape fresh.
c-256.principle: Bloom na hydrophobic wax crystals like oleanolic acid ($\mathrm{C_{30}H_{48}O_3}$), e na natural waterproof layer wey dey prevent water evaporation and block mould and rain.
c-256.example: Di bloom layer thin well well, only few μm or less, and e easily wipe off when you touch am. Grapes wey get even bloom remaining mean say dem don touch less after harvest, so e dey help to judge freshness.
c-256.actionItem: Today, rinse grapes under running water for 30 seconds just before you eat dem, and no wash dem early.

c-257.title: Autumn leaves dey turn red because leaf dey make new pigment
c-257.summary: Yellow autumn leaves na di original colour wey dey show, but red leaves dey form because for autumn di leaf dey make new anthocyanin.
c-257.principle: When days short and weather cool, chlorophyll ($\mathrm{C_{55}H_{72}O_5N_4Mg}$) dey break down and di yellow of carotenoids go show, and if sugar gather, anthocyanin go form newly and make am red.
c-257.example: Red leaves dey sharper when day dey clear and make plenty sugar, and morning temperature drop to 5 to 10℃. For di opposite, for rainy and warm autumn, di colours go dull.
c-257.actionItem: Today, if you plan autumn leaves trip, check foliage prediction map using 1 to 2 weeks after minimum temperature start to be around 5℃.

c-258.title: No pick ginkgo fruit skin with bare hand
c-258.summary: If you touch di outer pulp of ginkgo fruit with bare hand, e fit cause dermatitis like poison ivy, and di smell na because of butyric acid.
c-258.principle: Ginkgolic acid (alkylphenol) for ginkgo pulp dey cause contact dermatitis, and di terrible smell na butyric acid. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2CH_2COOH}$
c-258.example: If ginkgo pulp juice touch your skin, red rash and itching fit show after some hours to one day. Butyric acid na di same family as di smell of spoiled butter or vomit.
c-258.actionItem: Today, for your autumn walk, no pick ginkgo fruits wey fall, and if you must, wear disposable gloves and handle dem inside bag.

c-259.title: Poisonous mushroom poison no go comot even if you boil or dry am
c-259.summary: Di poison of poisonous mushroom no dey comot even if you boil, dry, or check with silver spoon, so you must not eat wild mushroom wey expert never confirm.
c-259.principle: Amatoxin (alpha-amanitin) of death cap na heat-stable cyclic peptide, and e dey block RNA polymerase II and damage liver and kidney cells. $\text{Amatoxin} + \text{RNA polymerase II} \to \text{inactive complex}$
c-259.example: Di lethal dose na about 0.1mg/kg, and one death cap cap (about 50g) fit even kill adult. Symptoms only dey show after 6 to 24 hours, so e easy to be late.
c-259.actionItem: Today, if you see wild mushroom for mountain, no pick am, and if you don eat am and get vomiting or diarrhoea, go emergency room immediately and carry di mushroom wey you eat.

c-260.title: Why you must not burn autumn leaves and rubbish
c-260.summary: If you burn leaves and rubbish outside, incomplete combustion dey produce plenty fine dust and harmful substances, and if you burn plastic or PVC, dioxin go form.
c-260.principle: Outdoor burning wey lack oxygen dey make PAH and carbon monoxide by incomplete combustion. $2\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{CO}$ PVC $(\mathrm{C_2H_3Cl})_n$ fit produce hydrogen chloride and dioxin family when e burn.
c-260.example: About 57% of PVC mass na chlorine, so 1kg get about 570g of chlorine. Open burning of agricultural residue fit produce about 5 to 15g of fine dust per 1kg.
c-260.actionItem: Today, no burn leaves, gather dem and use dem as compost or dispose dem according to di local government collection method.

c-261.title: White powder for humidifier na tap water minerals
c-261.summary: Di white powder wey dey gather round ultrasonic humidifier na minerals like calcium and magnesium wey dissolve inside tap water.
c-261.principle: Ultrasonic humidifier no dey boil di water, e dey scatter am as fine droplets, and di salts wey dissolve for di water dey remain as solid particles after di droplets dry. If you boil, some hardness components go settle. $\mathrm{Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3 + CO_2 + H_2O}$
c-261.example: If tap water minerals na about 80mg/L and e spray 2.4L for one night of 8 hours, about 190mg of particles fit spread inside di air. Dis particles dey fine enough to reach di respiratory tract.
c-261.actionItem: Today, empty and rinse di humidifier tank every day before you refill am, and if possible use distilled water or heated or evaporative humidifier.

c-262.title: Why old books dey turn yellow
c-262.summary: Old books dey turn yellow and brittle because di acidic components and lignin inside di paper dey oxidise and break down.
c-262.principle: Lignin for acidic paper dey oxidise with light and oxygen and turn yellow, and acid dey hydrolyse cellulose and weaken di paper. $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H^+}} n\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-262.example: Paper wey get plenty lignin like newspaper (about 25% lignin) go turn yellow within few months, but neutral-paper books wey no get acid fit last hundreds of years. Di higher di humidity and temperature, di faster di reaction.
c-262.actionItem: Today, put precious books for cool and dry bookshelf wey no get direct sunlight, and no put newspaper cuttings between di books.

c-263.title: Tomato bottom dey rot black because of calcium shortage
c-263.summary: Blossom-end rot wey dey make tomato fruit bottom rot black dey happen not mainly because di soil lack calcium, but because di calcium no reach di fruit.
c-263.principle: Calcium ions dey move along with di water flow wey transpiration dey create, and di fruit tip wey transpire less water dey receive am late. If flow speed slow, supply go reduce. $J = C \times \dot{V}$ ($C$: calcium concentration, $\dot{V}$: water flow)
c-263.example: If watering dey irregular, calcium movement go break and symptoms go show, and e dey recommended to water steadily with about 25mm (2.5cm) per week. Water management dey more effective than putting plenty calcium for di soil.
c-263.actionItem: Today, water your tomatoes at regular intervals before di soil dry, no just give dem plenty water every few days, and mulch.

c-264.title: Charcoal ash na free potassium fertiliser for garden, but be careful
c-264.summary: Ash from burnt wood na alkaline fertiliser wey dey give potassium and calcium, but e dey harm acid-loving crops, and you no suppose use ash from charcoal wey get additives or painted wood.
c-264.principle: Di $\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ for ash dey dissolve for water to give potassium ions and hydroxide ions, and e dey raise di soil pH. $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons 2K^+ + HCO_3^- + OH^-}$
c-264.example: Wood ash pH na 10 to 13 and e get about 3 to 10% potassium (K₂O). Di recommended amount na about 100g (one or two handfuls) or less per m² per year, and no use am for blueberries or potatoes.
c-264.actionItem: Today, if you get pure wood ash wey don cool completely, sieve am, measure di soil pH, and sprinkle am thin only for neutral to alkaline beds.

c-265.title: If compost smell bad, add carbon
c-265.summary: If compost smell like ammonia or rot, na too much nitrogen, so mix am with carbon material like dry leaves.
c-265.principle: For microbes to work well, di carbon-to-nitrogen ratio must be about 30:1. $\mathrm{C/N} = \frac{m_C}{m_N} \approx 30$ If nitrogen too much, ammonia smell go dey through $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + OH^- \to NH_3 + H_2O}$.
c-265.example: Food waste C/N na about 15 to 20, dry leaves na 50 to 80, and sawdust na about 400. By volume, if you mix 1 part food waste with 2 to 3 parts brown material like dry leaves, di smell go reduce well.
c-265.actionItem: Today, if compost bin dey smell, add one bag of dry leaves or torn cardboard, mix am well, and give am air.

c-266.title: Undercooked kidney bean get lectin toxin
c-266.summary: Raw kidney beans or beans wey dem only half-cook at about 80℃ fit cause vomiting and diarrhoea because of lectin, so you must boil dem hard.
c-266.principle: Kidney bean lectin (phytohaemagglutinin) na protein, so you must heat am well at 100℃ before e go denature. $\text{active lectin} \xrightarrow{100^\circ\mathrm{C},\ \ge 10\ \text{min}} \text{denatured lectin}$ For about 80℃, di toxicity fit even increase by many times.
c-266.example: Just 4 to 5 raw red kidney beans fit cause nausea and vomiting within 1 to 3 hours, and dem report say low-temperature cooking at 80℃ fit make am about 5 times more toxic than raw beans. Canned beans don already cook.
c-266.actionItem: Today, if you dey use dry kidney beans, soak dem for more than 5 hours, throw di water away, boil dem hard for at least 10 minutes, and den cook dem for low fire.

c-267.title: No close plum syrup bottle lid tight
c-267.summary: Plum syrup dey produce carbon dioxide through yeast fermentation, so if you close di bottle tight, pressure fit build up and e fit burst.
c-267.principle: Yeast dey break sugar to make alcohol and carbon dioxide. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2\,C_2H_5OH + 2\,CO_2}$
c-267.example: Even fermenting only 10g glucose (about 0.056 mol) fit produce about 2.7L of CO2, and inside 3L bottle, pressure fit rise quickly. E dey happen more when sugar never fully dissolve or when temperature high.
c-267.actionItem: Today, close di plum syrup bottle lid loosely or cover am with cloth, and if bubbles rise, open di lid once a day to release di gas.

c-268.title: Why curry stain dey turn red when you wash am with soap
c-268.summary: Di yellow pigment of curry (curcumin) dey turn red for alkali, so if you rub am with alkaline soap, di stain go instead turn redder and darker.
c-268.principle: Curcumin na pH indicator wey be yellow for acidic and neutral conditions and reddish-brown from about pH 8.6 and above. $\mathrm{HCur \rightleftharpoons H^+ + Cur^-}$ (yellow ⇌ red)
c-268.example: Solid soap solution get pH 9 to 10, wey pass dis colour change range. If you treat am with neutral dish detergent (pH about 7), di colour no go change, and if you dry am for sunlight, curcumin go photodegrade and fade.
c-268.actionItem: Today, if curry stain dey, rinse am with cold water, dab am with neutral dish detergent, and dry am for sun, no use soap.

c-269.title: Why boiled egg yolk dey get greenish colour
c-269.summary: Di green ring around boiled egg yolk na iron sulphide, wey be harmless compound, and you fit prevent am by reducing di boiling time.
c-269.principle: Hydrogen sulphide from sulphur amino acids for egg white dey meet iron for di yolk to form iron sulphide. $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + H_2S \to FeS + 2H^+}$
c-269.example: Large egg dey hard-boil in about 10 to 12 minutes after e start to boil, and if you boil am for 15 minutes or more, green ring dey form easily. If you soak am for cold water for 5 minutes immediately after boiling, di reaction go stop.
c-269.actionItem: Today, when you dey boil egg, boil am for only 10 to 12 minutes after e boil and immediately cool am in cold water for 5 minutes.

c-270.title: If you swallow button battery, burn go happen within 2 hours
c-270.summary: If you swallow coin-shaped button battery, severe burn fit happen for di food pipe even within 2 hours, so even if no symptoms dey, go emergency room immediately.
c-270.principle: When battery touch saliva for di food pipe, current dey flow and water dey split by electrolysis, and hydroxide ions dey form for di negative side and cause strong alkali burn. $2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2e^- \to \mathrm{H_2} + 2\mathrm{OH^-}$
c-270.example: 3V lithium button battery wey get 20mm diameter (CR2032) dey easily stuck for child food pipe, and tissue pH fit rise to 12 to 13. Damage dey start within 2 hours, and you no suppose make di person vomit or wait.
c-270.actionItem: Today, check say di button battery compartments for remote, smart key and toys dey locked with screws, and keep spare batteries where children no fit reach.

c-271.title: Tuna and swordfish: eat dem only 1 to 2 times per week because of mercury
c-271.summary: Big predatory fish like tuna and swordfish get methylmercury wey concentrate inside dem, so e better to control di amount wey you eat to about 1 to 2 times per week.
c-271.principle: Mercury dey change to methylmercury through microbes and concentrate along di food chain. $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{microbes}} CH_3Hg^+}$ European Food Safety Authority tolerable weekly intake na 1.3 μg per kg body weight.
c-271.example: For 60kg body weight, di weekly tolerable amount na 78 μg. 100g swordfish wey get 1.0ppm mercury get about 100 μg, so even one time fit exceed am, and 100g light tuna wey get about 0.1ppm na about 10 μg. Pregnant women and children must be stricter.
c-271.actionItem: Today, eat tuna, swordfish and shark only about 100g at a time, and plan to eat di same big fish within 1 to 2 times dis week.

c-272.title: Shrimp and crab dey turn red when dem cook
c-272.summary: When shrimp and crab cook, di proteins dey change and di trapped red pigment dey release and turn dem red, and dis na good sign say dem don cook finish.
c-272.principle: When dem alive, astaxanthin dey attach to protein (crustacyanin) and show blue-grey, but when heat denature di protein, di red astaxanthin go release. $\text{astaxanthin-protein (blue-grey)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{astaxanthin (red)} + \text{denatured protein}$
c-272.example: Shrimp don cook when di internal temperature reach 63℃ (145℉) or more and e turn opaque pink, and 2 to 3 minutes for boiling water dey enough. If you boil am longer, di meat go tough.
c-272.actionItem: Today, when you dey boil shrimp, comot dem immediately when di body turn opaque pink C-shape so dem no go tough.

c-273.title: Old brake fluid dey weaken braking
c-273.summary: Brake fluid dey absorb moisture from di air so di boiling point dey drop, and for hard braking like downhill, e fit boil and braking power go drop.
c-273.principle: Glycol-based brake fluid dey absorb moisture, so if water mix with am, di boiling point go lower and vapour go form, and vapour dey compress so e no fit transmit braking force. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: DOT 4 dry boiling point na at least 230℃, but if e absorb moisture, e go drop by about 75℃ to 155℃. E dey usually absorb about 2 to 3% moisture per year, so dem recommend to change am every 2 years or 40,000km.
c-273.actionItem: Today, check your maintenance record for di last time you change di brake fluid, and if e don pass 2 years, book inspection for di garage.

c-274.title: Di pink colour for ham gift set na from nitrite colouring
