c-274.summary: Di reason why ham still dey pink after cooking na colour wey nitrite make, and e better no make you eat processed meat plenty.
c-274.principle: For acid, nitrite dey become nitric oxide (NO), wey dey bind to di iron of di meat pigment myoglobin to form pink nitrosomyoglobin. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Korean meat product residual nitrite limit na 70mg/kg or less. Di World Health Organization classify processed meat as Group 1 carcinogen and e estimate say if you eat 50g every day, di risk of colorectal cancer go increase by about 18%.
c-274.actionItem: Today, keep di ham gift set wey you receive for fridge, divide am into portions of about 50g at a time, and eat am together with vegetables.

c-275.title: White powder on persimmon na sugar crystal, no be mould
c-275.summary: Di white powder for dried persimmon surface na mostly sugar (glucose and fructose) crystals wey harden for di surface, no be mould. If e get fluffy blue or black spots, na mould so throw am away.
c-275.principle: As e dey dry, moisture dey reduce and sugar concentration dey rise, and when e pass saturation solubility, sugar go precipitate as crystals. Di saturation condition na $C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$ and na di result of water flying comot to reduce di denominator of $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{sugar}}}{V_{\mathrm{water}}}$.
c-275.example: Fresh persimmon get about 80% moisture and about 15% sugar, but dried persimmon moisture dey reduce to about 25 to 30% and sugar concentrate to about 60% or more. Na why white powder dey form for di surface.
c-275.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy dried persimmon, choose one wey di powder even and firm and di surface dry, and avoid ones wey get blue fluff or sticky stains.

c-276.title: Di burning smell wey you get when you first turn on heater na accumulated dust wey dey decompose by heat
c-276.summary: Di musty burnt smell wey you get when you first turn on heater wey rest for whole summer na often di smell of dust wey gather for di heater decompose by heat. If you ventilate and run am few minutes, e usually go disappear, but if e continue, e need inspection.
c-276.principle: Organic matter for dust (fibres, skin flakes and so on) dey thermally decompose when e heat and e dey release volatile substances and char. E start around $T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, and di heating element surface dey much hotter than dat.
c-276.example: Electric heater element surface dey usually reach 300 to 800°C so dust dey burn easily. 1 to 2kW heater fit smell even when you turn on am for only 30 minutes, and after cleaning, di smell go almost disappear.
c-276.actionItem: Today, before you turn on di heater, unplug am, remove dust from di intake and floor with vacuum cleaner, open window, and run am for 10 minutes test. If burning smell continue or smoke show, off am immediately and get am checked.

c-277.title: Salt di cabbage make e soften and kimchi flavour soak in
c-277.summary: If you salt napa cabbage, water dey comot through osmosis so e soften, seasoning dey soak in well, and crunchiness dey remain. If salting no enough, kimchi go taste bland and soft.
c-277.principle: Cell membranes dey semi-permeable, so if outside salt concentration high, water dey move from inside to outside. Osmotic pressure dey expressed as $\Pi = iCRT$, and calcium dey cross-link pectin to maintain tissue structure.
c-277.example: If you salt 1 head of napa cabbage (about 2.5kg) with about 200g salt (about 8%) for 4 to 6 hours, di weight go reduce by about 20 to 25% as about 0.5 to 0.6kg of water dey comot. Salinity of salted cabbage around 2% dey suitable.
c-277.actionItem: Today, if you dey make kimchi, turn di cabbage once for middle of salting, and rinse and drain am when di stem bend but no break.

c-278.title: Astringent persimmon no go taste astringent if soluble tannin harden
c-278.summary: Di astringent taste of persimmon na from water-soluble tannin, and if e harden to insoluble form, e no go taste astringent again. Drying persimmon or de-astringency treatment na di principle.
c-278.principle: Soluble tannin dey bind to tongue protein so e dey feel astringent. When persimmon ripen, dry or seal, di acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) wey form dey polymerise di tannin into insoluble lumps wey no dissolve again for saliva.
c-278.example: Astringent persimmon get about 1% soluble tannin so e dey dry di mouth, but if you leave am sealed for about 20 to 25°C for 3 to 5 days, most go become insoluble and di astringent taste almost disappear.
c-278.actionItem: Today, if you get astringent persimmon, put am inside sealed container or bag with apple or banana for 2 to 3 days, or peel am and dry am for sun. Taste one piece before you eat to check di astringency.

c-279.title: Grapefruit juice dey change di effect of some medicines
c-279.summary: Grapefruit fit block di breakdown of some medicines and raise di drug concentration for di blood. If you dey take any medicine, ask pharmacist about interaction with grapefruit.
c-279.principle: Furanocoumarins for grapefruit dey inhibit di drug-metabolising enzyme CYP3A4 for di gut. If breakdown reduce, more absorbed drug go remain, $AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ go increase and risk of side effects go rise.
c-279.example: For some statins (cholesterol medicines), drinking 1 cup (about 250mL) of grapefruit juice fit increase blood exposure (AUC) by many times and di effect fit last more than one day. Di effect dey differ a lot for each medicine.
c-279.actionItem: Today, check di instruction leaflet of di medicine wey you dey take or ask di pharmacist if e get grapefruit warning, and if e get, avoid grapefruit juice and fresh fruit. No stop di medicine on your own.

c-280.title: Why liquids for cabin dey split into 100mL or less
c-280.summary: For international flights, you fit carry liquids and gels in containers of 100mL or less inside transparent zip bag. Di volume rule na to make am hard to make dangerous amount with one container.
c-280.principle: Di rule come from di idea say liquid explosives need to gather to certain quantity before dem dey dangerous, so dem limit container size. Di total wey you fit carry na $V_{\mathrm{total}}=\sum V_i$ and $V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ each, and e dey usually limited to one 1L zip bag.
c-280.example: If you put ten 100mL containers inside 1L zip bag, di maximum total na about 1L. 200mL container even if e half full, e often fail di container capacity rule and e no dey pass.
c-280.actionItem: Today, if you dey prepare for trip, move shampoo, lotion and liquid medicine into small containers of 100mL or less, put dem inside one transparent zip bag, and put am for di top of your luggage. Check airline and country rules one more time before you leave.

c-281.title: Choose fermented fish sauce by maturation period and amino acid taste, no be by saltiness
c-281.summary: Di umami of jeotgal (salted fermented seafood) dey come from amino acids wey form when protein dey break down during maturation. Check say e no be only salty and say di production and maturation information dey clear.
c-281.principle: Protein-digesting enzymes from fish guts dey hydrolyse proteins into peptides and amino acids: $\text{protein} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{amino acid}$. For dis process, glutamic acid dey give umami.
c-281.example: Salted shrimp salinity dey usually about 20%, and if e mature for 3 to 6 months, amino nitrogen go increase and di taste go deepen. Even with di same salinity, if maturation short, fishy smell and saltiness go dey pronounced.
c-281.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy jeotgal, check di production date, raw materials and salinity label for di package, and if you fit taste am, choose di one wey sweetness and savouriness remain after di saltiness.

c-282.title: Check gas connections with soapy water bubbles, no use smell
c-282.summary: For gas connection wey you suspect say e dey leak, put soapy water and check whether bubbles form. To check with flame or lighter na very dangerous because explosion fit happen.
c-282.principle: Di leaking gas dey push up di surfactant film of di soapy water to form bubbles. Pressure inside di bubble na $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$ (for soap bubble), so even small leak dey become bubbles wey you fit see.
c-282.example: Apply solution of about 1mL dish detergent mixed with 100mL water for di gas stove hose connection, and if bubbles grow or keep forming, e dey leak. City gas dey lighter than air so e dey go up, and LPG dey heavier so e dey gather for di floor.
c-282.actionItem: Today, with di gas valve closed, put soapy water for di hose connection and check whether bubbles form. If bubbles keep growing, close di valve, ventilate, and let expert check am.

c-283.title: If you keep chestnut for low temperature, starch go turn to sugar and e go sweeter
c-283.summary: If you store raw chestnut for 0 to 4°C fridge for few weeks, di starch go turn to sugar and e go sweeter. If you leave am for room temperature, e go easily spoil, so refrigeration na di thrifty way.
c-283.principle: For low temperature, amylase and others dey break starch into maltose and glucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Plants dey accumulate sugar to prevent freezing and protect osmotically.
c-283.example: Freshly picked chestnut get about 5 to 8% sugar, but if you store am for 0 to 2°C for 4 to 8 weeks, di sugar content fit increase to about 1.5 to 2 times and di sweetness go noticeably stronger. For room temperature, insects and mould dey form easily within half a month.
c-283.actionItem: Today, wrap raw chestnuts in their shell with kitchen towel, put dem inside zip bag, keep dem for fridge (about 1 to 4°C), and steam or roast dem within 1 to 2 weeks.

c-284.title: For canning, safety depend on acidity at pH 4.6
c-284.summary: When you dey make home canning, you must separate acidic foods wey get pH 4.6 or below from low-acid foods wey get above. For low-acid foods, boiling water heating alone fit still leave risk of botulinum toxin.
c-284.principle: Botulinum spores fit produce toxin for sealed oxygen-free conditions wey pH pass 4.6. Acidity na $\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$ and pH 4.6 na $[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Jam and fruit preserves get pH about 3 to 4 and dem dey acidic, so dem dey relatively safe with boiling water heating, but vegetables, meat and beans get pH 5 to 7 and dem dey low-acid, so dem need high-pressure heating of about 116 to 121°C. Boiling water no fit pass 100°C.
c-284.actionItem: Today, if you dey can food, check di acidity of di ingredients (whether fruit or vinegar pickle), and for low-acid ingredients, refrigerate or freeze dem at home instead of canning. If di lid swell or e get bubbles or strange smell, no eat am, throw am away.

c-285.title: Chocolate fit be poison for dogs
c-285.summary: Theobromine for chocolate dey break down slowly for dogs and e fit cause poisoning. Di more cocoa, di more dangerous, so if your dog eat am, check di amount and type and call di vet.
c-285.principle: Theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) get half-life of about 17 hours for dogs, wey long pass humans (about 6 to 10 hours), so e dey accumulate for di body. Poisoning risk dey estimated with intake per body weight $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{body\ weight}}}$.
c-285.example: Dark chocolate (70% cocoa) get about 5 to 8mg/g theobromine, so if 10kg dog eat about 50g (about half bar of normal chocolate), e be about 250 to 400mg (about 25 to 40mg/kg of body weight), wey be di severe-symptoms risk range. Milk chocolate get lower content.
c-285.actionItem: Today, keep chocolate and cocoa products high up or inside sealed cabinet where your dog no fit reach. If e eat am, no wait, write di type, amount and time and call di vet immediately.

c-286.title: Di reason why plane food dey taste bland na cabin air pressure and dryness
c-286.summary: Inside plane, air pressure low and e dry well, so smell and taste dey dull and food dey taste bland. Na why dem dey deliberately season plane food strong.
c-286.principle: Cabin pressure na about 2,000 to 2,400m above sea level (about 0.75 to 0.8atm) and relative humidity na 10 to 20%. For low pressure and dryness, smell and taste receptor sensitivity dey drop a lot, and dem report say sweetness and saltiness dey dull by about 30%. Pressure ratio na $\frac{P_{\mathrm{cabin}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: Even food wey taste normal for ground fit taste about 20 to 30% less sweet and salty for cruising altitude, so plane food dey use plenty salt and spices. Di reason why tomato juice dey taste special for plane dey explained for similar way.
c-286.actionItem: Today, if you dey fly, drink water often so your mouth no go dry, and even if food taste bland, no add more salt, pick strongly flavoured food or sour drink.

c-287.title: Choose baking flour by protein: strong, all-purpose or weak
c-287.summary: Di difference between strong, all-purpose and weak flour na di protein content. Choose high-protein strong flour for bread and low-protein weak flour for cake and cookies so di texture go correct.
c-287.principle: Wheat proteins gliadin and glutenin dey form gluten network when dem meet water: $\text{gliadin}+\text{glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{gluten}$. Di more protein, di tougher and more elastic di network.
c-287.example: Strong flour get about 11 to 13% protein and e suit chewy loaf bread and bagels, all-purpose flour get about 9 to 10% for noodles and pancakes, and weak flour get about 7 to 9% for fluffy cakes and cookies. 100g weak flour get about 8g protein.
c-287.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy flour, look di protein content for di nutrition information for di back of di package and choose strong, all-purpose or weak flour according to wetin you wan make.

c-288.title: If you mix new and old batteries, leak risk high
c-288.summary: If you mix new batteries with used ones, or different types of batteries, di weak battery go over-discharge and fit leak. For device, replace batteries of di same type and same age at once.
c-288.principle: For series connection, di same current dey flow, but if di voltage of di weak battery drop near 0V first, di remaining ones go reverse-charge dat battery. Dat time $2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$ reaction go produce hydrogen, internal pressure go rise and leak go happen.
c-288.example: If one of 3 new 1.5V batteries wey connect for series (4.5V) don finish and dey near 0V, di remaining two go keep pushing about 3V and di battery go dey charged in reverse. Leaked potassium hydroxide na strong alkali (pH about 14) and e dey corrode skin and device.
c-288.actionItem: Today, check di batteries for your remote, clock and toys, and when you dey replace dem, change all di batteries for one device to di same brand and new ones. No touch di white powder wey comot with bare hand.

c-289.title: Boil beef bone soup once and divide am into portions
c-289.summary: If you boil beef bone for long time, collagen go release into gelatin and make thick soup, and when e cool, e go solidify like jelly. If you boil am once and freeze am in portions, you fit save gas bill and time.
c-289.principle: Collagen dey release when you heat am and become gelatin, and when e cool, e go change from sol to gel. Heat hydrolysis na $\text{collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{gelatin}$ and e dey usually set below about 35°C.
c-289.example: If you boil 1kg beef bone with about 6L water for 6 to 8 hours, you go get about 4 to 5L soup. Instead of lighting gas stove every time, if you boil am once and divide am into 15 portions of 300mL, you fit reduce gas use well.
c-289.actionItem: Today, if you boil beef bone soup, let am cool completely, divide am into portions for zip bags or containers, freeze am, and thaw and heat only di amount wey you need.

c-290.title: White powder on pot soil fit be salts, no be mould
c-290.summary: White powder for plant pot soil or di edge of di pot fit be salts from fertiliser or tap water wey remain, no be mould. If you water well to wash am out, e go reduce.
c-290.principle: When water evaporate from di surface, di dissolved salts remain and precipitate. Salt concentration $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{salt}}}{V_{\mathrm{water}}}$ dey increase as $V_{\mathrm{water}}$ reduce, and if e pass saturation, crystals go form. For example, hard water components like $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$ remain.
c-290.example: If tap water hardness na about 100mg/L (as CaCO3), when 1L water evaporate, about 100mg calcium carbonate go remain. Even if you give 200mL every week, after few months noticeable white layer go form for di soil surface.
c-290.actionItem: Today, if you see white powder, scrape off 1 to 2cm of top soil, cover with fresh soil, den water slowly with di same volume as di pot and let am flow out through di drainage hole well.

c-291.title: Xylitol gum dey dangerous if dog eat am
c-291.summary: Xylitol wey safe for humans dey very dangerous for dogs and even small amount fit cause low blood sugar and liver damage. Keep sugar-free gum, candy and some peanut butter where dogs no fit reach.
c-291.principle: Dog pancreas dey mistake xylitol for glucose and release insulin suddenly. Den blood sugar go drop sharply, and di dangerous intake of $\mathrm{C_5H_{12}O_5}$ (xylitol) dey estimated with $D=\frac{m}{m_{\mathrm{body\ weight}}}$.
c-291.example: For 10kg dog, xylitol of about 0.1g/kg (about 1g) alone fit cause low blood sugar, and 0.5g/kg (about 5g) or more get high risk of liver damage. One piece of sugar-free gum usually get about 0.2 to 1g xylitol, so few pieces na danger zone.
c-291.actionItem: Today, move sugar-free gum and candy for your bag, pocket and drawer to where your dog no fit reach. If e eat am, carry di ingredient list and call di vet immediately.

c-292.title: Why alkaline hot spring water dey feel slippery
c-292.summary: When you soak for alkaline hot spring, di slippery feeling na because di lipids for di skin surface dey turn like soap. If your skin sensitive, no soak long and moisturise after you comot.
c-292.principle: Alkali (pH 8.5 or more) dey saponify di skin oil components (triglycerides) into soap and glycerol: $\text{fat} + 3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to 3\,\text{fatty acid salt (soap)}+\text{glycerol}$. Dis soap component dey emulsify for di surface and dey feel slippery.
c-292.example: If you soak for alkaline hot spring with pH about 9 to 10 at about 40°C for 20 minutes, dead skin and sebum dey dissolve and skin go smooth. But pH 10 get $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ 1,000 times higher than neutral (pH 7).
c-292.actionItem: Today, if you go hot spring or bath, limit alkaline hot spring to about 10 to 20 minutes at a time, and after you comot, dry yourself and apply moisturiser immediately.

c-293.title: Olive oil 'extra virgin' na grade label for acidity 0.8% or less
c-293.summary: Extra virgin na grade for oil wey dem press from olives wey get free fatty acid acidity of 0.8% or less and wey pass sensory test. Low acidity no always mean better taste, so look di harvest and bottling date too.
c-293.principle: Acidity na di ratio of free fatty acids (as oleic acid) for di oil: $\text{acidity (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{free\ fatty\ acid}}}{m_{\mathrm{oil}}}\times100$. Di fresher di olives, di less di triglycerides dey break down and di lower di acidity, and polyphenols dey slow oxidation.
c-293.example: Acidity 0.8% or less na extra virgin and 2% or less na virgin. For 1L bottle, free fatty acid for extra virgin na about 8g or less. E dey weak against light and heat, so dark bottle dey better.
c-293.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy olive oil, check di harvest year and bottling date together with di 'extra virgin' label, choose dark bottle instead of transparent bottle, and store am for cool place.

c-294.title: Cover 9V battery terminals with tape when you store dem
c-294.summary: 9V battery get two terminals close for di same side, so if metal touch dem, short circuit fit happen and e fit get hot. When you put dem for drawer, cover di terminals with tape or pack dem separately.
c-294.principle: If di terminals touch metal like key or coin and short-circuit, resistance dey very small so big current $I=\frac{V}{R}$ go flow and Joule heat $P=I^2R$ go form. For example, if $R=0.5\,\Omega$, e be $I=18\,\mathrm{A}$.
c-294.example: If 9V battery get internal resistance of about 1.5Ω and short-circuit, in theory $I\approx6\,\mathrm{A}$ and heat fit rise to about 54W level, so e fit get hot within few minutes. Alkaline batteries dey usually lower than dis, but burn and fire risk still remain.
c-294.actionItem: Today, cover di terminals of spare 9V batteries for your drawer with clear tape or put dem inside di original packaging or plastic case. No keep dem together with coins and keys.

c-295.title: Tofu dey last longer if you soak am for water and change di water every day
c-295.summary: For opened tofu, if you submerge am for clean water, refrigerate am, and change di water every day, you fit keep am fresh for 2 to 3 more days. If sour smell or stickiness show, throw am away.
c-295.principle: Tofu na soy protein wey form gel with coagulant, and e get about 85% water so bacteria dey grow easily. When e dey submerged, change in surface water activity $a_w=\frac{p}{p_0}$ and oxygen contact reduce, and if you change water every time, di bacteria and metabolites wey multiply go wash away.
c-295.example: If you soak opened tofu for water for 4°C fridge and change am every day, e fit last 3 to 5 days, and if you just leave am, di surface often go sticky within 1 to 2 days. Just by not throwing away one block of tofu (300g, about 2,000 won), na big saving.
c-295.actionItem: Today, put remaining tofu inside sealed container, pour enough clean water (bottled or boiled and cooled) to cover am, refrigerate am, and change di water once a day from tomorrow.

c-296.title: Wash down puffer jacket with neutral detergent and dry am completely
c-296.summary: For down (duck or goose feather) puffer jacket, if you use strong alkaline detergent, di natural oil for di feathers go comot and e go lose recovery. Wash am with neutral detergent and dry am completely to di inside to prevent smell and mould.
c-296.principle: Fats (lipids) for feathers dey saponify under alkaline conditions and wash away: $\text{fat}+3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to\text{soap}+\text{glycerol}$. When di fat dey gone, di feathers dey clump and di air layer thickness wey dey create insulation dey reduce.
c-296.example: Ordinary powder detergent solution get pH about 10 to 11 wey be alkaline, but neutral detergent get pH about 7 to 8. For 500g 800-fill-power jacket, even if only 100g of water remain, damp smell and mould fit form even after drying.
c-296.actionItem: Today, if you go wash puffer jacket, use neutral detergent (wool and down special), rinse am well, and dry am completely inside low-temperature dryer with 2 to 3 tennis balls, or dry am for shade for few days until di inside dry.

c-297.title: Take calcium and iron supplements at different times
c-297.summary: If you take calcium supplements and iron supplements together, dem fit block each other absorption. If you take both, leave at least 2 hours gap.
c-297.principle: Divalent cations like $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ and $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ dey compete for di same absorption transporter (like DMT1) for di small intestine. If di concentration of one high, di absorption of di other dey drop, and at calcium 500mg or more, iron absorption fit reduce noticeably.
c-297.example: Dem report say if you take 600mg calcium and 18mg iron together, iron absorption rate dey reduce to about 40 to 50%. Commonly, people dey take iron on empty stomach with vitamin C and calcium with meals.
c-297.actionItem: Today, if you dey take both, separate di time: take iron for morning on empty stomach or before noon, and calcium with dinner. If you get prescription medicine, ask di pharmacist first.

c-298.title: Lighters get rules for cabin carry
c-298.summary: Lighter rules dey different for each country and airline, and generally you fit carry only 1 per person on your body and for many cases you no fit put am for checked baggage. Torch-type (turbo) dey mostly banned. Check before you leave.
c-298.principle: Lighter fuel butane ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$) dey inside as pressurised liquid and e dey highly flammable and combustion na $2\,\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}+13\,\mathrm{O_2}\to8\,\mathrm{CO_2}+10\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. When cabin pressure low, di pressure difference $\Delta P$ between inside and outside of di container go increase.
c-298.example: Butane get vapour pressure of about 2atm for 20°C. For cabin (about 0.8atm), di difference with outside dey bigger than for ground, so for some lighters, fuel fit leak or flame fit grow. Ordinary disposable lighter dey usually hold few g of butane.
c-298.actionItem: Today, if you dey travel, check di lighter rules of di airline and destination country, and if you no need am, leave di lighter for home. If you carry am, take only one for pocket so you fit bring am out and show am during security check.

c-299.title: Brewed soy sauce and acid-hydrolysed soy sauce get different reactions
c-299.summary: Brewed soy sauce dey make by fermenting and maturing soy and wheat with microbes, and acid-hydrolysed soy sauce dey make by quickly breaking soy protein with hydrochloric acid. You fit tell di difference if you check di 'brewed soy sauce' label and raw materials.
c-299.principle: Both dey hydrolyse protein into amino acids but di catalyst different. Fermentation na enzyme $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\text{enzyme},\ \text{months}}\text{amino acid}$, and acid hydrolysis na $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{HCl},\ \Delta}\text{amino acid}$ and e dey finish for some hours to few days.
c-299.example: Brewed soy sauce usually take 6 months to some years to mature, and acid-hydrolysed soy sauce fit be make within few days so e cheap but di aroma dey flat. Commercial blended soy sauce na mix of both and di ratio dey show for di label.
c-299.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy soy sauce, check for di raw material name whether e be 'brewed soy sauce 100%' or 'acid-hydrolysed blend', and choose according to use: brewed for soups and braises, blended for stir-fry and stews.

c-300.title: For extreme cold, diesel paraffin wax dey solidify and engine no go start
c-300.summary: Paraffin wax for diesel dey crystallise when temperature drop below zero and block di fuel filter so di engine no go start. If cold wave dey forecast, use winter-grade diesel and keep di tank full.
c-300.principle: N-paraffins for diesel (for example, $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{42}}$) dey precipitate as crystals when temperature drop below di cloud point $T_{\mathrm{cp}}$. When $T<T_{\mathrm{cp}}$ reach, wax crystals go grow bigger, and for di lower cold filter plugging point, di filter go block.
c-300.example: Summer-grade diesel cloud point dey adjusted to about 0°C and winter-grade to about -15 to -20°C. If -10°C morning come for winter, di risk of starting failure go rise if summer-spec diesel still remain.
c-300.actionItem: Today, if cold wave dey forecast, check at di petrol station whether di car get winter-grade diesel, and keep di tank more than half full. If e no start, no keep cranking am, call garage or insurance breakdown service.

c-301.title: Few grains of rice inside salt shaker go prevent hardening
c-301.summary: When salt harden from moisture, if you put few grains of rice, di rice go absorb di moisture first so salt go clump less. E no perfect, so airtight storage na di priority.
c-301.principle: Sodium chloride show deliquescence, e dey absorb moisture from di air when relative humidity pass about 75%. Dis critical humidity na $\mathrm{RH}_{\mathrm{c}}\approx75\%$, and above dat, di grains dey stick together and form lumps.
c-301.example: For rainy season when humidity pass 80%, open salt shaker fit harden within one or two days. If you put about 10 to 20 grains of rice, dem go partly absorb few g of moisture per 100g salt and slow di clumping.
c-301.actionItem: Today, put 10 to 20 grains of rice for your salt shaker, close di lid tight, and keep am for cool and dry place, no for humid places like beside gas stove.

c-302.title: No use enzyme detergent for wool and silk clothes
c-302.summary: Wool and silk na protein fibres, so enzyme detergent wey get protein-digesting enzymes go dissolve di fibres and spoil dem. Use neutral detergent special for wool and silk.
c-302.principle: Protease for enzyme detergent dey hydrolyse di peptide bonds of proteins: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{H_2N{-}R'}$. Keratin for wool and fibroin for silk na di same kind of protein so dem dey weaken by di same reaction.
c-302.example: Protease enzymes dey most active for 30 to 50°C so dem dey work for normal wash temperatures. If you soak wool sweater for 30°C with enzyme detergent for only 1 hour, di fibres fit thin, lose shine or get holes.
c-302.actionItem: Today, check di wash label of your wool or silk clothes, and if di detergent ingredients list get 'enzyme (protease)', no use am, hand wash gently with special neutral wool and silk detergent in cold water.

c-303.title: Follow di storage temperature label for probiotic products
c-303.summary: Probiotic products na living bacteria, so dem dey weak against heat and moisture and you must follow di storage temperature label. If e get refrigeration label, no leave am inside summer delivery or inside car.
c-303.principle: As temperature rise, di death rate of live bacteria dey increase and e reduce to $N(t)=N_0\,e^{-kt}$, and di higher di temperature, di bigger $k$. Spore-forming strains (like Bacillus) or coated or freeze-dried products dey relatively stable even for room temperature.
c-303.example: If you keep refrigerated product at 25 to 30°C, di live bacteria count fit reduce noticeably within few weeks, and inside car at 40°C or more, e dey faster. Di guaranteed count dey usually based on di survival number until expiry date, not for di manufacturing time.
c-303.actionItem: Today, check di label of your probiotic products for 'refrigerate' or 'room temperature', and if e get refrigerate label, keep am inside fridge and no put am inside car or by di window for summer. If you get health problems, talk to doctor.

c-304.title: For pharmacy abroad, look for medicine by ingredient name
c-304.summary: Even di same medicine get different brand names for different countries, so for pharmacy abroad, to tell dem di ingredient name (English) na di most accurate. For example, acetaminophen na also call paracetamol abroad.
c-304.principle: Di ingredient name (generic name, INN) of medicines dey standardised internationally and brand names dey differ by manufacturer. Di same ingredient $\mathrm{C_8H_9NO_2}$ dem dey call am acetaminophen (US and Korea) and paracetamol (Europe, Asia and others).
c-304.example: Acetaminophen 500mg products dey sell for different countries as 'Tylenol', 'Panadol', 'Paracetamol' and so on, but di ingredient na di same. Make sure say adult maximum daily dose no pass 4g (8 tablets of 500mg).
c-304.actionItem: Today, as part of your trip preparation, note di ingredient name (English) of di medicines wey you normally take or save dem inside your phone. For di pharmacy, tell dem di symptoms, di medicines wey you dey take, and allergies together, and carry doctor note for prescription medicines.

c-305.title: Di difference between black tea, green tea and oolong na di degree of leaf oxidation
c-305.summary: Black tea, oolong and green tea na leaves of di same tea plant but di degree of oxidation (fermentation) different so di taste and colour dey differ. Green tea dey prevent oxidation and black tea dey fully oxidise am.
c-305.principle: Polyphenol oxidase (PPO) for tea leaves dey react catechins with oxygen to turn dem into theaflavin and others: $\text{catechin}+\mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PPO}}\text{theaflavin}$. Green tea dey first inactivate di enzyme with heat to prevent oxidation.
c-305.example: Green tea get about 0% oxidation, oolong about 10 to 80%, and black tea near 100%. Generally, green tea dey brew with water of about 70 to 80°C for 1 to 2 minutes, and black tea with about 90 to 95°C water for 3 to 5 minutes.
c-305.actionItem: Today, when you dey buy tea, check di 'unoxidised (green), semi-oxidised (oolong), fully oxidised (black)' information for di package, and brew am with di water temperature and time wey suit di type.

c-306.title: For winter, keep di fuel tank more than half full
c-306.summary: For winter, if di fuel tank empty, water vapour for air go condense and water go mix with di fuel, and e fit freeze for freezing temperature and block di fuel line. If you keep di tank more than half full, you fit reduce dis.
c-306.principle: Water vapour for di empty space dey condense for di cold tank wall. Condensation dey happen when temperature drop below di dew point $T_d$, and di more air inside di tank, di more water vapour go condense. Water dey freeze below $0^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and e block fuel flow.
c-306.example: If 50L tank empty, e get about 50L humid air inside, so at relative humidity 80% and 10°C, theoretically few grams of water fit condense. If you fill am full, di air amount go reduce so less water go form, and cases where fuel line freeze for -10°C winter morning and car no start go reduce.
c-306.actionItem: Today, check di remaining fuel for your car or heating fuel tank, and if e dey below half, refill am. Di habit of keeping am more than half full dey more convenient for winter than filling am full once.

c-307.title: If coffee bitter, no add more beans, reduce extraction
c-307.summary: If coffee bitter, instead of adding more beans, reduce di extraction time or grind coarser. Over-extraction na di cause of bitterness, so you fit adjust di taste without wasting beans.
c-307.principle: Extraction yield na $\text{yield(\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{dissolved\ solids}}}{m_{\mathrm{beans}}}\times100$ and 18 to 22% na usually di proper range. If e pass dis, plenty bitter components (chlorogenic acid lactones, phenylindanes, etc.) go dissolve.
c-307.example: If 20g beans go above 22% yield, more than 4.4g go dissolve and e go taste bitter and astringent. If you adjust di same 20g beans to 20% yield, about 4g go dissolve and e go sweet and balanced. If 20g beans cost about 1,000 won, you go reduce wastage.
c-307.actionItem: Today if coffee bitter, no increase di amount of beans, just grind one step coarser or cut di extraction time by 20 to 30 seconds. Keep di water temperature at 90 to 94°C.

c-308.title: Yeast go die if you put am inside water wey pass 55℃
c-308.summary: Yeast wey dem dey use for bread dough go die if you put am inside water wey too hot and di dough no go rise. Set di water temperature to lukewarm 30 to 38°C by touching am with your hand.
c-308.principle: Yeast (Saccharomyces) dey die quickly above about 55°C where protein dey denature. Optimum activity na about 28 to 35°C, and fermentation $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\to2\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+2\,\mathrm{CO_2}$ produce carbon dioxide wey dey make di dough rise.
c-308.example: If you put 7g yeast for 500g flour and di water temperature na 35°C, di dough go rise about 2 times within 1 hour, but if e na 60°C water, most yeast go die and e hardly go rise. Na way to save one packet of yeast (about 500 won).
c-308.actionItem: If you dey bake bread today, check di water temperature with thermometer or inside of your wrist so e no hot, set am to lukewarm 30 to 38°C, and mix salt and yeast separately so dem no touch directly.

c-309.title: If you take cold medicines together, acetaminophen fit double
c-309.summary: If you take combination cold medicine, fever and pain reliever, and Tylenol separately, acetaminophen go repeat and you fit pass di maximum daily dose. Add di acetaminophen (paracetamol) content from di ingredient list to check am.
c-309.principle: Most acetaminophen dey metabolise for liver but if e too much, di toxic metabolite NAPQI go increase, glutathione go finish and liver cells go get damage. Add di daily total as $D_{\mathrm{total}}=\sum D_i$ and keep am at 4g for adult (recommended usually 3g or below).
c-309.example: 4 tablets of 500mg Tylenol (2g) plus 3 sachets (about 1g) of combination cold medicine wey get 325mg acetaminophen make 3g per day. You need to add am up so you no go take another Tylenol and pass 4g.
c-309.actionItem: Today if you dey take cold medicine, check di acetaminophen content for di ingredient list of all di medicines, write down di daily total and make sure say you no pass di dose. If you no sure, ask pharmacist.

c-310.title: For travel, solid shampoo and conditioner bar dey avoid liquid limit
c-310.summary: Solid shampoo and conditioner bars no be liquid or gel, so di 100mL limit for plane no apply and your travel bag go light. Many airlines and countries no dey treat solid soap as liquid.
c-310.principle: Dem make am by hardening surfactant (for example sodium cocoyl isethionate) without water, so e almost no get water content. Di liquid limit na rule about volume $V\le100\,\mathrm{mL}$, so solids no dey affected, but di final decision na for di security staff.
c-310.example: Ordinary liquid shampoo of 250mL no fit go for cabin because of container size, but one solid shampoo (about 50g) fit normally last about 50 to 80 uses and e weigh about 1/5 of one bottle of liquid.
c-310.actionItem: If you dey travel today, carry solid shampoo and conditioner bar inside container wey dey drain water, no put am wet, dry am completely before you pack am. Rules dey different for airline and country so check before you leave.

c-311.title: For butter and margarine, look di fat composition and trans fat label
c-311.summary: Butter and margarine get different types of fat, so compare saturated fat and trans fat for di nutrition label to choose. Margarine no be always better or worse, e depend on di product.
c-311.principle: If you add hydrogen to unsaturated fatty acids for vegetable oil, e go harden and some go become trans isomers: $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{H_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ni}}\mathrm{C{-}C}$. Trans fat fit form for dis partial hydrogenation process.
c-311.example: Butter get about 80% fat, mostly saturated fat (about 50%), and small amount of natural trans fat. Old-style margarine wey use partially hydrogenated oil get high trans fat, but nowadays most products get less than 0.5g and saturated fat ratio dey low.
c-311.actionItem: Today when you dey buy butter or margarine, compare saturated fat and trans fat per serving for di nutrition label and check whether 'partially hydrogenated oil' dey for di ingredients.

c-312.title: For fuel additive advert, read di ingredient function first
c-312.summary: For fuel additives, look which ingredient dey do wetin, no be advert words. Detergent dispersant dey wash comot deposits but e no guarantee say fuel economy go increase well well.
c-312.principle: Detergent dispersant na surfactant molecule wey get two-sided nature and e dey surround deposits (carbon) and disperse dem inside di fuel. Fuel economy change dey measure with $\eta=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{fuel}}$, and for clean engine di improvement small well well.
c-312.example: Many products dey add few mL of additive per 1L, but fuel economy improvement dey limited to around 1 to 2% on average. For car wey get 12km/L, 2% na 12.24km/L, and di price of one bottle of 5,000 won additive fit hard to recover from fuel cost.
c-312.actionItem: Today if you wan buy fuel additive, check di ingredient description for di package (detergent dispersant, cetane improver, etc.) and di fuel type and car model wey e fit, and see whether di fuel economy figures for advert get conditions.

c-313.title: For leather shoes, fill dem with cream oil instead of polishing
c-313.summary: For leather shoes, to add oil with cream pass to make dem shine, so dem no go dry and crack. Dem go last longer so you go save di cost of new shoes.
c-313.principle: Leather get lipids wey fill between collagen fibres to make e soft. If dis lipid reduce through evaporation or washing, di fibres go rub each other and e go dry and crack. Cream dey fill dis empty space with oil and wax.
c-313.example: If one pair of leather shoes cost about 150,000 won and you apply cream once a month to maintain am, di lifespan fit increase from 2 to 3 years to 5 years or more. For yearly view, di shoe cost go reduce to about half. One tin of shoe cream (about 5,000 won) fit serve tens of pairs.
c-313.actionItem: Today, wipe di dust from your leather shoes with dry cloth, apply small cream thinly, and after 5 minutes rub am with soft brush or cloth.

c-314.title: Green vegetables go turn yellow if you add vinegar
c-314.summary: When you blanch green vegetables like spinach or broccoli, if you add acid like vinegar or lemon juice, di bright green go change to yellowish olive colour. Add acid at di end or sprinkle am just before you eat.
c-314.principle: Di $\mathrm{H^+}$ for acid dey replace di $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ for di centre of chlorophyll to become pheophytin: $\text{chlorophyll}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\to\text{pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$. Pheophytin get yellowish brown colour so di colour go dull.
c-314.example: If you boil 100g blanched spinach with water wey get one spoon vinegar (15mL), di pH go drop from about 7 to around 4 and di colour go start to change within 5 minutes. On di other hand, if you add small salt and blanch am short for boiling water, di green go last long.
c-314.actionItem: Today if you dey blanch green vegetables, blanch dem only 1 to 2 minutes for boiling water with di lid open, rinse with cold water, and sprinkle vinegar or lemon juice just before you eat.

c-315.title: Use retinol product for night and wear sunscreen for day
c-315.summary: Retinol weak against light and e fit make your skin more sensitive to UV, so use am for night and always apply sunscreen for day. If you dey pregnant or get skin disease, first talk to professional.
c-315.principle: Retinol dey break down under UV: $\text{retinol}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{degradation products}$. Also, di stratum corneum dey become thin and new skin dey come up, so erythema fit form more easily even with di same amount of UV.
c-315.example: E common to start with low-concentration retinol (0.1 to 0.3%) 2 to 3 times a week and apply sunscreen of SPF 30 or more at about 2mg/cm² for daytime. SPF 30 dey block about 97% of UVB.
c-315.actionItem: Tonight after you wash your face, use retinol, and tomorrow morning apply sunscreen of SPF 30 or more. If stinging or redness serious, reduce use and talk to doctor.

c-316.title: Why retort instant rice fit last long for room temperature
c-316.summary: Instant rice dey last long for room temperature because afta dem seal am, dem dey sterilise am with high temperature and high pressure to almost remove all microbes. Before you open am, you fit keep am for room temperature so e good as emergency food for travel.
c-316.principle: Retort sterilisation dey apply pressure at about 120°C to kill even heat-resistant bacterial spores. Sterilisation time dey calculate as $F=D_T\,\log\frac{N_0}{N}$ and because e dey sealed without oxygen, aerobic bacteria no fit grow.
c-316.example: One instant rice (210g) dey sterilise at about 120°C for about 20 to 30 minutes and normally keep for 6 to 12 months at room temperature. You fit keep am for room temperature before you open am, but afta you open am, you must eat am immediately or keep am for fridge.
c-316.actionItem: Today when you dey pack for travel, carry instant rice as emergency food, and if di lid swell or di package leak, no eat am, throw am away. Heat am for microwave as di container mark show.

c-317.title: Sugar substitutes like allulose and erythritol get different sweetness and properties
c-317.summary: Sugar substitutes like allulose, erythritol and xylitol get different sweetness, calories and digestive reactions, so you must choose according to use. If you take too much, stomach discomfort fit come, so start with small amount.
c-317.principle: Sugar alcohols and rare sugars get different molecular structures so absorption rate and calories dey different. For example, erythritol ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O_4}$) mostly dey absorb and comot through urine so e almost no get calories, and e dey absorb heat when e dissolve ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{sol}}>0$) so e dey give cool feeling.
c-317.example: 1g sugar na about 4kcal but erythritol na about 0 to 0.2kcal/g and allulose na about 0.4kcal/g. If sugar be 1, sweetness of erythritol na about 0.7 and allulose na about 0.7. When you dey use dem instead of sugar, you must adjust di amount.
c-317.actionItem: Today when you dey buy sugar substitute, check di type (allulose, erythritol, etc.) and calories per serving for di ingredient list, and start with around 10g per day first to see how your body react.

c-318.title: Black water for heating pipes na iron oxide sludge
c-318.summary: If di water wey you drain from heating pipe black, e fit be sludge (magnetite) from iron pipe oxidation, and if e gather, heat transfer go worse. Think about asking boiler company to clean di pipes and check di rust inhibitor.
c-318.principle: For hot water wey almost no get oxygen, iron dey oxidise slowly: $3\,\mathrm{Fe}+4\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}+4\,\mathrm{H_2}$. Di magnetite ($\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$) wey form dey gather as black powder and increase heat transfer resistance.
c-318.example: If 1mm of sludge gather inside pipes and radiator, heat transfer fit drop by few percent, and di boiler go run longer so fuel cost fit increase by about 5 to 10%. Pipe cleaning cost na usually few hundred thousand won but e fit recover through heating cost saving and longer life.
c-318.actionItem: Today, check di heating pipe cleaning history and if e don pass several years, ask boiler company for inspection. No dismantle di pipes by yourself or touch di drain water directly.

c-319.title: Freezer burn na mark of water wey comot from di surface wey touch air
c-319.summary: Di white and dry part for meat or vegetables wey stay long inside freezer na freezer burn, e no harm if you eat am but e tough and taste worse. If you remove air and seal am well, you fit prevent am.
c-319.principle: During freezing, surface ice dey sublime to water vapour without passing through liquid and water dey comot: $\mathrm{H_2O(s)}\to\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$. Di dry surface dey touch air so fat go oxidise and e go taste spoiled.
c-319.example: Meat wey you leave without packing for -18°C freezer go lose few % of surface water within few weeks and go dry white. If you remove air with vacuum or zip bag, quality go remain for more than 3 to 6 months and you go reduce di cost of food wey dem throw away (thousands of won per month or more).
c-319.actionItem: Today, put meat and vegetables wey you wan freeze inside zip bag one serving each, remove di air as much as you fit, seal am and write di date. Cut off di part wey don already get freezer burn and use am for soup or stew.

c-320.title: Dissolve curry and sauce powder inside cold water first so e no go lump
c-320.summary: If you put curry or sauce powder directly inside hot soup, only di outside go cook and e go lump. First dissolve am inside cold or lukewarm water or turn off di fire and mix am small small.
c-320.principle: Starch particles dey gelatinise for surface first when dem meet hot water to form sticky gel film, and dis film dey stop water from reaching di powder inside. Gelatinisation dey start at about 60 to 70°C and e dey happen first for di surface where $T>T_{\mathrm{gel}}$.
c-320.example: If you put 100g curry powder inside 90°C soup all at once, di surface go gelatinise and lumps of few mm diameter go form, but if you first dissolve am inside 200mL of 20 to 30°C water and then put am, di particles go spread evenly and almost no lump.
c-320.actionItem: Today if you dey make curry or sauce, dissolve di powder inside cold water first and strain am, or turn off di fire, add am small small while you stir, then boil again on low heat.

c-321.title: For AHA and BHA exfoliant, pH and concentration na di key
c-321.summary: Di effect and irritation of exfoliating acid depend on di product pH and concentration, no be di ingredient name. Even gentle product fit irritate more if di pH low.
c-321.principle: Acid dey ionise according to $\mathrm{pH} = \mathrm{p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, and na di undissociated free acid ($\mathrm{HA}$) dey act on di skin. Di lower di pH be than $\mathrm{p}K_a$, di bigger di free acid fraction.
c-321.example: Glycolic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ about 3.83) 10% product get 50% free acid for pH 3.83, and for pH 3.0 e go increase to about 87% so irritation go bigger. Salicylic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ about 2.97) dem dey mainly use am around pH 3 to 4.
c-321.actionItem: Today if you dey use exfoliant, check di acid type, concentration and pH of di product, start with maximum 2 times a week and apply sunscreen di next day.

c-322.title: Durian dem ban am from hotel because of smell
c-322.summary: Dem ban durian for hotels and public transport no be because of toxicity but because of di smell wey strong even for very small amount.
c-322.principle: Esters ($\mathrm{RCOOH + R'OH \rightleftharpoons RCOOR' + H_2O}$) and sulphur compounds (thiols $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$) get smell threshold for ppb level so even very tiny amount fit dey detected.
c-322.example: 1ppb na one billionth by volume, so for 30m³ room e be about 0.03mL gas. Na why if you leave am with di shell, di smell go remain for di whole room and di air conditioner filter.
c-322.actionItem: Before you travel to Southeast Asia, check di hotel's ban notice, and eat durian for packaged shop or outdoors.

c-323.title: For moisturiser, ceramide, glycerin and oil get different roles
c-323.summary: Good moisturiser get ingredients wey dey pull water, ingredients wey dey fill gaps and ingredients wey dey stop evaporation together.
c-323.principle: Humectant (glycerin) dey pull water, emollient (ceramide etc.) dey fill gaps between dead skin cells, and occlusive (Vaseline) dey stop water evaporation. Water movement dey explain with $J = -D\frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}$.
c-323.example: Glycerin dey usually use 5 to 10%, and Vaseline dey known to reduce transepidermal water loss by more than 90%. If all three dey inside, e go last longer for dry winter than product wey get only one.
c-323.actionItem: Today, check di moisturiser ingredient list for glycerin, ceramide and oil (or Vaseline), and apply am within 3 minutes afta shower.

c-324.title: Check creosote for fireplace and stove chimney every year
c-324.summary: If tar for firewood smoke condense and gather for chimney wall, e fit cause chimney fire, so you must check am every year.
c-324.principle: Tar and soot vapour wey form from incomplete combustion dey condense for di cold chimney wall to become creosote. If oxygen no enough like $\mathrm{C_xH_y + O_2 \to C + CO + H_2O}$, unburnt materials go increase.
c-324.example: US NFPA 211 dey recommend to clean di chimney when di deposit for di inner wall reach about 3mm (1/8 inch). Wet firewood wey get more than 20% moisture dey lower di combustion temperature and make di deposit build up fast.
c-324.actionItem: Today, check whether your firewood don dry well to 20% moisture or below, and book chimney inspection and cleaning with professional.

c-325.title: If you keep butter near strong-smelling food, di smell go enter am
c-325.summary: Butter get about 80% fat so e dey dissolve and absorb smell molecules from things like kimchi or fish well.
c-325.principle: Fat dey non-polar so e dey dissolve di non-polar volatile molecules wey dey cause smell well. Partition coefficient na $K = \frac{C_{\mathrm{fat}}}{C_{\mathrm{water}}}$, and if $\log K = 3$, di concentration for di fat side go be 1,000 times higher.
c-325.example: Out of 200g butter, fat na about 160g. If you leave am without lid near kimchi for few days, di smell go enter and you go pity throw di butter away.
c-325.actionItem: Today, put butter inside airtight container on top of di original wrapper and keep am for shelf wey far from strong-smelling food.

c-326.title: Why glass cup dey turn cloudy inside dishwasher
c-326.summary: Di cloudiness fit be water scale or di glass surface don get etched. If you soak am for vinegar, you go know di difference.
c-326.principle: If you use soft water and alkaline detergent at high temperature, di silicate network for glass go dissolve and di surface go etch. $\mathrm{SiO_2 + 2OH^- \to SiO_3^{2-} + H_2O}$
c-326.example: Etching no fit reverse, but di lime film from hard water go disappear if you soak am for white vinegar for 5 minutes. If you reduce detergent use and use eco programme around 55℃, etching go reduce.
c-326.actionItem: Today, soak di cloudy cup for white vinegar for 5 minutes to check whether na water scale, and put only di amount of detergent wey di manual recommend.

c-327.title: Change mascara after 3 to 6 months
c-327.summary: Mascara dey near di eye and every time you open am, air dey enter, so bacteria fit increase easily, so e good to change am within 3 to 6 months afta you open am.
c-327.principle: After you open am, preservative dey finish small small and bacteria dey increase as $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$. Every time you put brush inside and comot, air dey push enter, so drying and contamination dey happen together.
c-327.example: For ideal condition, if bacteria double every 20 minutes, after 6 hours e go be $2^{18}$, about 260,000 times. If your eye dey itch or red, suspect old mascara first.
c-327.actionItem: Today, write di opening date for your mascara container, and if e don pass 3 months, change am to new one.

c-328.title: Foreign rice get different amylose content so di taste of rice different
c-328.summary: Di reason why rice wey you chop abroad fit be loose or sticky na say di ratio of amylose and amylopectin for di rice different.
c-328.principle: If amylose (straight chain) plenty, di rice grains go separate and firm, and if amylopectin (branched) plenty, e go sticky more. $\text{amylose \%} = \frac{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}}{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}+m_{\mathrm{amylopectin}}}\times 100$
c-328.example: Short-grain rice for Korea and Japan get amylose about 17 to 20%, long-grain indica about 22 to 28%, and glutinous rice almost 0%. Long-grain usually need water of 1.5 to 2 times rice volume.
c-328.actionItem: Today, check di short, medium or long grain mark for rice package and cook di rice with di water ratio wey dem write for di package.

c-329.title: For mouthwash, check say e no get alcohol and e get CPC
c-329.summary: Choose mouthwash by looking di antibacterial ingredient (CPC) and whether e get alcohol. Alcohol fit dry your mouth.
c-329.principle: CPC (cetylpyridinium chloride) na cationic surfactant wey dey stick to negatively charged bacteria membrane and destroy am. Di attraction dey explain with $F = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$.
c-329.example: CPC products dey usually get concentration of 0.05 to 0.07%, and one gargle of 20mL get about 10 to 14mg. Some products get 20% or more ethanol, so person wey mouth dey dry easily fit prefer alcohol-free.
c-329.actionItem: Today, check di mouthwash ingredient list for CPC and ethanol, gargle for 30 seconds and spit am, no swallow am.

c-330.title: Window silicone caulk smell na acetic acid wey dey come out when e dey cure
c-330.summary: Di vinegar-like smell of caulk dey come because acetic acid dey come out as di silicone dey harden, and e go reduce when curing finish.
c-330.principle: Acetoxy silicone dey react with moisture for air to release acetic acid and cross-link. $\mathrm{R{-}Si(OCOCH_3)_3 + 3H_2O \to R{-}Si(OH)_3 + 3CH_3COOH}$
c-330.example: Di surface usually take 10 to 30 minutes to harden, and 3mm thickness take about 24 hours to harden completely. Acetic acid fit corrode metal and marble, so neutral silicone dey suitable for those places.
c-330.actionItem: If you do di work today, open window and ventilate for 24 hours, and choose neutral silicone for metal and stone materials.

c-331.title: If olive oil turn cloudy and solid inside fridge, e no spoil
c-331.summary: Olive oil wey turn cloudy and solid inside fridge no spoil, na di fat don crystallise, and if you leave am for room temperature e go clear again.
c-331.principle: Even unsaturated fatty acids dey form crystals below melting point. Melting temperature na $T_m = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}$, and olive oil dey start to turn cloudy below about 5 to 10℃.
c-331.example: For 4℃ fridge e dey turn cloudy and solid, but if you leave am for 20 to 25℃ room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour, e go clear again. For olive oil, dark cool room temperature better than fridge storage for oxidation.
c-331.actionItem: Today, for olive oil wey don turn cloudy and solid, leave am for room temperature for 30 minutes to melt am instead of microwave, and from now keep am inside dark cupboard.

c-332.title: Melt sugar without stirring to make caramel
c-332.summary: When you dey make caramel, you no stir di sugar to prevent sugar crystals from forming again in chain reaction.
c-332.principle: If one sugar grain become seed, di solution around am go crystallise in chain. Above 160℃, hydrolysis and dehydration dey happen and e go brown. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \to C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-332.example: If you put 50mL water for 200g sugar and boil am, e go become golden caramel at about 170 to 180℃ after 5 to 10 minutes. Caramel for dis temperature fit burn you if e splash.
c-332.actionItem: Today if you dey make caramel, no stir, swirl di pan to mix, and wash di crystals for di pot wall down with wet brush.

c-333.title: If skin turn red from metal accessories, e fit be nickel allergy
c-333.summary: If your skin turn red and itchy where earring or watch buckle touch am, e fit be because of di nickel for di metal. Go see dermatologist for diagnosis.
c-333.principle: Nickel for metal dey oxidise for sweat and dissolve as ions. $\mathrm{Ni \to Ni^{2+} + 2e^-}$ If dis ion bond with skin protein, contact dermatitis fit form.
c-333.example: EU dey set di nickel release limit for products wey dey touch skin for long at $0.5\ \mu\mathrm{g/cm^2}$ per week. E dey known say about 1 in 10 people dey sensitive to nickel.
c-333.actionItem: Today, check di 'nickel free' mark for jewellery wey dey cause repeated itching, and if di symptoms continue, go see dermatologist.

c-334.title: Wasabi hotness dey come when you grate am and e dey disappear quick
c-334.summary: Di hotness of real wasabi dey form when you grate am and cells break, and e dey volatile so e dey fly comot quick.
c-334.principle: When cells break, di enzyme myrosinase dey break down di glycoside sinigrin to form hot allyl isothiocyanate. $\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}KNO_9S_2 + H_2O \to C_4H_5NS + C_6H_{12}O_6 + KHSO_4}$
c-334.example: Di hotness dey strongest within few minutes afta grating and e go reduce well well by 15 to 30 minutes. For tube wasabi, di main raw material dey often be horseradish.
c-334.actionItem: Today if you dey use fresh wasabi, grate am with grater just before you eat and cover am, and for tube product check di ingredient name.

c-335.title: Plenty foam for dish soap no mean say e dey clean better
c-335.summary: Plenty foam and cleaning grease well na two different things. Foam fit come from stabilisers.
c-335.principle: Surfactants dey form micelles above critical micelle concentration (CMC) to wrap oil. Surface tension dey drop until CMC and afta dat e almost dey constant.
c-335.example: CMC of SDS na about 8.2 mM, wey be about 2.4g per 1L water. If you add more detergent afta you pass dis concentration, cleaning power no go increase much and rinsing go just hard.
c-335.actionItem: Today, use only bean-size dish soap and judge by whether di grease don comot, no be by di amount of foam.

c-336.title: Heat-generating underwear like Heattech dey produce heat when sweat moisture adsorb to di fibre
c-336.summary: Di reason why heat-generating underwear dey warm na say heat dey release when water vapour from di body adsorb to di fibre, but di effect no big and e no dey last long.
c-336.principle: When water vapour stick to di fibre, heat dey release like condensation. $Q = m\,L$ and di latent heat of condensation $L$ of water na about $2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
c-336.example: If 10g moisture adsorb, up to about 23kJ heat go come out but when di fibre saturate, e stop. If you sweat plenty and e wet, e go rather take heat away and you go feel colder.
c-336.actionItem: Today, wear thin layer on top of di heat-generating underwear, and if you sweat, remove one layer so e no wet.

c-337.title: PET bottle must separate label and cap so e go become recycled material
c-337.summary: PET bottle must comot label and rinse before dem put am for disposal so e no go mix with other plastics and e go become good recycled material.
c-337.principle: For recycling, dem dey separate PET wey dey sink inside water from PP and PE wey dey float by density difference $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$ and melt dem to make products. PET dey melt at about 250℃, PP about 165℃ and PE about 110 to 130℃.
c-337.example: PET density na about 1.38g/cm³ and PP and PE na about 0.9g/cm³ so dem dey separate inside water. If about 2g cap mix with about 20g of 500mL bottle, impurities fit reach 10%.
c-337.actionItem: Today, empty and rinse di PET bottle, comot di label and put am inside transparent PET collection bin.

c-338.title: Meringue no go rise even if one drop of grease dey
c-338.summary: Di most common reason meringue no dey rise na grease for di bowl or egg white.
c-338.principle: Egg white protein dey spread for di boundary between air and water to form film wey dey hold di bubbles. Fat dey take position for dis film first and e dey block di film formation. Pressure difference between inside and outside of di bubble na $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$.
c-338.example: 3 egg whites (about 100g) get about 90% water and about 10% protein, but egg yolk get about 30% fat so even one drop mix and di volume go reduce well well. Plastic bowl fit easily get oil inside.
c-338.actionItem: Today if you dey make meringue, wipe glass or stainless steel bowl with vinegar or lemon juice, and separate di egg whites one by one into am.

c-339.title: Before you dye grey hair, do patch test two days before
c-339.summary: Hair dye allergy fit suddenly happen, so e good to do patch test for behind di ear or inside di arm 48 hours before you dye.
c-339.principle: Oxidative dyes like para-phenylenediamine (PPD) dey meet hydrogen peroxide to make reactive intermediates wey fit bond with skin protein and cause allergy. $\mathrm{C_6H_4(NH_2)_2 \xrightarrow{H_2O_2} \text{reactive intermediate}}$
c-339.example: EU dey limit PPD for hair to maximum 2% after mixing. Wait 48 hours with small amount below di size of 500-won coin, and if redness, itching or swelling dey, no dye.
c-339.actionItem: If you plan to dye, apply small amount behind your ear two days before for patch test, and if symptoms dey, no use am, and if e serious, go see doctor.

c-340.title: Proof for foreign alcohol bottle na double of di alcohol percent
c-340.summary: Proof for American alcohol bottle na double of alcohol by volume (ABV), so 80 proof na 40%.
c-340.principle: American style na $\text{proof} = 2 \times \text{ABV}$. Old British proof get different standard so 100 proof be about 57.15%, so you must check for each country.
c-340.example: For 45mL (1.5 oz) of 80 proof whisky, ethanol na $45 \times 0.40 = 18\ \mathrm{mL}$, about 14.2g, wey be one drink by US standard. 100 proof (50%) na about 17.8g for di same amount.
c-340.actionItem: Today, divide di proof of foreign alcohol bottle by 2 to calculate di percent and write down how much you drink so you no go drink too much.

c-341.title: For water purifier filter, activated carbon and reverse osmosis membrane filter different things
c-341.summary: Activated carbon dey mainly filter organic things like chlorine and smell, and reverse osmosis membrane dey mainly filter ions wey dissolve for water. Before you choose, decide wetin you wan filter.
c-341.principle: Activated carbon dey adsorb for surface, and reverse osmosis dey apply pressure bigger than osmotic pressure $\pi = iMRT$ to make only water pass through di semipermeable membrane.
c-341.example: Osmotic pressure of NaCl 500mg/L (about 8.6 mmol/L) na about 0.42atm at 25℃. Household reverse osmosis dey usually apply 3 to 4bar pressure to remove most ions.
c-341.actionItem: Today, check when to change your water purifier filter, and confirm di performance for wetin e remove with official certification mark.

c-342.title: Di reason why camping lantern gas mantle dey shine bright na rare earth oxides
c-342.summary: Di bright light for gas lantern no come from di flame but from di rare earth oxide mantle wey flame heat dey heat up.
c-342.principle: When di oxide mantle heat to about 2,000K, e dey radiate towards visible light. Di radiation peak wavelength na $\lambda_{\max} T = 2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$.
c-342.example: For 2,000K, $\lambda_{\max}$ na about 1.45μm. Yttrium oxide and cerium mantle get big share of visible light so for di same fuel e dey far brighter than bare flame. Old mantles dey use radioactive thorium oxide.
c-342.actionItem: Today, burn new mantle for first time outdoors to harden am, no touch di ash, and check di thorium-free mark.

c-343.title: Paper cup no dey recycle as normal paper because of di polyethylene coating inside
c-343.summary: Paper cup get plastic film for waterproofing, so if you put am inside normal paper collection bin, recycling go hard.
c-343.principle: Di polyethylene (PE) for inside of paper cup no dissolve for water and e dey float because e get density $\rho \approx 0.92\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$, so e hard to separate from fibre for pulping process.
c-343.example: One paper cup na about 10g and PE coating be about 5%. If no special process dey, dis coating fit make all di paper lose recycling quality.
c-343.actionItem: Today, carry your personal tumbler, and if you must use paper cup, check local separation rules and collect dem separately.

c-344.title: Fresh cream must cold to whip hard
c-344.summary: Fresh cream dey form hard foam when e very cold, and if e lukewarm, e no go rise no matter how you whisk am.
c-344.principle: When e cold, di fat inside di fat globules don crystallise, so for whipping di fat globules dey partially cluster and make net wey dey hold di air bubbles. If di fat melt, dis net no dey form.
c-344.example: If you whip 200mL cream wey get 35% or more milk fat at 4℃, di volume go double in 3 to 5 minutes. At 20℃ or more e no dey rise well and if you whisk too long, e go separate into butter and whey.
c-344.actionItem: Today before you whip, cool di cream and bowl for more than 10 minutes, and stop as soon as peaks form.

c-345.title: No hold peroxide from whitening toothpaste for long
c-345.summary: Peroxide for whitening toothpaste or strips fit irritate gum, so use am only for di set time.
c-345.principle: Hydrogen peroxide dey oxidise and break down colouring molecules and release oxygen. $2\mathrm{H_2O_2} \to 2\mathrm{H_2O} + \mathrm{O_2}$. Dis kind of reactivity dey irritate mucous membrane too.
c-345.example: EU dey limit hydrogen peroxide for normal toothpaste to 0.1% or below, and whitening products of 0.1 to 6% must be use under dental supervision. If you no follow time and hold am long, gum irritation and sensitivity go increase.
c-345.actionItem: Today, use whitening product only for di time wey di instruction say, and if your gum sting, stop and talk to dentist.

c-346.title: No drink melted snow water directly
c-346.summary: Snow fit look clean but e dey collect air pollutants and microbes, so you must boil melted water before you drink am.
c-346.principle: Snow crystals dey catch dust and fine particles as dem dey form and fall. Boiling dey kill microbes but heavy metals and chemical pollutants no dey disappear. Amount of water dey depend on snow density, so $V_{\mathrm{water}} \approx \frac{V_{\mathrm{snow}}}{10}$.
c-346.example: If you melt 10L fresh snow, water na about 1L, and boiling time of 1 minute or more (3 minutes for 2,000m above sea level or more) na di general standard. No use snow wey dey beside road or wey change colour.
c-346.actionItem: For emergency today, collect only clean fresh snow, put small water inside pot first, melt am and boil am before you drink, and normally carry bottled water.

c-347.title: Lactose-free milk na milk wey dem don break lactose down before
c-347.summary: Lactose-free milk na milk wey dem don break di lactose before, so e fit lactose intolerance, but di milk protein still dey so e no fit milk allergy.
c-347.principle: Di enzyme lactase dey hydrolyse lactose into glucose and galactose. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{lactase}} C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-347.example: Lactose for normal milk na about 4.7 to 5g per 100mL, so 200mL na about 9.5g. Lactose-free label na 0.01g/100g or below for EU standard, and because of di broken-down simple sugars e dey sweeter small.
c-347.actionItem: Today, if lactose intolerance dey make your belly uncomfortable, choose lactose-free product, but if you get milk allergy, avoid both normal and lactose-free.

c-348.title: Nitrogen dioxide dey come out when you cook with gas stove, so turn on di hood
c-348.summary: Gas flame dey make nitrogen dioxide wey fit spoil di air inside small kitchen, so e good to turn on di hood when you dey cook.
c-348.principle: For high-temperature flame, nitrogen and oxygen for air dey react ($\mathrm{N_2 + O_2 \to 2NO}$) and then oxidise. $2\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{NO_2}$
c-348.example: Measurements for small kitchen without ventilation don report cases where nitrogen dioxide concentration pass di WHO 1-hour guideline $200\ \mu\mathrm{g/m^3}$. Hood wey dey vent comot outside dey reduce dis concentration well well.
c-348.actionItem: Today, turn on di hood before you start to cook and leave am running for about 10 more minutes afta you off di fire.

c-349.title: You fit make laundry soap from used cooking oil
c-349.summary: If you collect used cooking oil instead of to throw am inside drain, you fit react am with caustic soda to make soap.
c-349.principle: Saponification reaction na triglyceride and NaOH dey make soap and glycerol. $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-349.example: Soybean oil need about 0.135g NaOH per 1g oil, so for 500g oil e be about 68g. Caustic soda na strong alkali so safety goggles and gloves na must, and you go use di soap after e don harden for about 4 weeks.
c-349.actionItem: Today, strain di used oil with coffee filter and collect am inside airtight bottle, and never throw am inside drain.

c-350.title: Even one drop of water fit make melted chocolate thick
c-350.summary: If even small water enter melted chocolate, di smooth one go suddenly turn thick lump.
c-350.principle: Sugar and cocoa particles dey absorb water to form sticky syrup film and di particles dey stick together so viscosity go rise sharply. Dem dey call am seizing.
c-350.example: If only few grams, about 1 to 2%, of water enter 200g chocolate, e go thicken. If you add more water until about 20% or more, e fit even become smooth again like thin ganache.
c-350.actionItem: Today when you dey melt chocolate, wipe water from di bowl and spatula, and make sure say di double-boiler water no touch di bowl or steam no enter.

c-351.title: Wash chopping board immediately afta use and dry am completely
c-351.summary: Bacteria dey multiply only if moisture dey, so di key na to wash chopping board immediately afta use and dry am completely.
c-351.principle: Water activity wey show how much water dey available na $a_w = \frac{p}{p_0}$, and many pathogens dey increase fast when $a_w$ na about 0.9 or more.
c-351.example: Di $a_w$ for raw meat surface na about 0.99, so bacteria fit grow easily. If you no leave am standing wet but dry am with air flow, surface moisture go reduce and growth go suppress.
c-351.actionItem: Today, wash di chopping board with hot water and detergent immediately afta you use am, and stand am up to dry completely. Use separate boards for raw meat and vegetables.

c-352.title: For Christmas market glühwein, if you boil am di aroma go fly comot
c-352.summary: No boil glühwein (mulled wine), just heat am until steam dey rise so di aroma and alcohol no go escape much.
c-352.principle: Ethanol boiling point na about 78℃, lower than water, so e dey evaporate first when you heat am. Vapour pressure of di mixture dey show as $P = x_{\mathrm{EtOH}}\,P^{\circ}_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ (Raoult's law).
c-352.example: 750mL wine wey be 12% get about 90mL ethanol. Dem usually serve am heated to 60 to 70℃, and if you boil am above 78℃, alcohol and aroma components go fly comot quick.
c-352.actionItem: Today, heat wine on low fire so e no pass 70℃, and remove di spices before e boil.

c-353.title: Di ABC mark for fire extinguisher show di type of fire
c-353.summary: A, B and C for fire extinguisher show which fire you fit use am for, and for home ABC powder extinguisher na di common one.
c-353.principle: For Korean and US marking, A na ordinary fire, B na oil fire and C na electrical fire. Monoammonium phosphate dey break down when e heat to stop di combustion chain reaction. $\mathrm{NH_4H_2PO_4 \to NH_3 + H_3PO_4}$
c-353.example: Home 3.3kg powder extinguisher normally dey discharge for about 10 to 20 seconds so you must know how to use am before. For Europe, C mean gas fire and di marks dey different, so check your local standard.
c-353.actionItem: Today, check say di pressure gauge of your extinguisher dey for green range, and keep am where your hand fit reach.

c-354.title: Reusable hand warmer dey use crystallisation heat of sodium acetate
c-354.summary: Reusable hand warmer dey use heat wey dey come out when supersaturated solution crystallise all at once, and you fit reuse am if you dissolve am inside boiling water.
c-354.principle: Sodium acetate trihydrate dey melt at about 58℃, and when di supercooled liquid crystallise, e dey release heat of fusion. $Q = m\,\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$, $\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$ na about 265J/g.
c-354.example: If 100g hand warmer crystallise, about 26kJ heat go come out and di surface go rise to about 50℃. If you put di same pack inside boiling water for about 10 minutes, e go become clear liquid again.
c-354.actionItem: Today, soak di hand warmer inside boiling water until all di crystals dissolve, let am cool slowly, and no hold am on bare skin for long.

c-355.title: Opened wine go last four more days if you block oxygen
c-355.summary: Di main reason why opened wine dey change na oxygen, so if you close di stopper and keep am for fridge, you fit still drink am for 3 to 5 more days.
c-355.principle: Oxygen and acetic acid bacteria dey change ethanol through acetaldehyde to acetic acid. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH + O_2 \to CH_3COOH + H_2O}$ Di reaction rate na $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, and if temperature drop by about 10℃, e go roughly halve.
c-355.example: If you close am with stopper and keep am for fridge, both red and white normally last 3 to 5 days, but without stopper for room temperature, di taste go drop within 1 to 2 days. If di amount wey remain small, pour am into small bottle to reduce di air inside.
c-355.actionItem: Today, close di stopper for leftover wine and put am for fridge immediately, and take red out 20 minutes before you drink.

c-356.title: Di white crystals for di bottom of wine bottle na tartrate deposit
c-356.summary: Di white grains for di bottom of wine bottle or for cork no be sign of spoiling, na tartrate crystals wey no dey harm.
c-356.principle: Potassium hydrogen tartrate (KHT) dey precipitate because e solubility reduce for low temperature. $\mathrm{KHC_4H_4O_6(s) \rightleftharpoons K^+ + HC_4H_4O_6^-}$ and $K_{sp} = [\mathrm{K^+}][\mathrm{HC_4H_4O_6^-}]$.
c-356.example: Wine usually get 1.5 to 4g/L tartaric acid, and crystals dey form slowly for low temperature like fridge. Di same substance na cream of tartar wey dem dey use for baking.
c-356.actionItem: Today if you see di crystals, no throw am away, stand di bottle up and pour am slowly to leave di deposit for di bottom.

c-357.title: No put aroma oil or detergent inside humidifier
c-357.summary: For humidifier water tank, put only clean water. If you put oil or detergent, e go become fine particles and you go breathe am directly.
c-357.principle: Ultrasonic humidifier dey spray water as fine droplets and dem dey send di dissolved substances together into di air. Di amount of non-volatile material wey dem spray na $m = C \times V_{\mathrm{mist}}$.
c-357.example: If spray rate na about 300mL per hour and you put am at 1% concentration, about 3mL oil or detergent per hour go spray. Tap water minerals (assume 150mg/L) too, about 45mg per hour go become white powder.
c-357.actionItem: Today, change di humidifier water every day, use special diffuser for aroma, and wash di water tank every week.

c-358.title: For foreign rental car fuel station, E10 na petrol wey dem mix with ethanol
c-358.summary: E10 na fuel wey get about 10% ethanol mixed inside petrol, and most petrol cars fit use am but e get small lower energy.
c-358.principle: Ethanol get energy per volume of about 21MJ/L, lower than petrol (about 32MJ/L). $E_{\mathrm{E10}} = 0.9E_{\mathrm{gas}} + 0.1E_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ and di octane number rise small.
c-358.example: Di energy of E10 na about 30.9MJ/L, about 3% lower than petrol, so car wey do 14km/L go do about 13.6km/L. To know whether your car type dey suit E10, check di mark for di fuel flap.
c-358.actionItem: Today when you collect rental car, check di fuel mark for di fuel flap (petrol, diesel, E10 suitable), and no confuse diesel and petrol.

c-359.title: Smoke detector, photoelectric and ionisation type no be di same
c-359.summary: Smoke detector dey detect different fires well depending on type, and photoelectric type dey stronger for fires wey dey smoulder slowly.
c-359.principle: Ionisation type dey use americium-241 to ionise air and e go alarm when di current wey dey flow reduce by smoke particles, and photoelectric type sensor dey detect light wey smoke particles scatter.
c-359.example: Ionisation type dey fast for small particles (about 0.01 to 0.3μm) from big flaming fires, and photoelectric dey fast for large particles (about 0.3 to 10μm) from smouldering fires. Ionisation type get about 30 to 40 kBq of americium inside.
c-359.actionItem: Today, press di test button of di detector to check say e dey work, and if di manufacture date for di back don pass 10 years, change am.

c-360.title: If diesel car do only short trips, di soot filter go block
c-360.summary: If you only use diesel car for short trips, di exhaust no go hot enough and soot go gather for di particulate filter (DPF).
c-360.principle: Di soot wey gather for DPF need regeneration by burning am for high temperature. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ Dis reaction dey happen at about 350 to 450℃ if catalyst dey, and active regeneration dey happen at about 600℃.
c-360.example: For short trips, di exhaust temperature no even reach 200℃ so regeneration no dey happen. Na why sometimes you must drive fast for more than about 20 to 30 minutes to burn di filter.
c-360.actionItem: This week, drive highway at steady speed for more than 20 to 30 minutes, and if di warning light dey on, go garage for inspection.

c-361.title: Tough meat fit soften with small baking soda
